## Abbott Orders State Agencies to Aid Deportations
Gov. Greg Abbott [issued a series of executive orders](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD3PozAQhH8NdEa2dxOgcHFNulx7JfLHQqwzGNmbQP79q6R_u6eYGY2ef_fpbmOK2_LXrmT4nPOkpb4IqQSoKdiY3hO2wTgZRtWSUT0MoAGwbx_GoUQ_Y8DrCN4NF9WT1QhBK4CxJ99G8xmTCpRSAKA6HGzwiHjVbh7tMDQoKUTOpeMHMZ22zumdX1Q6n9c2mQfzXhv40-hbo2_HcXQbHfUg-v8JNPq2FFqEdS4zizm-SNBJ_skfyiVQqeJZxRqXYjnmTQTac-EvVxHyZlMQXJ7rLlY6o8_CfVtCSw2ohraYsB8xpVivfYNyWW1M32v8q6uX0T8BAAD__1vTbrM) Wednesday that enlist state resources in the Trump Administration’s nationwide effort to deport illegal immigrants. [The five orders](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuO4zAMRb9G7hjoNbZTqNhG3Wy7ZSBLdCJANg2JzuPvF5p-SpIHB7z33_ftO-SS9_vfsKHj90o3LfUXSAVG3VLI5XOzQ3KLTFc1oFOTmY02xk7Dw5nZXnGR8WuRxo4q2GkdZzmufTaTvQ7ZdZlURilljFEXO4cUrbWjXtZrmGdhJabMVC_8QMZ3aGv50BPrJdI2FPdgPpowf4T2Qvt2YOR6boViKDu-WqeE9vzuRzr5AT8OwAJHaCS075TQvr8htJdKaG-k0P5OT4CwLMQMKVeM3KBxYIRwxz1mbMAEkaimvPf1K3d7PbcDaIeEB1UOnGkHXFeq3AAWqgkrNIxnzfyBobp0vHIpuY2TsPK-hVx-gvGvTT-d_h8AAP__BpGC4Q) require state agencies to assist federal law enforcement in detaining and deporting illegal immigrants, to share intelligence on criminal organizations like Tren de Aragua, and to support the Border Patrol and U.S. military in deploying border barriers and “repelling the invasion.” “ _Now, we have a Commander-in-Chief in the White House who will do what is necessary to protect Americans_ ,” [Abbott said](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD3PozAQhH8NdEb4gzdQuLiGLtdeifyxwErGi-wNSf79Kbn62pnR6NHz577cHSbM2293gOXXSovq1SB6KbRcosP0Xkwbre_jJFuw8qZHrbQ2t3a3anVgYhhWs0pwfog6mMn71UxRBqWHFu3nrJdaSqm1lp0ZXQzGmB_l18mNY2N6iMhUOt6B4eXqmt50QekCHW2yO_NZG_2rUXOj5o2u7jvqNroaNWd41kbNJ1X-10LJVITznphFxAKBq6jsGITbIAeEKphEICoR8yd-Iu-Cy-M4hYsHZqxcHCNlQVl4KhGK2OmA5HIUFcKjIL_bYuP5xJSw_twa02-Hw_Ql5v8qvKz6GwAA__9Tk3mb). “ _Just like President Donald Trump and his Administration, Texas will do what is necessary to keep our country safe._ ”
## Sales of THC Products Spike As Potential Ban Looms
Retailers of products containing THC, the psychoactive ingredient in marijuana, have seen an [increase in sales](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7GO6yAQheGngc4WzIAzLihu4y633dIaAw5IJFg2ipO3XyX91kf6jv6f63zlXPLj9p_v0bXXWmdQYDulO9Rz4Fzes5HBLSqMWkanL0gIiOYikzMLLZqtpYG0t0QIAS0SG8MxjGuU2X0wpVFrjYi6N8TBG2MGWNaRiYRRMeRW976l2OKLj7W86zPuva93WVxqbTsE_hMwCZjO8-x92uvjswqYtlpyy_4QMPHesi9RwPRVupZ8t_CjA6Us0Tj0W9rk7sJ25lLyMVyEUbc75_I9an-WPx38BgAA__8szVoJ) since Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick indicated last month that he wants to ban the sale of such products. "_People are in disbelief_ ," said Scott Stubbs, president of cannabinoid retailer Sublingwell Brands. "_All of them are experiencing fear and anxiety about the potential ban_.” Since 2019, state law has allowed the sale of hemp products containing less than 0.3% THC, but [Patrick claims](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j72OwyAQBp8GOqzdhdimoLgmXa690sJmHaPDPzIoJG9_Svrrv29G83Mbbj6muN2__cquPOd9IKCLAlQah-Bjeg1GBjdCsCjZYad7TVqbTi5uvugeJ8JLmJAMWMDWE0DH4FtjEWV0bxigRkStNTam92EyxrQ0ztb3vTDAIZb9bMrChZ8-z-m1P_hspn2VyS2lHFnoL0FXQddaa7NxzZX59z0QdP181BhTUqPf1MLrocoyqewTZ4XWtoAkTxeOGlOKue2EgfvqY_oYyr_JD0d_AQAA__8k3Fcm) retailers are selling products with much higher concentrations and that such products are often marketed to children. On Wednesday, Patrick released the [first 25 of his 40 legislative priorities](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLvOozAUhJ_GdAf5Fi6Fi23osu2WyGAbjtaxkX0Cydv_Svq_m2I08-n7d5_vFiOm7a99eEOvkGfJ5Q24ACVmZzG-Z904s3A3isYb0atBSaV03-zG-3FQN3UbFqUHtQgdOi5lkKteAl-7vkHzGeNCCSGUUqLVg3Wr1rqTSxjtMDDNvUPKpaXdk3_ZGuI7n760a3400exER2XqD5MTk9N1XW2kLZ_tt9pu-WRy-lwwOXHxySOTUyTY8gnOJjgsFVz_g00pP9PqKwQslaDkZ3KQA1A-QHM4CuaC9IYFY6wQcgHaPXxVRL9hjZbw9FB9rZgTk1NTjDsujBFr1zPNt4fF-KWmXzWeRv4EAAD__1oqdNc) for the session. “Banning THC in Texas” ranked third on the list after the state budget and “Providing School Choice.”
## County Meeting Goes off the Rails
At least [three people were forcibly removed](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0ULnOozAYfBrTfQgf4ShcpKHLtlsiYz6DNz6QbUJ4-xV__3ejGc2h-fuaXso6G9Y_yqMsXxMn1rAHNBQ4nRZl3TWJapFzswy0Qkk73nPGueiqTXZ8Fg8cDLKBMdUb3vY408bMRrezNkNl5R3WUE4p5ZzTWvRq0UKIls1mUH1PRIOLLTHVZcOCX5WNu-IHU62jr5zcStkz4U_CRsLG8zxrn8OtETZigCMTNu7R2WL1DdfbGjyGcvPH7KyGvKN6Y8qwHckBfneHxX4wgw2gN-UchhUhGigqJRUK6HiEckGGgCcsqGM6PNwl-iJsVAmeT3pR__5XJbnsp3XO5rYjolm9su5nePn1yY9k_wMAAP__upF6Dw) from Tuesday’s meeting of the Republican-controlled Tarrant County Commissioners Court as a new policy regulating public comments and decorum was debated and ultimately approved in a 3-2 party-line vote. At one point, Judge Tim O’Hare ordered the removal of a man who used profanity after indicating he wanted to address the court about a death in the county jail. When he protested that what he said was protected speech, Precinct 2 Commissioner Alisa Simmons asked the court’s lawyer to weigh in. He answered that it violated court policy. O’Hare agreed. “That’s fine, that’s f***ing fine,” Simmons responded, prompting O’Hare to call her “the most classless person we’ve ever had sitting on this dais.” [See a video of the exchange here](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFv8yAUAH8NbLbgPYLNwPDpizy0TaV06YjAPGJUUkcxieN_X6V755PupPs8uIPPJX-f3v2ZbH2k2YGAXSNkg9JFn8vmFI82iGgkJys77BEQVccnayh2Rms5Qp_SKCgkJB3Qj2RMSDHwbJ8yIVFKiYiyVb2Po1JKQ0jG9z1TgmKu87WtE1V6-CWVbb7TtR3nMy92qvWyMPzHYGAwrOvabvOt3gI9OYOh5DsxGPQxfsD_N-f2R4bDkhnupyBemmM-NTvzepu-EgNdGe6N0civNl7WXEpedMeUOJ19Lr_B-ueBu4WfAAAA__-KRlvn). The policy, which authorizes limiting the number of people allowed to speak on a specific agenda item and requires those who wish to address the court to sign up the day before, was proposed after an unruly meeting earlier this month [resulted in two arrests](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL0OnDAQhJ_GdEb-w_gKF2noLm1KtGADGxn7ZG-Ou7ePSJ92ZjQz-n495ydgwrz_hDN6-mxlVkINXEiu5RwA03c2XfCLCA_ZRS9H7bTS2ozd4YNdHttgh2WVA1jnwmbHxQozuMHq4MYO_V0mpJZSaq1lbxyE1Rhj1bI9wDlmRAxIpfZ0RIofaFv6lnes_VrOLvmD6NWY_sHUxNR0XVeflzVs120zNeV4NaamVFZITE3xLIQlN14h8wP3g9NVONQaG8XAgThBrZCJr-VPpi9fy3lia1hyrO0WK92ppWLcMO-8ZP4bMPEQgY57SY9GKi2Ymrrqw-vClLDZkRmxn4Dp32v6L8a3V38DAAD__xdPdts).

At one point, Judge Tim O’Hare ordered the removal of a man who used profanity after indicating he wanted to address the court about a death in the county jail. When he protested that what he said was protected speech, Precinct 2 Commissioner Alisa Simmons asked the court’s lawyer to weigh in. He answered that it violated court policy. ## No Survivors in American Airlines Collision
All 67 people aboard an Army helicopter and a jetliner [that collided above](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kD2P8yAQhH-N3RGxsP4qKN4mXd72SmsX1jEnbCyMEuXfn3z9lTMjjR49X4_5QTHF_fmfNnF1ybPRplMalIU5UEyfGdvgFhEjthUHgx2tsQahXR1NNGnxqL3uNY_EgT3yECx3ATxCG931psECgLWdvU0oYeQpMAOStlODWkKsudy-c9zrKkv65JeUm89bm9xa63E29l9j7o2507HL-7ymK5QafZLG3EveKQVVhJ60q51qvApFsRy5VOULnavqDQWmYWFYOuwZ_QID9IKGxx5Hw21x4XjHlOLZDw3q50Yx_VLUv6y8nPkJAAD__2JUY_c) the Potomac River near Ronald Reagan National Airport late Wednesday night have been confirmed dead, according to officials. Among those on the jetliner [were several members ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1uwyAURp8Gb1hwL3HigaGLt3TtaPFziWkJREBi5e0rd-_2SZ90jnS-ruvVxBTz7dPcSfdQVhBw4kJylKs3Mb1XNXgdiIBwIC3PeEFAUHLY9CWEYGGepANSarJ4nqfJGSEUIE0ShqgPmpAopUQ84Tgr8hc7e2ulMgJnpgT52Esdv0vMfaOQ3uVFdXTlPiS99f5oDD8YLAyWfd9HZ1umvR0_g-WYDJZHMpm4q6Zt3Dv-bLw-W4sm8xBvz0q8_ZhOtfGSuS2megbLULV_7DGl2KYzU-J2NzH9aft_GV4afgMAAP__I9tf3g)of U.S. Figure Skating, along with skaters from both the U.S. and Russia. They had just attended a prestigious training camp in Wichita, Kansas, where the flight took off. First responders transitioned overnight [from rescue efforts to recovery](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LGO6yAQheGnwR0WzJA4Lihu4y633dIaYBzPChuLoFh5-1W23_pI35H-r_t8J8myP_7Txr4tZQYDF22sRjsnkvyeXZf8wgyMHXs74A0Bwdlu9beQxmuKFC98DbSMbjAJLHAcRgxxgE78RzMWrbWIF-xHx-kWxhSCdWRwVM5wklZq_11kbysv-V1eXPtYti77tbXjqfCfgknBdJ5nH_cQP6OC6UMrmIxVMKFRMJHUWGlpOpVz17Lro7SySdRVXlz1zlR1iqRJ6lFq69e25a76dJySszyvg3LmsZHk3_f2V42Xh58AAAD__5QaYSs) operations. Authorities reported that at least 28 bodies have been found so far in the worst air disaster in the U.S. since 2001. American Airlines CEO Robert Isom held[ a media briefing](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L2OqzAQxfGnMZ2Rx0MCFC5uQ5fbbonG9hDPynzIWEF5-1W23_pIvyP9vx7zgyTL9vxPK7u67LM19qYNaIQ5kuT33DXRLcyWsWEHPQ5o0XbQJBfvsUfwfaBl7IEHHMj3FAmWwQ8YuBH30QwgACDesB07joMfo_fQkcFRdYaj1L2037tsNfGS3_uLSxv2tcku1XqcCv8pOyk7XdfVhs2Hz6js9KGVnQwoO6FRdqKViwTaNEnJsvGpj0wb61DoTHrJ8kxVH1RTm-qam-LicUnOct571ZnnSpJ_f-tfHV7O_gQAAP__ZENfGQ) on Thursday morning, stating it remains unclear why the Black Hawk military helicopter was flying near American Eagle Flight 5342.
## Duffy Orders Rewrite of Gas Mileage Rules
New Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy has ordered a review and rewrite of the [more stringent U.S. fuel economy rules](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHOpCAUhZ8GOwxw8VcLimnsZtotDcJ1hg2CueAY337j9n93kpNz8uX785yfNsSQ3i-7oalrnpVQHReSg5y9DfGadePNiqgQGjSyhwEUKC2bjxlGh3LpvbPK6x7GZf3pYHB-0MKhGLsmmPtNSJBSAnTQjhr9sIx-WaS2AkamBfpQM7V_c0j1g2u88hepdXlrovnUuhcGD6YmpqbzPNutpLtjasLEj8LUtOcYanB3fN_TtGGqTE2Vjm3nhVeyqeyZKi_oCKuli2fySIWvB0aOLqe8XZyOiJzwpFCRqckSfzzkBWd8NWT8foYYQ_npmRbvzYb4n7D-Zuxr1L8AAAD__9C9cJU) imposed by the Biden administration that would have required cars to average 65 miles per gallon by 2031. In his first act in office, Duffy signed a memo asking the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration to review the standards [to make them less aggressive.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2q4zAQhZ9G7iboL_F1oSKNYYu77ZZGtkbJLLJkpHGM337x9rc6Bw4cPr4_39O3p0T59duv6DiWSUt9B6nAqCl4Sudku-AiokbToVO9-TLaaKu6t3vgXfe-V6o3Kg46SJTWDMbOOoQ4R9mRu96kMkopY-7mNlgMX_MQ5llZL80grMRAXOrtb6HMb4zpLB-st6WsXXJv5q0J8xR6FHo8juO2tnxtQo-YYW9CjxmPK7aSiGm5Ktd93YCrz20rlT1TydBwqci-nrCWDzbgAnsOBWYKmCHumKCxz8HX0IAyRKqNwS8s9OgrPJ_qtOuvR1dd2A5KidqjF1a-Vk_pPy3_ZO_j9L8AAAD__6gLc_8) The memo specifically seeks to lessen the Biden-era push toward electric vehicles and away from gas-powered cars. Duffy’s memo said the current standards “diminish” the domestic auto industry and make it difficult for Americans to purchase affordable cars. The administration has also ordered an end to policies supporting the electric car market.
## China Sets Humans vs. Robot Half-Marathon
The first-ever half-marathon featuring humans racing against [humanoid robots](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kD2PszAQhH8NdI78FYgLF2-TLm97JVrwAnsya2T7iPLvT9BfN9IzejSar9fwAorEy3_Y0Nc5DVrqu5BKGDUEoPgZbBv8jKjRtOhVbx5GG21Vu_pOyUc_2bELwXXTPOJkjJLBqd5Zq8G15E-bVEYpZczd3JzF8BhdGEdlQRrXWImBasq370RcV5zjJx2Yb1Pa2ujXWvfSmH-Nfjb6SVwxY6nEC_JCjJiJl7N6QU4HVErc6Of6swEXcRRxpUShiGklBrHHE7xTjqGImXKpIsOEYqd6esUGLGAB4hOkMdXSZh_2N8VIpesbK5cNKF776l9_HV7_BgAA__9m9nFz) is set for April in Beijing, China, with an estimated 12,000 human runners from around the world expected to compete against robots. Eligible robots must have a human-like appearance, run on two legs, and stand between 0.5 meters (about 1.6 feet) and 2 meters tall (roughly 6.5 feet). [See photos and details here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LFuwyAUheGnwRsW3IuTeGDowpauHS0Ml0CFTQQkVvr0Vbp3PtKno__rulxtymm_fdqNdA9lAQETF5KjXLxN-bWowetABIQDaXnGCwKCkkPUODk3ncA7e8FpBgWgwIVpneFsJxf8kPRbExKllIgTjrMif1lnv65SWYEzU4J86qWO3yXtPVLIr_KkOrqyDVnH3u-N4QcDw8AcxzF6-iHa3zMD88YZGCEZGBQMjItpt_woNfvGQ6qt8_jY7N74k2p7NF7LWnrj0ebAN1ttj2VnYIaq_f1IOad2OjMlbptN-e9D_6_JU8NvAAAA__-AumLv). Organizers will permit a combination of remote-controlled and fully autonomous humanoids, and manufacturers will be allowed to replace batteries during the race. The unique race will cover a distance of 13 miles, and the top three runners will receive prizes. The race is open to all robots created by national and international companies, research institutions, universities, and robotics clubs.

name: Hillsdale College via Conservative Broadcast
subject: Who rules whom?
body:
The Constitution of “We the People” is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | |
---
| | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/VEVPcyKXUiubMCVwg004tg~~/AARclBA~/-5Nfs98lcCnRGB_864kxbYmIBbsTHdhWz74_Eqn7R90x2TEZKAqAGhifeWbAbnyXUCpP4OIiLqoG6_RSLILvf-nBQ1GwNOXy9Ai_f5CxWLuM281NH3ryzjwt8b7wOvryVL5l20_u5Gs13mFWFMSGXsopKh3Eyd9eJwoRRg3vbIYfirIRI6ZXZc9ay4OgBm6MR0f6eB2ZonzENr5aWuHB-51Slwe7YcFHhJYAgBGdZq4miHD8bURP_VSigmkhhf9a0GDHcaBwE2vY_HvaF5bphDHw4tRS7IdauQ_BpGtNkLuhl1q5mJKSS9qWy-kzT71x)
---
| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/VEVPcyKXUiubMCVwg004tg~~/AARclBA~/-5Nfs98lcCnRGB_864kxbYmIBbsTHdhWz74_Eqn7R90x2TEZKAqAGhifeWbAbnyXUCpP4OIiLqoG6_RSLILvf-nBQ1GwNOXy9Ai_f5CxWLuM281NH3ryzjwt8b7wOvryVL5l20_u5Gs13mFWFMSGXsopKh3Eyd9eJwoRRg3vbIYfirIRI6ZXZc9ay4OgBm6MR0f6eB2ZonzENr5aWuHB-51Slwe7YcFHhJYAgBGdZq4miHD8bURP_VSigmkhhf9a0GDHcaBwE2vY_HvaF5bphDHw4tRS7IdauQ_BpGtNkLuhl1q5mJKSS9qWy-kzT71x).

Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/VEVPcyKXUiubMCVwg004tg~~/AARclBA~/-5Nfs98lcCnRGB_864kxbYmIBbsTHdhWz74_Eqn7R90x2TEZKAqAGhifeWbAbnyXUCpP4OIiLqoG6_RSLILvf-nBQ1GwNOXy9Ai_f5CxWLuM281NH3ryzjwt8b7wOvryVL5l20_u5Gs13mFWFMSGXsopKh3Eyd9eJwoRRg3vbIYfirIRI6ZXZc9ay4OgBm6MR0f6eB2ZonzENr5aWuHB-51Slwe7YcFHhJYAgBGdZq4miHD8bURP_VSigmkhhf9a0GDHcaBwE2vY_HvaF5bphDHw4tRS7IdauQ_BpGtNkLuhl1q5mJKSS9qWy-kzT71x)**

When you send in your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The rise of the administrative state is a grave threat to our country.

To counter this threat, Hillsdale sponsors several educational outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, programs on our Washington, D.C., campus, and a growing network of classical K-12 schools and homeschoolers--to teach citizens about the meaning of the Constitution and the importance of our founding principles of liberty.

Your gift of at least $15--or even $25, $35, $50, $100, or more if you're especially motivated to TAKE ACTION--will help us to expand these educational initiatives that are reaching and teaching millions.

Your support of these efforts is essential because Hillsdale refuses to take ONE PENNY of government funding.

So please complete your **National Referendum on the Administrative State** and consider giving your most generous tax-deductible contribution.

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

**P.S.** I look forward to receiving your opinions about what's happening in our nation. And I hope that you can support our work.

Records are meant to be broken, but at least one weather-related event is unlikely to be bested anytime soon: the biggest snowstorm in American history, [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=1krv9cfc68d8qj2ey6cn0zwwq0hzccm3t05gtw37i1zuaplu4rs4jujn8f3umonvhahgyjtsl8fevq503e40e5ywrxhj79jkhf0hzl5lkfbpkg99ifn570g1ojlk3lba4ae3pck40vpfapyjoshg57vt8&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqyc7l&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

# [The biggest blizzard in U.S. history saw nearly 5 feet of snow.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqyc7l&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Science & Industry](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqyc7l&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqyc7l&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| R ecords are meant to be broken, but at least one weather-related event is unlikely to be bested anytime soon: the biggest snowstorm in American history, which dumped nearly 5 feet of snow on the Northeastern U.S. The aptly named Great Blizzard of 1888, also known as the Great White Hurricane, occurred in New Jersey, New York, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, and Connecticut between March 11 and 14, and saw as much as [58 inches](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqyc7l&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) (4.8 feet) of snowfall. That was in Saratoga Springs, New York, while Bennington, Vermont, reported 48 inches and Middletown, Connecticut, received 50 inches.
---
By midnight on March 12, winds reached speeds of 50 miles per hour. Snowdrifts as high as 40 feet accumulated in the small town of Bangall, New York. Railways and telegraph lines shut down — [inspiring](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqyc7l&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) the creation of the first underground subway system — and people were stuck indoors for as long as a week. By the time it was over, at least 400 people had lost their lives and $25 million in damages (roughly $850 million today) had been caused. Among the victims was [Roscoe Conkling](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqyc7l&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), a powerful senator who represented New York from 1867 to 1881. He contracted pneumonia after attempting to walk 3 miles in New York City on March 12.

## Antarctica is the world’s largest desert.
Though we think of deserts as hot and sandy, the technical definition is simply a place with very little precipitation. That’s why the mighty Sahara, which reaches temperatures of 122 degrees Fahrenheit in the summer and covers an area of 3.6 million square miles, isn’t the largest desert on Earth. That superlative belongs to [Antarctica](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqyc7l&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), which is 5.5 million square miles and nearly the opposite of what springs to mind when thinking of deserts: It is very, very cold. Temperatures as low as -128.2 degrees Fahrenheit have been recorded there, and the ice is an average of 1.5 miles thick. But it isn’t snowy, and receives only about [2 inches](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqyc7l&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) of precipitation per year. That makes it one of the driest places on Earth, and certainly one of the most inhospitable — it has very little vegetation and is the only continent with no permanent human settlements.

| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0baba0e284ff4084b4870cdf50264d8c&_e=7fKpQuar5vw1mg9xV-1AgAmD9-oLU_ULpR0irmdJhUsoevTgxormVBrK1NX48YtlUBS2iyQcA5pXgUcfCSTB98XXjfe1-aD1TXbo2FUszMzQppTOx1-loNdJ40dowvz4BFYeFBCUDbHpsHYT43HavSfDD3fezWTLArveBDZvj4aJd0VcZS3e_O0YwluoxlLpBVBELGDxqqWohNRFi2SBSyoNwlwqoxWjuw7rVo95ktduSensi7FJzUNue60U3UF4JNxKw8CTYuA8DPONiNAYFkzgzwaFdtUXaOQeJGW8QwKrYsOGqHudAVOuZ0VfrPOpuyS1ogI_ISAs6h75uu6tUNIHtmsovoGaLYaqmTZtJQMUAuMdNTquliPLqYDgJD0aZO0wHu1W1x035XVQBdHcxmQqHk4qry9ECYMmpmyMkvU%3D).

Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0baba0e284ff4084b4870cdf50264d8c&_e=7fKpQuar5vw1mg9xV-1AgAmD9-oLU_ULpR0irmdJhUsoevTgxormVBrK1NX48YtlUBS2iyQcA5pXgUcfCSTB98XXjfe1-aD1TXbo2FUszMzQppTOx1-loNdJ40dowvz4BFYeFBCUDbHpsHYT43HavSfDD3fezWTLArveBDZvj4aJd0VcZS3e_O0YwluoxlLpBVBELGDxqqWohNRFi2SBSyoNwlwqoxWjuw7rVo95ktduSensi7FJzUNue60U3UF4LSh2r0CxB0uymn2A-Nh5k25D8MEHKVYUoSWVRxw4IEbvhNZq65pQMY-3AgSHJsPfWrDv5QUU5b7STNgpbBQw2su1awX1epxeLk4Y6WewaymZU6WX4roQoBoFYLz3uq194OKNvW7XTDNLVt6RwzDVbSMEOvf_Xe-0gk3WZiEqYTg%3D)**

When you send in your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The rise of the administrative state is a grave threat to our country.

To counter this threat, Hillsdale sponsors several educational outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, programs on our Washington, D.C., campus, and a growing network of classical K-12 schools and homeschoolers--to teach citizens about the meaning of the Constitution and the importance of our founding principles of liberty.

Your gift of at least $15--or even $25, $35, $50, $100, or more if you're especially motivated to TAKE ACTION--will help us to expand these educational initiatives that are reaching and teaching millions.

Your support of these efforts is essential because Hillsdale refuses to take ONE PENNY of government funding.

So please complete your **National Referendum on the Administrative State** and consider giving your most generous tax-deductible contribution.

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

**P.S.** I look forward to receiving your opinions about what's happening in our nation. And I hope that you can support our work.

So please complete the **National Referendum on the Administrative State** using this secure link:

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0baba0e284ff4084b4870cdf50264d8c&_e=7fKpQuar5vw1mg9xV-1AgAmD9-oLU_ULpR0irmdJhUsoevTgxormVBrK1NX48YtlUBS2iyQcA5pXgUcfCSTB98XXjfe1-aD1TXbo2FUszMzQppTOx1-loNdJ40dowvz4BFYeFBCUDbHpsHYT43HavSfDD3fezWTLArveBDZvj4aJd0VcZS3e_O0YwluoxlLpBVBELGDxqqWohNRFi2SBSyoNwlwqoxWjuw7rVo95ktduSensi7FJzUNue60U3UF4wHywMUNpP9-18OCZ-igt3iHoflTtYjMBeT1E6IE7ElOv2kSppgIHuv7vzFR4LuMdnUoOMzDea6H9r5pxMM2XmL7_9Q-ED0fc5zqUNhe-_Guu2GBlmVIKjS6ntWywMh9ORSW15THhbruNU9_VfmSp1xQrvfVUxuwjo2LZaw22fBQ%3D)**

As soon as you respond, we will begin your FREE lifetime subscription to _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's digest of liberty that you will receive via email ten times a year. If you'd like, you can also sign up to receive the publication through postal mail.

Educating millions about the Constitution to counter the threat from the administrative state is a monumental task. That's why when you complete your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your commitment to liberty.

subject: Our country is facing a constitutional crisis
body:
The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | |
---
| | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=08a95a49eb1942e8adedabf1f6d539ac&_e=xfHWN_TLFL9J9JRYVVqRq4KgK75x3_mEkgjOcRLEt4BsDMSnQfYHMg_VtxSe7Oy-gZiZ7lZndd2dMxyehZH6kDmFeWdGltVlIhRu8cHmaWL4qBQZMpDxzkWNPwGfeWZwLKW5y1_aHwR4kA8KNmKsZden-n78DamikkqQ-Hdouet4WAx6ZCfi7bbADPlA-tRsfYQZobPSsP-C-J3RmjpUPg9EI9LoA30CC2mmneoA0GzM4Ymp1DY69guBNyG2NZxhu89w3NjeLDq6sfQjBXxNE0aGVhdY2k6NwDFBAHavyc3enoAmJnt397jrycC0uqhQWD2Foeu0s0hMM_0pzxahW_jaeroaUFJ6-uTu7_hz3WxF79-F3DXRuMO_FIqx8aL97GDuPu2_h2x32lijyvhYUyZJGEJ663rhCgK33BiDUhw%3D)
---
| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=08a95a49eb1942e8adedabf1f6d539ac&_e=xfHWN_TLFL9J9JRYVVqRq4KgK75x3_mEkgjOcRLEt4BsDMSnQfYHMg_VtxSe7Oy-gZiZ7lZndd2dMxyehZH6kDmFeWdGltVlIhRu8cHmaWL4qBQZMpDxzkWNPwGfeWZwLKW5y1_aHwR4kA8KNmKsZden-n78DamikkqQ-Hdouet4WAx6ZCfi7bbADPlA-tRsfYQZobPSsP-C-J3RmjpUPg9EI9LoA30CC2mmneoA0GzM4Ymp1DY69guBNyG2NZxhjrNeBdtPRqDsv0FfbrkPmOcaJmwoOFjqaJDkTUwdZPpBQpwH36MwNEtk7hg-89lr0TYYXjPAZEZU8mA5DruTkfonhbKmQM-RFr566o1YzHEEYD_1n3g16dWsHa1mo6_4dQp5L9r2zVPMYQzuZTWmd1J9DmOdI5-M2eWnvx3El2c%3D).

Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=08a95a49eb1942e8adedabf1f6d539ac&_e=xfHWN_TLFL9J9JRYVVqRq4KgK75x3_mEkgjOcRLEt4BsDMSnQfYHMg_VtxSe7Oy-gZiZ7lZndd2dMxyehZH6kDmFeWdGltVlIhRu8cHmaWL4qBQZMpDxzkWNPwGfeWZwLKW5y1_aHwR4kA8KNmKsZden-n78DamikkqQ-Hdouet4WAx6ZCfi7bbADPlA-tRsfYQZobPSsP-C-J3RmjpUPg9EI9LoA30CC2mmneoA0GzM4Ymp1DY69guBNyG2NZxh-dfxE23u7MQO-SI_5UhY_1UDP8MlNWp_J3IttiJSjltbc8oCXqkRVFkSfUPuBeNyHoUuc828iF9FKvwZlVgg37H3RKnaBmdSBmnVMB51gIxBGntEBMou_z5A-gNGqfBjwsY2Vd7Qqz993XPhyPQbJKuTmtosV7nxHzMlNi5nmUw%3D)**

When you send in your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The rise of the administrative state is a grave threat to our country.

To counter this threat, Hillsdale sponsors several educational outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, programs on our Washington, D.C., campus, and a growing network of classical K-12 schools and homeschoolers--to teach citizens about the meaning of the Constitution and the importance of our founding principles of liberty.

Your gift of at least $15--or even $25, $35, $50, $100, or more if you're especially motivated to TAKE ACTION--will help us to expand these educational initiatives that are reaching and teaching millions.

Your support of these efforts is essential because Hillsdale refuses to take ONE PENNY of government funding.

So please complete your **National Referendum on the Administrative State** and consider giving your most generous tax-deductible contribution.

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

**P.S.** I look forward to receiving your opinions about what's happening in our nation. And I hope that you can support our work.

So please complete the **National Referendum on the Administrative State** using this secure link:

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=08a95a49eb1942e8adedabf1f6d539ac&_e=xfHWN_TLFL9J9JRYVVqRq4KgK75x3_mEkgjOcRLEt4BsDMSnQfYHMg_VtxSe7Oy-gZiZ7lZndd2dMxyehZH6kDmFeWdGltVlIhRu8cHmaWL4qBQZMpDxzkWNPwGfeWZwLKW5y1_aHwR4kA8KNmKsZden-n78DamikkqQ-Hdouet4WAx6ZCfi7bbADPlA-tRsfYQZobPSsP-C-J3RmjpUPg9EI9LoA30CC2mmneoA0GzM4Ymp1DY69guBNyG2NZxhuGvJZXyJlbciCIsUhg_Li7gZ7aV-k4Ac_wrNyI1_S_pYlEuOq-Rjmw-Z-DcUxr5LVtuYf92CfXKB3UXVVUCZ-cQiwh3eRxuqULzf88KraYUcyKPvN45Nsm4ly36iAJ7sQ1Bot8qm_rCK9RObdi_edo849FoV6RXg89V0RWTeF0c%3D)**

As soon as you respond, we will begin your FREE lifetime subscription to _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's digest of liberty that you will receive via email ten times a year. If you'd like, you can also sign up to receive the publication through postal mail.

Educating millions about the Constitution to counter the threat from the administrative state is a monumental task. That's why when you complete your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your commitment to liberty.
---
| | Hillsdale College 33 East College St Hillsdale, MI 49242 USA

Robert F. Kennedy Jr. **[called out Senator Bernie Sanders to his face](https://substack.com/redirect/edad9dc4-e77e-4b99-99d6-3065688523ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for being a Big Pharma hypocrite during his confirmation hearing to be President Donald Trump's HHS Director, Thursday.
The entire room cheered when RFK Jr said this, but Sanders was absolutely FURIOUS! "You were the single largest accepter of pharmaceutical dollars Bernie!!"
[](https://substack.com/redirect/edad9dc4-e77e-4b99-99d6-3065688523ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
RFK was forced to stand up for himself after Sanders pressed him to say he supports universal government healthcare for "every single American."
"I'm going to make America healthier than other countries in the world, right now we are the sickest!" Kennedy fired back.
**[Watch the heated moment here:](https://substack.com/redirect/edad9dc4-e77e-4b99-99d6-3065688523ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

# **Trump just TORCHED Pete Buttigieg during epic rant from the White House podium**
President Donald Trump responded to the tragic plane collision over the Potomac River wednesday evening with a Thursday press conference in which **[he criticized Biden's FFA diversity and inclusion hiring protocols,](https://substack.com/redirect/74bba615-6f3f-4d70-8012-693575e7c8ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** which he says make air travel less safe for Americans.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/74bba615-6f3f-4d70-8012-693575e7c8ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
He singled out Pete Buttigieg by name, Biden's former Secretary of transportation, for doing "a bad job" running the department.
"That guy is a real winner," Trump joked. "You know how badly every has run since he ran the Department of Transportation? He's a disaster. He was a disaster as a mayor, he ran his city into the ground."
"He's a disaster now. He's just got a good line of bullshit!" Trump continued to tear Buttigieg.
This well may be the first time a sitting president used light profanity from the White House podium to blast a political opponent, **[and America seemed to love it.](https://substack.com/redirect/74bba615-6f3f-4d70-8012-693575e7c8ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

# **Kash Patel SHUTS UP Democrat bully Adam Schiff for talking down to him during intense questioning**
Trump FBI Director pick Kash Patel **[went to war with Democrat Adam Schiff](https://substack.com/redirect/0e2ae611-16a3-4e8c-8fc8-6c293abc7ba1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** during his intense confirmation hearing, Thursday.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/0e2ae611-16a3-4e8c-8fc8-6c293abc7ba1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Schiff accused Patel of being anti-law enforcement for supporting January 6 prisoners being released from jail after he says they "assaulted" Capitol Police.
"There are Capitol Police officers behind you, turn around," Schiff commanded Patel.
"I'm looking at you, you are talking to me," Patel answered, refusing to play Schiff's game.
"Tell them you're proud of what you did Mr. Patel, they're right there! They're guarding you today," Schiff said, again pointing to the Capitol Police officers within the Senate hearing room.
"Thats a lie and you know it," Patel returned fire. "I have never ever accepted violence against law enforcement! How about you ask them if I have their backs?!"

name: Neil Parrott
subject: 4 Truths and a Lie
body:
The truth matters. This email contains 4 truths and a lie.Truth One: Early this week, I filed with the FEC to keep my campaign account open | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=03e5dc260e)
---
|
---
| | Peter,

The truth matters. This email contains 4 truths and a lie.

**_Truth One:_** Early this week, I filed with the FEC to keep my campaign account open for financial purposes. It's considered part of an "exploratory" campaign; I didn't make an announcement, and I didn't file to run with the Maryland Board of Elections.

**_Truth Two:_** Right away, April Delaney, used this FEC filing in a text yesterday to fundraise for a 2026 Congressional race. She owns houses totaling more than $25 Million, all outside of Maryland's 6th District, yet she is asking people for their money to fund her next campaign.

**_Truth Three:_** During the 2024 Congressional Campaign, Ms. Delaney spent 10s of thousands of dollars mailing voters, accusing me of lying about her and about my own record. SEE THE FLYER BELOW.

**THE LIE:** Delaney's October, 2024, campaign flyer claims that, "April McClain Delaney does not support boys playing in girls' sports or any of the other ridiculous claims that Neil Parrott is making."

**_TRUTH FOUR_** : Less than 2 weeks after she is sworn in, and less than 3 months since she sent the flyer pictured below, the new Congresswoman for Maryland's District 6, Delaney, VOTED AGAINST The Protection of Women and Girls In Sports Act. This act mandates that only biological women participate in women's sports.(1)

**_Character matters._** Ms. Delaney spent her millions slandering me in 2024. She does not appear to care about the truth, either during the campaign or now.

During one of her very first votes, she voted exactly the opposite of what she told her future constituents that she believed. Because this issue is contentious and extremely important to many in Garrett, Allegany, Washington, Frederick, and Montgomery Counties, people should know about her deception and double-talk.

---
| There is good news. With your help, we proved that Maryland's District 6 can be won in the right circumstances. This year, we came very close, and were one of the closest 50 races out of the 435 seats up for grabs in the country. (2)

No matter how you feel about biological males playing in women's sports, I think that everyone can agree: we should not have a dishonest politician representing Maryland's Congressional District 6, one who lies to their constituents, just to win an election.

I believe that character matters, and I believe that Delaney should be defeated in 2026.

Thanks for reading, and I hope that you have a great weekend.
Neil

(1) https://www.foxnews.com/politics/two-house-dems-join-gop-ban-biological-males-from-girls-school-sports
(2) https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/ng-interactive/2024/nov/14/us-house-senate-and-governor-elections-2024-results-from-all-50-states

Dear Friend,My husband saved the life of his fellow officer and now, on February 3rd, a Soros-funded prosecutor is going to try and lock him up for _11 years_.
Here is one of my favorite pictures of our two boys.

---
Now it makes me cry. As you can probably tell from my sons' costumes, my husband Brad is a proud U.S. Army veteran. He served two tours of duty in Iraq as a Cavalry Scout. And today he is also a decorated, 9-year veteran of the Las Cruces, New Mexico, police department. I'm used to my husband being in danger. But never in my wildest dreams did I think the biggest threat to Brad wouldn't come from a radical terrorist or a violent gangster... ...but from a _Soros-funded_ , _anti-police_ _prosecutor_. **[**That's why I'm writing you today as a last resort to ask if you'll help me fight for my husband.**](https://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkEGPmzAQRn-NuTmyZwyGA4etCL0kVRWh3aM12ENiyU4iMO3fr7Ld3nt9ehrN-z7O7kwxxfv1B2Xuy1rcurk5uMQpLPKxF1liZgcKaqm0RO2wCr2xELCpuNcWW0SrlKpufW29tfOiNWG7zA2FWrdBzwGMD6qtoYr9647SqDWazsCh0ZaBfNs2RnWEWhhFideyHcqNV37uc4qe7oUpH_wjV6m_lfLcBL4JGAWMG_t95QPdOTzKyxAwfn4uYIRWd2xUJ8MyszQL15KgBtnNHq03Nc2eBI57yW577KtngcO34bu8HN8FNC-cOcQ9CxyO5y_iKT8pXu8Ch78l0LnT8TSM7jR9nNzl-O5-vsnpMn35xQscpssk_3VXax-ev2NKcWusMOqaKabPtPKf4__q4U8AAAD__7Awhfc)** Our nightmare started the day my husband responded to a shoplifting call. When Brad arrived on the scene, right away he sensed something was off. And when he and his partner, Officer Keegan Arbogast, asked the suspect to identify himself, the suspect refused. So when Officer Arbogast saw a knife sitting on the suspect's lap, hidden under a water bottle, the officers moved to detain him. Instead of complying, the suspect got violent. Everything that happened next happened in an instant. As the officers tried to subdue him, the suspect went for Officer Arbogast's gun, trying to pull it from the holster. Then he lunged for Officer Arbogast's taser, yanked it free, and pointed it directly at him. In that moment, my husband had no choice -- it was the suspect's life or his partner's. He drew his pistol and fired, killing the suspect and saving Officer Arbogast's life. When one of Brad's coworkers called me to tell me there had been a shooting, I burst into tears. I didn't stop crying until Brad came home. I was so thankful he was safe. I knew he did what he had to do to protect his partner so they could both make it home to their families. And when an Internal Investigation _and_ the local District Attorney cleared my husband of any wrongdoing, I thought this awful episode was behind us. I couldn't have been more wrong. Because more than a year after the incident, the Attorney General of New Mexico charged my husband with Voluntary Manslaughter! When I heard about the charges, I was shocked. Then we did some digging -- and it all made sense. The New Mexico Attorney General is a rabid far-Left activist who _hates_ the police. He was funded by George Soros. And because my husband is white, and the suspect was black... ...this radical prosecutor is determined to make a name for himself by destroying my husband and dragging his name through the mud. He even held a press conference and turned the microphone over to the suspect's family so they could spread hateful lies about my husband, smearing him as a "racist" and a "cold-blooded killer." **Make no mistake -- these charges are a slap in the face to every brave man and woman who has ever put on the badge.** Now you can see why I'm so heartbroken and furious. My husband is an honorable man who wanted nothing more than to serve his country and his community. That's why he served for 3 years in the Army as a cavalry scout. And it's why he served for 10 years as a police officer. But more than that, he's a wonderful husband and an incredible father to our 9- and 6-year-old boys. We've tried to explain to our boys as best we can about what's going on. But they're too young to fully understand. And I can't bear to think of what it will do to them if one day, Daddy is taken away and they're forced to grow up with their father behind bars. But unless people like you speak up to defend my husband against these disgusting Soros-funded political attacks... ...Brad will miss 11 years of birthdays, wedding anniversaries, and Little League games. As I mentioned earlier, Brad's trial starts in just days and already, the legal bills have become overwhelming for our family. Thank God, we got a call from Jason Johnson. Jason is a retired police officer -- and he's the President of the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Brad. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent officers -- and their families -- when it seemed like there was no hope left. And with the thought of losing my husband and trying to suddenly raise my two boys on my own -- I was certainly hopeless. Not only did LELDF decide to help my husband get the legal defense he deserves, they're also raising money to pay for the best lawyers and expert witnesses available. But it’s only because of the support of brave patriots like yourself. Jason and LELDF were an answer to prayer for our family. That's because Brad and I aren't wealthy people. subject: I’m heartbroken about the aviation disaster in D.C. this week.

body:
Friends, I’m heartbroken about the aviation disaster near D.C.’s Washington National Airport that occurred late Wednesday evening.
Anne and I continue to pray for all those impacted, particularly the families of those on board AA Flight 5342, of the dedicated crew members, and of the servicemembers on board the Army helicopter. Sixty-seven lives cut tragically short, and countless loved ones grieving — our hearts are with you all.
I’m deeply grateful for the work of our first responders, as hundreds from D.C., Virginia, and Maryland arrived on the scene quickly and came together to respond as best they could.
We’re continuing to gather more information from local officials, the FAA, and the Army, and I can assure you I will be pushing for a thorough investigation into what happened.
I will update you as we learn more.
Sincerely,
Tim

| | Dear Fellow Believer, It may seem a little early to be talking about Easter, but it's really only about 12 weeks away.And in that short amount of time, my friends at Brave Books are spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate......to Jesus.And this revival mission needs you! My friend, if you've seen me talking about Brave Books on Fox News, you know their mission is to counter the ungodly lies being pushed by the Left in schools, libraries, and Hollywood......by creating high-quality, wholesome, and Godly books and entertainment that instill conservative values and Gospel lessons in our children. And their "Prepare the Way" revival campaign is their biggest effort yet to point parents and children to the empty tomb and God’s redeeming love.Here’s exactly what their strategy is...First... Brave Books knows that families need an easy and impactful way to counter the Left's secularization of Easter and instead, captivate children with its true meaning. So, they created _Saving the Easter Bunny_ , a brand-new children's book that's destined to be a classic.In it, Ronnie the Rabbit learns the hard way what sin is and that our Lord Jesus Christ loves us so much that he took the punishment for that sin.Jesus is represented by a powerful lion named Lord Joshua and the book beautifully portrays his resurrection and God's never-ending redeeming love for us. It's incredible.And let me tell you, parents are hungry for content like this because everywhere they turn godlessness is being pushed by schools, left-wing publishers like Scholastic, and Hollywood. When Brave Books first introduced a God-centered Christmas game called "_Mouse in the House_ ," to counter the secular elf game that has become so popular -- it sold out in THREE HOURS!That's why step one of Brave Books' 12-week "Prepare the Way" revival, is ramping up the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ big-time. **[And today I'm hoping you'll help them kick it into high gear before orders start pouring in by rushing back your best "Prepare the Way" gift.](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=b72704da9bf147669d0f399cec99521b&_e=dddvtl8_gagxlMtMU2-YgkS-BwHgvpCHhvIulVdtIbEwQaar1mk-IFsE-g2rejBZ_qSwtCjsyvH5gDcGoTObBmqofl5zIFQOXCGw-6j4JIw2b-nZVA3mYxZo5njocdxznMDzpcbNsbtndZjF9kVEcjBwHAUC9AEH1dlRlP6hsQYTurBdOMKGf6XlE7HcwuOKG0NCpcHxv5NvfsO4jRFi4McXA5htYVcaqnsRAD10rJkh4s8JQYxSZ2PARXTMlwNSPmgyVCWHGc0Qe4sJ-iQ-mCcR67F-4LFKXJQk_mPcuXEcviLmkXiTRHNTRk8DDzTGVgymyvZ-7DJAeohR8JnPT08SIuK4tghoAJKvERoxXjdXwXV6aqdVRBOiNG4m571v)** No family should go without this wonderful book because of overwhelming demand. Second... Recognizing that families who want to raise their children with wholesome Christian values often feel alone in their mission...Brave Books is launching a 17-city traveling church tour that starts in Ponta Vedra Beach, Florida and ends in Laurel, Mississippi. I'll be leading the tour in every city as we prepare our hearts and our families for Easter through prayer, worship, music, and just some good old-fashioned conversation about raising Godly children in our godless culture.Our church tour aims to ignite a spirit of revival in thousands of families this Easter season and I can't wait to see what God makes of that! But getting our worship teams, musicians, and all the rest to 17 different cities for thousands of families to enjoy won't be easy and it won't be inexpensive.But I know we can do it.Brave Books is a small Christian company founded by a doctor named Trent Talbot. After having his first child, he saw how the Left was using books and entertainment to turn the hearts and minds of America's children away from God. And so he decided to take action and with the help of believers just like you, look at what they've already done:

Armed with Brave Books' "See You at the Library" kits, thousands of parents, grandparents, children, and concerned citizens have gathered at over 360 libraries in 49 states to take back our libraries.>>> Created an historic TV show called "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" to fight the ungodly lessons coming out of Hollywood. It's our modern day "Mr. Rogers' Neighborhood" funded by everyday Americans who want to return American culture to God. "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" uses humor and storytelling to reinforce the traditional biblical values that have made America great.>>> And now you are crucial to the success and failure of our "Prepare the Way" revival campaign which features the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ and a 17-city church tour.

body:
A strong Democratic Party has never been so important
# [](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/2780?t=1&akid=328%2E2563979%2E8OKn7G)

$5.
That is the donation I am asking you to make to the Democratic National Committee before their first official FEC fundraising deadline since Trump and the new Congress took office comes to a close.
If you agree that it has never been more important that we have a strong Democratic Party and are ready to give, do it here before midnight:
[**https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/dnc-donate**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc?refcode=em250131&refcode2=328_2563979_8OKn7G&akid=328%2E2563979%2E8OKn7G)
Otherwise, let me expand on why this request is so important.
We raised a historic amount of donations from regular folks chipping in a few bucks when they could. It is both humbling and heartbreaking because we did not get the result we both wanted.
But there were a number of important races we did help win because of the organization we built and the voters we turned out. There are Democratic Senators who may not have been elected, and Republicans only have the slimmest of House majorities because of our work.
That means we have a chance to stop bad legislation in the next two years and flip those chambers in the next election -- and a strong Democratic National Committee will be at the front of that effort.
So $5. That's the donation I am asking you to make to the DNC before their midnight deadline:
$5 to protect the Affordable Care Act, Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid.
$5 to help Democrats win the next round of elections.
$5 before this FEC deadline ends at midnight -- because it will take all of us staying in this fight to get it done.
[**Please use this link to contribute $5, or whatever you can afford today, directly to the Democratic National Committee. We have never needed a strong Democratic Party more than we need it today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc?refcode=em250131&refcode2=328_2563979_8OKn7G&akid=328%2E2563979%2E8OKn7G)

Hi Peter,

If we haven’t met, my name is Madison Horn.

In 2024, I ran to represent Oklahoma’s 5th Congressional District. I think it’s important to share a bit about that experience with you today:

When I first connected with Her Bold Move, I had already reached out to nearly every major women’s organization in the country. I was running for office in Oklahoma — a state ranked as the worst place in the US for women, with the strictest abortion laws and a staggering **_50% of women experiencing rape or domestic violence in their lifetime._** Despite this dire reality, my candidacy as a woman seeking to become the most credentialed cybersecurity lawmaker in Congress received little to no support.
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101300312/525532017/1701071684?refcode=EM_F_250131Horn_N_MH_NO_11_G_N_P1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjgzODgwMDBjLWU0ZGYtZWYxMS04OGY4LTAwMjI0ODJhOTdlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=akZskPiUr0CLBlJVs2BS4VOkq_O7Dn3BcTx7WpKQrfc=)
---
It was disheartening. These were organizations with bold mission statements about empowering women. Yet, when faced with a challenging race, the response was silence (or, even worse, excuses like, _“Your race is too difficult”_). Time and again, I was left wondering: If the most well-funded organizations won’t stand by their missions, what is their purpose? If women are to step into leadership, we must step into the arena together, no matter the odds.

That’s why, **when I received the news that Her Bold Move was endorsing me, I was nearly brought to tears. It wasn’t just about the endorsement. It was about an organization that believed women in Oklahoma — no matter how uphill the battle — were worth fighting for.** It was about an organization willing to live its mission and declare, loudly and clearly: We are in this fight with you. Even knowing the odds, they chose to stand boldly and take action.

[**Before I share more, will you join me in supporting them by pitching in $20.25 or more today so they can continue to support candidates running for office this year and beyond?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101300314/525532018/1701071684?refcode=EM_F_250131Horn_N_MH_NO_11_G_N_L1&amount=20.25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjgzODgwMDBjLWU0ZGYtZWYxMS04OGY4LTAwMjI0ODJhOTdlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=akZskPiUr0CLBlJVs2BS4VOkq_O7Dn3BcTx7WpKQrfc=)

What happened next left me even more in awe. **The day after my endorsement, four different resources from Her Bold Move reached out to offer media support, social media strategy, volunteer assistance, and seasoned advisors.** I couldn’t believe it. For the first time, I felt like I wasn’t on an island shouting into the void about the harsh realities in Oklahoma. **Her Bold Move didn’t just endorse me;_they joined my fight,_ shoulder to shoulder.**

Their commitment went beyond words or symbolic gestures. **In a state where the status quo means accepting the highest rates of rape and domestic violence in the country, Her Bold Move rejected complacency.** They took a stand knowing this might not be a seat to win this time. They chose bold action over safe bets, proving that their mission wasn’t just rhetoric – it was a promise to women across America.

**_Her Bold Move’s support was a lifeline for me_ , and it reignited my belief that change is possible when we act with courage and conviction. They’ve shown that, to create a better future, we must take bold steps today. Even in the face of what seem like impossible odds.**

To anyone seeking an example of what it means to truly support women, look no further than Her Bold Move. They are more than an organization; they are a movement — and one that I will forever be grateful for.

Friends,
The State Freedom Caucus Network has grown rapidly over the last three years, so we thought it would be a good idea to introduce ourselves to all our new supporters and followers. If you missed our last six emails, we did a short Q&A with:
1. [Network President Andy Roth](https://substack.com/redirect/f4d36929-c0d7-4885-b069-fbda14cc716e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
2. [Senior Vice President Justin Ouimette](https://substack.com/redirect/da7ccb54-eef2-4990-bf0c-603d89f3db4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
3. [VP of Development Dana Craycroft and Sr. Development Director Sara Prinzi](https://substack.com/redirect/22ec9673-1471-4638-b4db-cce7e2346a89?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
4. [VP of Government Affairs Cesar Ybarra](https://substack.com/redirect/499f1c71-415d-49b8-9472-5641f72dc3e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
5. [State Directors Connie Hair (LA) and Nathan Dahm (OK)](https://substack.com/redirect/79b80fa5-bae8-452b-9454-a8539e753e27?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
6. [State Directors Collin Moseley (IL) and Tim Jones (MO)](https://substack.com/redirect/afb7f996-21f4-483c-b67d-3b4dde5c2c9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

This week are two more of our amazing state directors representing Wyoming (**Jessie Rubino**) and Montana (**Darin Gaub**).
Two interesting facts about them - Jessie and her husband love to cook all of their meals - 100% of the time. Darin is a self-described "230-pound gym rat" whose favorite pet is a kitten - and who loves nerdy sci-fi shows like Firefly. Enjoy!
* * *
**JESSIE RUBINO**
**What is your role at SFCN?** I serve as the State Director for Wyoming-- the greatest state in the Union.
**Where are you from originally? Where do you live now?** I was born and raised in Cheyenne, Wyoming, and grew up listening to Rush Limbaugh any time my family hopped in the car for any length of time. After spending some time in Laramie at the University of Wyoming, I now live a few blocks from the home I was raised in.
**Tell us about your family! And pets!** My family is everything to me! I come from very patriotic roots, with two brothers slipping the surly bonds of Earth as pilots in the United States Air Force. I married into an equally patriotic family and met my husband during college. We connected over a cup of coffee and a deep-dive into state politics, and there was no turning back. We welcomed our daughter, Ruth, last July. She loves farm animals, puddles, and spaghetti.
**What's the best part of your job?** We often say that Wyoming is the last best place on Earth, and it's not because of our breathtaking landscapes and wide open spaces (although those things are a plus). The people of Wyoming are truly special, and the men and women of the Wyoming Freedom Caucus are no exception. I am blessed to work every day with people who cherish our founding principles, who love our country and our state, and who are downright funny. The WYFC members embody the very best of what it means to have a citizen legislature.
**How did you come to SFCN? What did you do before?** After a few years in the conservative grassroots world of Wyoming politics, I became close with what became a few founding members of the WYFC. I am so grateful that when these members decided to join the State Freedom Caucus Network, they recommended me as a potential State Director. I love my job! Before this role, I was a high school American history teacher.
**Who or what most shaped your political philosophy/ideology?** My amazing parents most shaped by political ideology, without a doubt. I was raised in a normal American household that valued our nation's heritage. This naturally lent itself to me developing a liberty-minded conservative political ideology.
***Pick One To Answer*: Favorite food? Favorite place to vacation? Favorite Book? Favorite Quote?** My favorite food is french fries, but only cooked in beef tallow. We're on the MAHA train at the Rubino house. No seed oils allowed!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/082ec956-c49b-4cdb-ae97-284cd3d3ab15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
**DARIN GAUB**
**What is your role at SFCN?** I'm the SFCN's State Director for Montana. I track legislation, communicate regularly with the caucus members about strategies, and help bring media attention to our efforts.
**Where are you from originally? Where do you live now?** Montana, our family is one of those that arrived to the territory before it was a state.
**Tell us about your family! And pets!** We are a military family. We've lived all over the country and traveled the world. For most of that travel, I was not with my family, and it was not to vacation destinations. Our two grown children have the typical trouble answering where they are from, so they say Montana because it's our generational home state and where they were born. Fortunately, one kid lives in Montana while the other enjoys the desert Southwest and can still make it home quickly.
**What's the best part of your job?** I'm a fighter. After decades of military service, I knew I couldn't just hang up my spurs and watch the world go around, so I sought out service opportunities and found them all over. This position keeps me in the Montana Capitol, where I can continue fighting for liberty while serving in other capacities nationally and worldwide. It also allows me to continue to appear on national news media outlets 4-5 times per week and write for two national media outlets and The Montana Sentinel.
**How did you come to SFCN? What did you do before?** I was at home living the life of a retired military officer when a text came asking me if I'd be the director for something called the Freedom Caucus. Once I found out who from Montana would form the caucus, I jumped in feet first to the point that I was notified and hired in less than a week and started the session right away. Drinking from a fire hose is a hobby of mine.
**Who or what most shaped your political philosophy/ideology?** My faith. Political philosophies are malleable if not grounded in faith in something bigger than us. As a minister mostly in Southern Baptist Churches over the years, I have made it a habit to bring that faith into the political sphere to help influence the trajectory of a nation.
***Pick One To Answer*: Favorite food? Favorite place to vacation? Favorite Book? Favorite Quote.** In addition to the fact that I live in Montana and consider myself to be on vacation all the time just by living in such a gorgeous state, my favorite place to disappear is the mountains around West Yellowstone, MT, and Island Park, ID in the winter. It's the snowmobile capital of the world, and I love getting out in the powder.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f43be214-78e5-4971-b146-62f06c2762d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

**Keep fighting,**

_Andrew Roth
President
State Freedom Caucus Network_
P.S. Your help is critical in building out a network of patriots and freedom fighters throughout our nation's state capitols and in your home state. (Donald Trump/Facebook)
By Illinois Review

Outgoing Illinois Republican State Sen. Dan McConchie, 26th Dist., who wrote a scathing opinion piece in the Chicago Sun-Times accusing President Donald Trump of inciting “violence” and “sedition” on January 6th – has issued a strong endorsement for his replacement – backing the GOP state party chairwoman’s son – citing his “loyalty” as one of his qualifications to lead the Senate district.

In a January 7, 2021 OpEd in the Chicago Sun-Times, McConchie wrote,

“I have never before had to question whether my president was inciting violence or sedition...This riotous activity could understandably cause an instinctual reaction to abandon the party claimed by the president and the people who put him in the position to abuse his power and encourage this chaos.”

McConchie then praised the IL GOP for its commitment to rooting out corruption, writing,

“Here in Illinois, the GOP is centered around rooting out the corruption that festers in the halls of our government and restoring the public’s faith in our representative democracy. It is this shared value system and dedication that will be the cornerstone of our renewal.”

body:
#

Friends -
Today, we hope you’ll allow us to share five reasons why your $5 contribution to GIFFORDS PAC is so important.
1. **President Trump is actively working to roll back our gun safety progress.** Soon after Trump took office, the Office of Gun Violence Prevention page on the White House website was taken down—seemingly shuttering this critical effort to keep our communities safe from gun violence. We must work together to get this important office reinstated.

2. **MAGA Republicans in the House of Representatives have already introduced legislation peddling the gun lobby’s “guns everywhere” agenda.** Extremists like Lauren Boebert are backing legislation pushing for concealed carry, permitless carry, and the abolishment of the ATF, the lead agency charged with tracking gun violence and keeping our communities safe.

3. **President Trump has picked a dangerous nominee to serve as FBI Director.** Kash Patel is a known conspiracy theorist who is a Trump and gun lobby loyalist. His confirmation would be a detriment to public safety, and we are working hard to urge Senators to vote “no” on Patel.

4. **Regardless of what some of our extreme elected officials may think, the majority of Americans support stronger gun laws.** All of us have a role to play in ensuring that our new leaders listen to the American people and support legislation that will keep us safe from gun violence.

5. **Tonight, we’re facing our very first end-of-month fundraising deadline of 2025.** This is our last chance to reach our January fundraising goals so we can have a strong start to the year.

Our gun violence prevention movement is at a crossroads, and we hope we can count on you to make a contribution today at a time when we need you most.

name: Congressman Jake Auchincloss
subject: Fighting back against Trump's dangerous appointees
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Massachusetts Democratic State Committee
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Hi Peter- [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/12d47ffe-7a64-42e5-ba84-e6e65556fae1.jpeg]
It’s Congressman Jake Auchincloss. President Trump has been in office for two weeks. He’s made plain his priorities:
* It’s not law & order. Instead of regulating glock switches or ghost guns, he pardoned J6 rioters who tased police officers in the neck – and bragged about it.
* It’s not the cost of living. Instead of taking bold action on housing or healthcare, he has focused on feathering the nests of billionaire tech oligarchs.
* It’s not a stronger America. Instead of getting tough on China and Russia, he has bullied... Panama.
This term, a volatile president + tight margins in Congress = reality TV.
Democrats have been here before. We know the antics, and we're going to stay disciplined.
We’re not going to chase Trump through the news cycle, we’re going to drive home the point that he is too corrupt to be trusted and that we can be counted on to put everyday Americans first.
Right now, I’m battling an immediate threat to our children’s health: Trump’s pick for HHS Secretary, RFK Jr. He is a conspiracist and quack whose 2019 anti-vax campaign in Samoa derailed its measles vaccination efforts, leading to the death of dozens of Samoan children. He called it a “natural experiment.”
RFK Jr. has previously said that “no vaccine is safe and effective,” and his top legal aide petitioned the FDA to revoke the polio vaccine.
RFK Jr. would have tremendous influence over the childhood vaccination schedule in the United States. His confirmation risks bringing back childhood diseases that America has consigned to history books.
Democrats must stay focused on the issues that matter: protecting public health, lowering costs for families, supporting the rule of law, and defending national security.
Where Donald Trump has sound ideas on these issues, we'll work with him.
When he's dangerously wrong, we'll fight back.
We know for whom we’re working.
Jake

I know my team and I have reached out about deadlines like this before, but we could really use your help.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1476%2E791427%2ED-2gct)

**June 5, 2018.**
Do you remember it? I'll never forget it — that was the day we launched our first campaign for Congress. The truth is, I had no idea what to expect.
I knew we had a large number of supporters who would be willing to commit the time and hard work needed to run a campaign of that magnitude, but I also knew that one of the biggest challenges we'd face would be funding a winning campaign.
But because of supporters like you, that was never in doubt. We were able to organize and mobilize our movement in Minnesota's 5th district, fighting off unprecedented right-wing attacks and outside spending along the way.
Two years later in 2020 we did it again. And again in 2022 and 2024.
**Midnight tonight.**
Just a few hours from now — our first end-of-month deadline in 2025 and our first with Trump back in the White House.
I know my team and I have reached out about deadlines like this before, but it’s really important that we have a big show of momentum this month.
People are wondering if progressives are up to the task of standing against Trump and his far-right agenda, meaning if we fall short we’ll send all the wrong messages about the strength of this movement.
**$3.**
That's the amount I'm asking you to contribute right now to stand with our movement, close our fundraising gap, and get the job done.
Are you in?

On January 29th, America witnessed its first mid-air aviation disaster in 16 years. An Army Black Hawk helicopter and an American Airlines plane collided in the air near Washington, D.C.'s Reagan National Airport. There are at least 67 reported deaths, and no survivors. Families are mourning the lives lost in this horrific tragedy, and instead of offering accountability and leadership, Donald Trump immediately blamed _diversity_.
This is what happens when ideology replaces expertise. And if history is any guide, this may not be the last such tragedy as Republicans insist on devaluing human life at the altar of deregulation--an injustice corporate media rarely addresses. But we will.
**Let 's Address This.**

Authorities at the site of the worst mid air collision in the USA in 16 years.
## The Republican Religion: Deregulation
For decades, Republicans have preached the gospel of deregulation, telling the American people that government oversight is the enemy. And every time they gut critical safety measures, disaster follows:
* **GOP deregulated the mortgage industry** -> Housing market collapse
* **GOP deregulated the banking industry** -> Banks failed
* **GOP deregulated the railroad industry** -> Trains derailed
* **GOP deregulated the food industry** -> Fatal food poisoning outbreaks
* **GOP deregulated the aviation industry** -> Planes crash, and people die

To be fair, corporate Democrats joined the GOP in deregulating the banking industry in the 1990s, leading to the eventual collapse. However, after Obama enacted banking reforms during his term, Trump and MAGA Republicans again deregulated banks during Trump's first term--leading to another near banking collapse in SVB.
And granted, we are awaiting the official report on this FAA disaster. But that's what makes Trump's condemnation of diversity as the absolute cause of this tragedy that much more bizarre--especially when all signs point to his own reckless decisions to deregulate the FAA even during his first term as contributing factors. For example, in 2017 Trump issued Executive Order 13,771, which mandated that for every new regulatory rule enacted, a federal agency (such as the FAA) would need to repeal two regulations.1
As a result, scholars at the American Bar Association analyzed the data a year later and found that the unfortunate impact of this Trump rule was that while the FAA is, "_an agency whose every rule is meant to increase transportation safety,_ " that as a result of Trump's deregulatory orders, "_The FAA may be avoiding any new rulemaking that would have to be justified under the new regulatory mandate_." I am horrified that the FAA feels restricted from making new rules to keep us safe, yet this is what Trump's deregulation rules have enforced.
## **The FAA Was Sabotaged in Real Time**
The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) exists to keep air travel safe. It ensures planes are maintained, air traffic controllers are trained and staffed, and flight systems operate with maximum safety standards. And yet, in his first _nine days in office_ , Trump deliberately dismantled key safety measures within the FAA. Here's the timeline:
* **January 20** : FAA Administrator Michael Whitaker was forced to step down after Elon Musk pressured him to resign for fining SpaceX over regulatory violations.
* **January 21** : Trump enacted a hiring freeze on air traffic controllers, despite an ongoing shortage, putting all travelers in unnecessary and preventable danger.
* **January 22** : The FAA's Aviation Safety Advisory Committee was _disbanded_ --Trump claimed this would "make flying safer." (More about this below).
* **January 28** : Trump administration issues directive to arbitrarily force out FAA employees (wrongly reported by corporate media as a 'buyout'), gutting experienced professionals, with no plan for replacement or analysis on whether such roles can safely be eliminated.
* **January 29** : America suffers its first fatal mid-air collision in 16 years. Every person involved in this tragic collision dies.

Let's be clear--this is not an accident. This is what happens when you remove trained professionals, cut safety oversight, and let billionaires dictate policy. The FAA is running on fumes because Trump and his enablers _made it that way_. And worse, rather than take any responsibility, Trump is blaming Black, brown, and disabled people, and doing what he does best--lie.

## **Trump 's Lies and Blame Game**
Instead of addressing the direct role his policies played in this disaster, Trump did what he always does--blamed Black and brown people.
When asked how he knew "diversity" was to blame for the crash, Trump responded:
_"Because I have common sense, OK? And unfortunately, a lot of people don 't."_
This is not leadership. It's racism. And it's a deliberate attempt to mislead the public. As I've [written before](https://substack.com/redirect/a508fb1e-d8e8-4211-8f82-439602f8ea69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), _actual_ common sense demonstrates that across industries diversity increases productivity, increases performance, increases profit, and increases safety and security. But Trump's hypocritical and racist stance is how he operates in every aspect of his life. Consider that while he sends ICE after Latino Americans to arrest and deport them, he has never once sent ICE into white majority schools, even though we know there are at least half a million undocumented mostly white Canadian and European immigrants in the United States right now.2 While he lifts sanctions on extremist Israeli settlers who are instigating actual mass violence and terrorism against Palestinian civilians in the West Bank,3 he's stripping visas from students who dared march peacefully within First Amendment protections for Palestinian liberation.4
And now, while he himself deregulates the FAA, he blames anything that goes wrong on Black and brown and disabled people. Never mind that the helicopter pilot, the airplane pilot, and the former FAA head were all able bodied white males. Never mind that air traffic staffing was reportedly "not normal" due to ongoing staffing shortages5 (even despite which Trump is trying to further shrink the size of the FAA). The racism and ableism is nauseating. Trump's executive order, issued just days before the crash, baselessly claimed that the FAA had been hiring people with "severe intellectual disabilities, psychiatric issues, and complete paralysis" due to DEI initiatives.6 There is no evidence of this. None. But it doesn't matter--Trump knows his base will believe whatever he tells them, no matter how absurd.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/73a71766-acc9-4b31-b1c9-dc78fcfd8c19?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Trump boasted just a week before the fatal crash that his Executive Order ending DEI would "restore excellence and safety within the FAA."
Former Secretary of Transportation Pete Buttigieg responded to Trump's grotesque comments, stating:
> Despicable. As families grieve, Trump should be leading, not lying. We put safety first, drove down close calls, grew Air Traffic Control, and had zero commercial airline crash fatalities out of millions of flights on our watch. President Trump now oversees the military and the FAA. One of his first acts was to fire and suspend some of the key personnel who helped keep our skies safe. Time for the President to show actual leadership and explain what he will do to prevent this from happening again.
I doubt Trump has the integrity to do any of those things. But speaking of DEIA and American Airlines, American Airlines ended its DEIA program in December after Stephen Miller's legal group threatened lawsuits. The idea that DEIA had _anything_ to do with this crash is a blatant lie designed to shift attention from the very real damage Trump has already done. Consider the absurdity that Trump himself issued Executive Orders to deregulate the airline industry, and then as standards fall, he blames the airlines for operating on lower standards.

## **The Cost of Deregulation Is Human Life**
This is bigger than partisan politics. The families mourning tonight come from all walks of life, all political backgrounds--but they are all Americans, and most importantly, they are human beings first. We should be demanding answers, demanding accountability, and demanding the restoration of safety regulations that protect _all of us_ when we travel.
Trump's recklessness has already killed Americans. And if this is just a preview of what's to come, then we must _stand united_ to ensure his incompetence doesn't claim even more lives. We cannot let these culture wars distract us from the truth--this is about class, about power, and about a government that is being weaponized against its own people.
We deserve better. Let's demand it.

your early investment in victory
Fellow Patriot, I officially became NRSC Chairman a couple of weeks ago.

**_[The goal for my first month is simple: Make this our best January ever.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=74ed296a0095418d98d3814fe6961c52&_e=Gh8YAfxFhtBfDczbHMLNNUTKe40H-OHgk7fgvJv1PznQIOsb_Ask4wL2IHFuodxTj5_i9EUN4riS1Uais4Z73NrNUH8YUlRcq_cb82Z2FlQW22ZIwPCYn4uzrDSwBErjt63m9GXvTe0TdchlJb0DDd6GrThOEDEfVgy686pqrzdgeQwZqGnDNUZnYIQ9Nb0pBbpoMo1f6FDAi4wM2EnTjnx0KXqNAwnLU5imJxjXjNfuSFOzqllb8U2EZr-gwdYZ929wvyraIED6swLVd3HKJmOQp5SOJItgobZaIB8pNkbcVcBMDzFEEMwO9zanO5T0sdK7HTyf8QpsMH1RIdZVJlzIAhqZ4osXmd9J-ouyLHtuaZt3vuwNl6wRByjWuVy2Ba52UVZP615Pf_65_OrvGsK2nYK6YQx4l7AMrR-U7epR5g5oS4hY090btnpeWG8nPrGcKYlji6eE_uprM1jSBA%3D%3D)_**
