Truthout: Republicans Plan to Revive Legislative Attacks on Voting Rights [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=013125_1&amount=25]
This is the consequence of opponents of voting rights controlling both houses of Congress and the White House, folks:
A key House lawmaker made clear in an interview that the vote suppressors plan to push for a pair of their voting-related bills when they take control of both chambers of Congress and the White House this month. They plan to bring forward both the American Confidence in Elections (ACE) Act and the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act.
“ As we look to the new year with unified Republican government, we have a real opportunity to move these pieces of legislation not only out of committee, but across the House floor and into law, ” he said.
The ACE ACT " would nationalize harmful and unnecessary restrictions on voting rights, " while the SAVE Act -- which narrowly passed the House in 2024 and was stopped in the Senate -- requires proof of U.S. citizenship to vote in federal elections, which is something you already need, since non-citizen voting is illegal, and adds onerous verification requirements intended to drive off eligible voters.

subject: We’re facing a defining moment

body:
Jason Crow For Congress [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88523/images/logoJC%20(1).png]
Team,

Right now, Colorado — and our entire country — is facing a defining moment.

Extremists like Donald Trump are working to divide us and undermine the very foundation of our democracy. They want to help the rich get richer and close the doors to freedom and opportunity that have made America a beacon of hope for centuries.

Those aren’t the American values I believe in.

This moment isn’t just about resisting extremism, it’s about fighting for a positive vision for our future. The America I’m fighting for is one where everyone has a fair shot to work hard and get ahead, where our differences make us stronger, and where we build a better tomorrow together — because that’s what Coloradans do.

I’m committed to continuing the fight for these values, but I need you with me. Our first monthly fundraising deadline of the year is tonight , and what we raise now will determine the strength of our campaign in the months ahead.

Will you pitch in today to support my campaign and help fight for Colorado’s future? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc-em-jan25]

Exciting Announcement Feb 1st
Good morning, all! We have some exciting news to share– around **11:00 AM on February 1st** , I’ll be making a major announcement on my podcast, _Independent is Power_. _**I will be launching an exploratory committee to evaluate a potential run for governor in 2026.**_ An exploratory committee allows us to assess the level of support for a campaign and lay the groundwork for a strong start. This means that if we decide to move forward, we’ll be ready to hit the ground running once a formal announcement is made.
**There are many things that led me to this decision** , but one of the biggest is my strong dislike of our current governor. His partisan handling of the recent elections—blocking independent and third-party candidates in direct violation of state law—was the final straw. Additionally, a poll we conducted last year showed that when asked which office I should run for next, the top choice was... governor. During this exploratory phase, we will also determine the best path forward for our campaign, including which party to run under. Right now, I am favoring running as an Independent constitutional conservative, while leaving open the possibility of running under the GOP banner later. With so many Minnesotans not identifying with either major party, running as an Independent could give us a unique opportunity to win their support and stand out in what will likely be a crowded GOP field.
**Given my experience running outside the two-party system in a major race before—and earning a respectable showing—we are in a strong position.** Both major parties and the media will have to take our campaign seriously, especially if we can make an impact on the race early on. This is where my thoughts are currently, but I’d love to hear from you! As always, I welcome your questions and comments—and I hope you’ll tune in to tomorrow's episode of _Independent is Power_ where I will answer your questions!

| In Liberty,

body:

We’re coming up on the end of January, and with less than two weeks in office under his belt, Donald Trump has shown us who his presidency will benefit: robber barons, corporate bosses, and the criminals who stormed our Capitol.

Trump prioritized corporate billionaires at his inauguration and promised them big tax handouts by cutting Medicare and Social Security, all while doing nothing to lower costs for the rest of us.

He made one of his first actions as president to pardon the criminals who stormed the Capitol on January 6, 2021, a slap in the face to law enforcement who put their lives on the line that day.

He tried to slash critical funding for public safety, hospitals, veterans’ services, medical facilities and so much more in his federal funding freeze—a freeze that still may go into effect – and would harm millions across the country.

**Derek, one thing is clear to me: Donald Trump isn’t serving the people of Western PA. He’s serving himself and his robber baron backers.**

I want you to know that in Congress, I’m dedicated to taking on the corporate stranglehold over our economy and fighting for families in my district and across the country. I’m here to serve the people of Western PA–to fight for your families, for lower costs, and for a better future.

Whenever Donald Trump and Republicans in Congress side with the wealthiest few, know that I’ll fight back with everything I’ve got. **[January has made one thing clear: the stakes couldn’t be higher. | | This month, we've experienced just a taste of what's to come with Trump in the White House. Trump's executive orders are targeting public servants, and he's getting ready to give more handouts to his billionaire and corporate donors. I'm a diplomat by trade, and I know that sometimes you need to work with people you don't agree with to get things done. If there's room to work together to make the lives of working people in New Jersey better, then I'll be there to get to work. **But let me make one thing clear:****_I won't compromise on our shared progressive values, and I won't vote for dangerous legislation that harms our future._** We have so much work to do on the issues that matter most, and Democrats will stay focused on delivering solutions, not fanning the flames of distracting and harmful culture wars. It'll take all of us together to ensure that we stand strong and stand up for what's right. ## Taxing peoples owned property annually is intellectually lazy.
---
|
---
# Tax belongs in commerce, NOT assessed annually against your owned property at the point of forfeiture in the courts.
It is not in ANY way Constitutional to tax a citizen annually for the right to own the assets for which they already have purchased and paid tax. ALL tax belongs in commerce. ALL OF IT. So...how did the entire tax burden of the state and nation end up on the homeowners, wage owners and small business? Lobbyists. That's how. Big Corps hired lobbyists to lobby and buy off your elected officials to put the entire tax burden on the wage earning, home owners and small business owners. Big Corps pay almost NO property tax and little income tax. In fact, they lobbied YOUR elected officials to FUND LOBBYISTS with YOUR TAX DOLLARS to then lobby your elected officials to RAISE YOUR TAXES. Are you sick of this yet? I bet you are and so are we. We can only fix this if we work together. That is why we started BIZPAC.us 7 years ago and you should be a part of it. I invite you to join us Thursday February 13th for a BIZPAC Roundtable Luncheon you will not forget. Learn what we are doing to stop this madness in Texas and more here: **https://gem.godaddy.com/p/ec1ccb1** Sincerely, JL Trahan
BIZPAC.us Founder and Executive Chairman
---

---
Our state and federal legislators have targeted the small business owner with the bulk of the tax burden and regulatory. Their lobbyists have big corps paying almost zero tax and have turned their regulatory into secondary markets where they trade "credits" for cash and stick us with the bill. At BIZPAC, we have organized and are fighting back. Join with us and take control. Together, we are taking control and turning this around for small business owners.
---

Join at the VIP Founders Club level and you and your guest never wait in line, pay a fee and you are invited to private briefings and exclusive receptions with only fellow VIP Founders Club Members. **We have 24 Luncheons and Receptions planned for 2025** **PLUS Special Events and trips to the Capital to work with our Legislators** **And** **the BIZPAC Center for Business Excellence Accelerator and PITCH ROOM**

body:

My Dear Friend, When I tell people my story, I hear the same things over and over again:“That’s crazy.” “I don’t believe that.” “That can’t be.”But if you’ve heard about my case from Charlie Kirk, Nick Freitas, or Fox News, then you know it’s horribly true. My name is Jeff Younger, and I’m the father to two wonderful boys. That’s my son **James** in the photo above.I’ve spent the last decade fighting tooth-and-nail to keep school counselors, my ex-wife, and activist judges from “transitioning” **James** against my will. If you didn’t know, “transitioning” is the LGBTQ+ industry’s euphemism for sex change surgery or the chemical castration of a child.And if these radicals get their way, my son will be sterilized, traumatized, and dependent on Big Pharma for the rest of his life.This all started ten years ago when my ex-wife began telling me our two-year-old boy **James **wanted to become a girl.I ignored her and kept dressing my son in boy’s clothes. Because he’s a boy!But then I found out that after dropping him off at school, the school counselor would change him into girl’s clothes WITHOUT TELLING ME.The counselors and teachers also began calling him a different name, “Luna,” at school. Also without telling me!I assumed I’d be able to stop this madness during the custody hearings with my ex-wife. Instead, the judge BANNED me from seeing my son.I would only be allowed to see James if I dressed him in girl’s clothes.My friend, I’ve never lied to my sons.And I’m not about to start now. So I was forced to stop visiting him.And then I began the fight of my life to save James from this evil “trans” culture.I’ve been in court three times a week for the past eight years. At this point, I have more trial experience than most lawyers.I even authored a bill to outlaw sex change surgeries for minors in Texas, South Carolina, and Tennessee.And spent almost every dollar I had to make sure politicians passed those bills.But these Radicals are relentless and they don’t play fair.After I got the law passed in my home state of Texas, my ex-wife fled with **James** to California: a “trans sanctuary” state. I think you know exactly what happened once she got to California.A radical judge sided with my ex-wife and gave the greenlight to proceed with chemically castrating my son.I have never felt so helpless in my life. I am James’s father – yet I can’t protect him from the powerful LGBTQ+ activists who are using my ex-wife and our kangaroo court systems to turn my son into the poster child for their twisted and perverted agenda.I’ve watched the school system, my ex-wife, and the courts systematically strip me of all parental rights and privileges.In fact, I can’t even appeal my case because the judge sealed the court records. I’d have to sue the LA County Court to unseal the records just to BEGIN the appeal process.Worst of all, I am under a gag order to NEVER speak about transgender issues publicly.Technically, my writing you this to you today is illegal.But I didn’t hesitate for one second to write it. If I were just some activist, maybe I would worry about the threat of jail time.But I’m not just some activist.I’m a father trying to save his son from the Left’s madness and butchery.This is what happens when you go up against the $6 BILLION “trans lobby” and radical activist judges.They’re trying to bury me in paperwork... They’re trying to bankrupt me in legal fees...They’re trying to break my spirit...But I refuse to ever stop fighting for my son... for truth... and for what’s right. Because I don’t want this to ever happen to another family.These radical LGBTQ+ doctors, lawyers and judges need to be stopped...They need to be held accountable...And **James** needs to be **saved** before he’s permanently butchered.That’s why I’m writing to you today.When Patriots Legal Defense Fund (PLDF) heard about my case, they immediately offered to stand with me and fight this insanity.PLDF has been on the frontlines defending innocent J6ers targeted by the Biden DOJ.And when they heard about my case, they told me they’d help in any way possible.The fact is, this transgender madness is affecting all of our children and grandchildren. It’s in their schools. In the books in their libraries. Pediatricians are asking five-year-olds if they “feel like they’re in the wrong body” during routine doctor visits.This is madness. And it’s got to stop.If you want to help save my son **James **from castration and make sure this will NEVER happen to ANY child ever again... And if you want to send a message to these radical judges that their day of reckoning has come... My name is Jeff Younger, and I’m the father to two wonderful boys. That’s my son James in the photo above.I’ve spent the last decade fighting tooth-and-nail to keep school counselors, my ex-wife, and activist judges from “transitioning” James against my will. If you didn’t know, “transitioning” is the LGBTQ+ industry’s euphemism for sex change surgery or the chemical castration of a child.And if these radicals get their way, my son will be sterilized, traumatized, and dependent on Big Pharma for the rest of his life.This all started ten years ago when my ex-wife began telling me our two-year-old boy James wanted to become a girl.I ignored her and kept dressing my son in boy’s clothes. Because he’s a boy!But then I found out that after dropping him off at school, the school counselor would change him into girl’s clothes WITHOUT TELLING ME.The counselors and teachers also began calling him a different name, “Luna,” at school. Also without telling me!I assumed I’d be able to stop this madness during the custody hearings with my ex-wife. Instead, the judge BANNED me from seeing my son.I would only be allowed to see James if I dressed him in girl’s clothes.My friend, I’ve never lied to my sons.And I’m not about to start now. So I was forced to stop visiting him.And then I began the fight of my life to save James from this evil “trans” culture.I’ve been in court three times a week for the past eight years. At this point, I have more trial experience than most lawyers.I even authored a bill to outlaw sex change surgeries for minors in Texas, South Carolina, and Tennessee.And spent almost every dollar I had to make sure politicians passed those bills.But these Radicals are relentless and they don’t play fair.After I got the law passed in my home state of Texas, my ex-wife fled with James to California: a “trans sanctuary” state. I think you know exactly what happened once she got to California.A radical judge sided with my ex-wife and gave the greenlight to proceed with chemically castrating my son.I have never felt so helpless in my life. I am James’s father – yet I can’t protect him from the powerful LGBTQ+ activists who are using my ex-wife and our kangaroo court systems to turn my son into the poster child for their twisted and perverted agenda.I’ve watched the school system, my ex-wife, and the courts systematically strip me of all parental rights and privileges.In fact, I can’t even appeal my case because the judge sealed the court records. I’d have to sue the LA County Court to unseal the records just to BEGIN the appeal process.Worst of all, I am under a gag order to NEVER speak about transgender issues publicly.Technically, my writing you this to you today is illegal.But I didn’t hesitate for one second to write it. If I were just some activist, maybe I would worry about the threat of jail time.But I’m not just some activist.I’m a father trying to save his son from the Left’s madness and butchery.This is what happens when you go up against the $6 BILLION “trans lobby” and radical activist judges.They’re trying to bury me in paperwork... They’re trying to bankrupt me in legal fees...They’re trying to break my spirit...But I refuse to ever stop fighting for my son... for truth... and for what’s right. It’s in their schools. In the books in their libraries. Pediatricians are asking five-year-olds if they “feel like they’re in the wrong body” during routine doctor visits.This is madness. And it’s got to stop.If you want to help save my son James from castration and make sure this will NEVER happen to ANY child ever again... Friend,
Today marks my first-ever end-of-month deadline since being sworn in. I could use your help. Would you consider donating today to help me continue fighting for the East Bay? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=X_013125_janeom]
Listen, Friend: Every morning since my swearing-in on January 3rd, stepping into the Capitol feels like entering the Colosseum. Every day, we are bombarded by this administration's hateful and discriminatory executive orders, like banning transgender individuals from serving in the military, dismantling diversity and inclusion initiatives, and executing their mass deportation plan. I know it's a scary time, folks, but we won't let them win.
I won’t let them win.
I’ve spent the last 25 years advocating for my community, so to be here, in DC, with so much clarity and discipline, I have not taken my foot off the gas once because I know what it takes to make real change.
This administration is costing folks their livelihoods, enabling ICE raids across the country, and stifling women's rights and autonomy.
As if that wasn’t enough, earlier this week, President Trump announced a pause on all federal grant, loan, and financial assistance programs — threatening up to $3 trillion in vital support, including SNAP benefits, the Veteran Suicide Hotline, school lunches, Medicaid, and housing assistance, just to name a few...
These are people’s livelihoods on the line.
Fortunately, after swift and overwhelming public backlash, he reversed course — but make no mistake, this wasn’t a misunderstanding. They are actively trying to dismantle constitutional law right in front of our eyes. We must keep up the pressure, because we know they will try again.
To continue this fight, I need your support. Can you chip in $10, $25, or any amount to help us meet this critical deadline? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=X_013125_janeom]

Peter, in case you missed it, President Biden signed the Social Security Fairness Act into law before leaving office.

name: Joseph Geevarghese @ Our Revolution
subject: Right now: The DNC is trying to silence us
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Our Revolution click here to unsubscribe
body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis — yesterday,
the DNC shut out our grassroots members by closing a “public” DNC
Candidates Forum to the public.

It’s clear Democratic leadership don’t want to hear from the base as just
448 insiders will vote on new DNC leadership tomorrow. But today I’m here
at the official DNC meeting as the leader of Our Revolution with our
volunteers and allies calling for a new direction for the Democratic
Party. We will not be silenced.

We are joining with progressive DNC delegates to send a clear message: the
Democrats need to stop taking money from Big Tech, Big Oil, Wall Street
and other billionaires — many of whom are collaborating with Trump to
co-opt our democracy for their own personal gain.

Bottom line — there can’t be TWO corporate parties in America. We need a
true opposition party that isn’t dependent on Big Money if we’re going to
take on Trump and the oligarchs. [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21384?t=1011&akid=7622%2E5885482%2Ekx-WSj ]That’s why our Citizen Action Team is
pressuring DNC voting members to Reject Corporate Money — please add your
voice to this urgent call!

WHAT WE’RE DOING AND WHY — Our Revolution is organizing delegates, getting
DNC leadership candidates on the record, and ensuring the voice of the
people is heard before the leadership election on Saturday.

In our member survey, just 14% had high confidence that Democrats will be
effective in working to block the worst of Trump and his agenda.
Meanwhile, 88% told us the Democratic Party needs to reject corporate
influence (the remaining 12% said they’ve lost faith in the party
altogether).

Corporate money has knee-capped progressives in primaries, prioritized the
interests of billionaires and elites, and given right-wing groups like
AIPAC, crypto PACs, Big Pharma, and others influence over Party elections
and politics.

The Party is unwilling to transform itself — that’s why we’re rallying our
movement to force the changes that we so desperately need.

The 448 DNC members will vote in new leadership this weekend! Will you add
to Our Revolution’s pressure campaign of calls, petitions, distributed
organizing, and big media moments aimed at DNC members? [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21384?t=1012&akid=7622%2E5885482%2Ekx-WSj ]Add your name:
Tell DNC voting members to Reject Corporate Money.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21384?t=1013&akid=7622%2E5885482%2Ekx-WSj ]ADD YOUR NAME

The Democratic Party cannot win back the working class and become a True
Opposition Party to Trump 2.0 without first addressing its own structural
decay.

The corporate hacks are paying more attention to Big Tech, Big Pharma, and
billionaires like Mark Cuban and Reid Hoffman than to the needs of people
and the planet.

The Party that lost to Donald Trump twice will not be the force that stops
his extreme, unprecedented drive towards Authoritarian Capitalism unless
we transform the Party.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21384?t=1014&akid=7622%2E5885482%2Ekx-WSj ]Add your name: Cut off the party’s reliance on corporate donors and ban
corporate money from Democratic politics! We need to gather as many
grassroots signatures as possible by tomorrow’s vote.

We know it’s been an overwhelming couple of weeks, but we are coming
together to fight back. We are not powerless to make change in the Party
and fight back against Trump’s Oligarchy.

In solidarity,

Joseph Geevarghese, Executive Director
Our Revolution

Today's New York Times has two articles that should give pause to Democrats.
First, there is the coverage of the potential settlement offer by CBS on Trump's $10 billion lawsuit for supposedly editing a Kamala Harris interview shortly before the November 2024 election.
> "Mr. Trump's legal complaint relied on a largely untested interpretation of a Texas law that prohibits deceptive trade practices in things like marketing products to consumers. Among other objections to the lawsuit, CBS lawyers have noted that Mr. Trump's standing to bring the suit in Texas was tenuous at best.
> Regardless of the lawsuit's merit, Mr. Trump's administration wields leverage. Because Paramount owns broadcasting licenses, it needs the blessing of the Federal Communications Commission to complete its planned merger with Skydance." Source: [NY Times](https://substack.com/redirect/c0904746-7b9c-403b-98a9-492b3ddd94d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), January 31, 2025.
### Deceptive Trade Practices claims don't really need to have any basis in reality to do damage.
Put in layman's terms, Trump's lawyers have filed a lawsuit alleging deceptive trade practices. It really doesn't matter whether the claim has basis in reality or not. In this case, it doesn't even matter that Kamala Harris did not win the November election.
Paramount, the parent company of CBS, is all-too-aware that MAGA attorneys have now associated their brand name with the word "deceptive". You know how that works -- if someone hears it a few times, it must be true. And of course, Trump's team trumps, now that he is the CEO of America and can manipulate on the licensing decisions at the FCC.
The damage was done just by filing the lawsuit.
### The "biggest political coup in the political law world that anybody has seen to date."
The Trump lawyers expertly connected the dots. Even though it was a long-shot claim, they realized that by filing a $10 billion lawsuit against CBS, if Trump won the election, they might also be able to wield leverage on high-dollar mergers planned by the network's parent company down the road.
Also in today's NY Times is an article describing Lex Politica, a law firm headed up by Elon Musk's lawyer, Chris Gober.
> ...Mr. Gober says he expects Lex Politica to be the primary outside counsel for the House and Senate Republican campaign arms, as well as for House Speaker Mike Johnson, Republican of Louisiana, and, of course, Mr. Musk... Source: [NY Times ](https://substack.com/redirect/38af0214-cd72-46ed-bf20-428ca6476f42?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), January 31, 2025.
Citing the significance of new hires for Lex Politica, Gober said it was the "biggest political coup in the political law world that anybody has seen to date."
### Gober is no goober. He set up the PAC that put Elon in the White House.
Gober is the lawyer responsible for setting up the super PAC which became the mechanism by which Musk donated over $250 million to the Trump campaign. He also defeated the Pennsylvania lawsuit against the petition drive to award $1 million to swing-state voters -- something most readers thought, "But they can't buy voters, can they?"
Whether they "can" or not -- Gober and his associated lawyers will try anything. That's why they are paid the big bucks.
Describing the experience of working with Elon Musk:
> "The level of risk tolerance and what we have the latitude to do and try is an absolute game-changer," Mr. Gober said of working with Mr. Musk. Using the abbreviation for "return on investment," he added, "He's willing to spend money on things that others might say, 'Well, that's just not historically been the best R.O.I. or the way we do things.'"
> Mr. Gober continued, "It's a completely different experience working with a PAC that has -- I don't want to say a limitless budget, but you don't take things off the table because of price." Source: [NY Times](https://substack.com/redirect/38af0214-cd72-46ed-bf20-428ca6476f42?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### Do Democrats have anything similar?
Before the entree of billionaires into our political space, Democrats actually had the upper hand when it comes to lawyers.
Remember the Clinton/Obama legal clashes? The elections lawyers were fresh off the chad-counting battleground, and eager to wield their swords for lofty ideals:
> The array of battle-tested Democratic lawyers who fought for recounts, changes in ballot counting procedures, and even re-votes in Florida courts and the U.S. Supreme Court in 2000 would separate into two camps. Half of them would be relying on the suddenly-respectable Supreme Court _Bush v. Gore_ decision that overturned the Florida courts' post-hoc election rules changes. The other half would be preaching a new-found respect for "federalism" and demanding that the high court leave the Florida court decisions alone. Source: [WSJ](https://substack.com/redirect/733f2027-86f3-4efd-8894-250021b27127?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Feb 11, 2008
### We're way beyond the days of counting hanging chads
We're way beyond bringing lawyers in to argue about hanging chads. And the party's internal fight for federalism seems quaint compared to the slaughter exacted by MAGA abortion bans and Medicaid funding.
Democrats do have powerhouse lawyers such as Marc Elias, author of Democracy Docket and the progressive go-to guy in elections and campaign law. But unless Elias has recently been gaming the bitcoin markets, he doesn't appear to have the unlimited cash to hire, staff, and launch legal warfare on the same level as Musk's attorneys.
Nor does anybody else that is visible in the Democratic or progressive camp.
### Could we defend Democracy as a mosaic of various legal teams?
Could we harness the legal resources of all of our various progressive groups, including the ACLU, the Southern Poverty Law Project, the Brennan Center, and various Legal Aid societies? Possibly. But the effect would be a mosaic, rather than a behemoth in terms of opposition.
Is there space for class-action work as we see groups targeted on a daily basis, including Medicaid recipients, transgender individuals, and asylum seekers? Perhaps.
But look at the punch carried by the hip-slick-and-cool lawyers who threw around fancy terms like "deceptive trade practices" and now they have a mainstream media and entertainment conglomerate hustling to the settlement table.
Correct me if I'm wrong. Call my attention to something I'm not seeing. But -- I'm not seeing that we have any comparable legal powerhouse like what is lined up on the MAGA side of the courtroom.
### The damage was done just by filing the lawsuit
The casual reader and low-information voter associates the word "deceptive" to the respondent CBS and forms the MAGA-desired effect: henceforth, the public will think of CBS as deceptive, no matter what the facts are in the case.
### This isn't 2008. Ya better move really fast.
I have no easy answers for you. I am merely calling this to your attention, as if to say, "the train is coming down the track". This isn't 2008. Ya better move really fast.
Politics in the year 2025 is a lightning-fast game that is played out in electronic court filings long before the issues or candidates go before the voters.
High-priced attorneys paid by deep-pocketed billionaires to do the dirty work of MAGA leaders who really don't care about anybody but themselves.
We can't work across the aisle. We can't send "moderates" into our midterm and Special Elections in hopes of picking up a few more votes. And those who are already in Congress can't sit back and wait to see if there is any place to meet them halfway.
Democrats need to be smart, strong, and bold.* My main message to you, and to progressive attorneys: what we did before doesn't work, and we need to move fast.
Take these law-firm powerhouse moves seriously before we get stuck on the train tracks.
(* I should give credit where credit is due. The organization, [Girls, Inc.](https://substack.com/redirect/99a2ac11-0277-43eb-bf12-8f1deeae8ac8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), has a phrase, "Strong, Smart, and Bold". I'm paraphrasing it.)

Paramount, the parent company of CBS, is all-too-aware that MAGA attorneys have now associated their brand name with the word "deceptive". You know how that works -- if someone hears it a few times, it must be true. And of course, Trump's team trumps, now that he is the CEO of America and can manipulate on the licensing decisions at the FCC. The damage was done just by filing the lawsuit. The "biggest political coup in the political law world that anybody has seen to date." The Trump lawyers expertly connected the dots. Even though it was a long-shot claim, they realized that by filing a $10 billion lawsuit against CBS, if Trump won the election, they might also be able to wield leverage on high-dollar mergers planned by the network's parent company down the road. Also in today's NY Times is an article describing Lex Politica, a law firm headed up by Elon Musk's lawyer, Chris Gober. ...Mr. Gober says he expects Lex Politica to be the primary outside counsel for the House and Senate Republican campaign arms, as well as for House Speaker Mike Johnson, Republican of Louisiana, and, of course, Mr. Musk... Source: , January 31, 2025. Citing the significance of new hires for Lex Politica, Gober said it was the "biggest political coup in the political law world that anybody has seen to date." Gober is no goober. He set up the PAC that put Elon in the White House. Gober is the lawyer responsible for setting up the super PAC which became the mechanism by which Musk donated over $250 million to the Trump campaign. He also defeated the Pennsylvania lawsuit against the petition drive to award $1 million to swing-state voters -- something most readers thought, "But they can't buy voters, can they?" Whether they "can" or not -- Gober and his associated lawyers will try anything. That's why they are paid the big bucks. Describing the experience of working with Elon Musk: "The level of risk tolerance and what we have the latitude to do and try is an absolute game-changer," Mr. Gober said of working with Mr. Musk. Using the abbreviation for "return on investment," he added, "He's willing to spend money on things that others might say, 'Well, that's just not historically been the best R.O.I. or the way we do things.'" Mr. Gober continued, "It's a completely different experience working with a PAC that has -- I don't want to say a limitless budget, but you don't take things off the table because of price." Source: Do Democrats have anything similar? Before the entree of billionaires into our political space, Democrats actually had the upper hand when it comes to lawyers. Remember the Clinton/Obama legal clashes? The elections lawyers were fresh off the chad-counting battleground, and eager to wield their swords for lofty ideals: The array of battle-tested Democratic lawyers who fought for recounts, changes in ballot counting procedures, and even re-votes in Florida courts and the U.S. Supreme Court in 2000 would separate into two camps. Half of them would be relying on the suddenly-respectable Supreme Court Bush v. Gore decision that overturned the Florida courts' post-hoc election rules changes. The other half would be preaching a new-found respect for "federalism" and demanding that the high court leave the Florida court decisions alone. Source: , Feb 11, 2008 We're way beyond the days of counting hanging chads We're way beyond bringing lawyers in to argue about hanging chads. And the party's internal fight for federalism seems quaint compared to the slaughter exacted by MAGA abortion bans and Medicaid funding. Democrats do have powerhouse lawyers such as Marc Elias, author of Democracy Docket and the progressive go-to guy in elections and campaign law. But unless Elias has recently been gaming the bitcoin markets, he doesn't appear to have the unlimited cash to hire, staff, and launch legal warfare on the same level as Musk's attorneys. Nor does anybody else that is visible in the Democratic or progressive camp. Could we defend Democracy as a mosaic of various legal teams? Could we harness the legal resources of all of our various progressive groups, including the ACLU, the Southern Poverty Law Project, the Brennan Center, and various Legal Aid societies? Possibly. But the effect would be a mosaic, rather than a behemoth in terms of opposition. Is there space for class-action work as we see groups targeted on a daily basis, including Medicaid recipients, transgender individuals, and asylum seekers? Perhaps. But look at the punch carried by the hip-slick-and-cool lawyers who threw around fancy terms like "deceptive trade practices" and now they have a mainstream media and entertainment conglomerate hustling to the settlement table. Correct me if I'm wrong. Call my attention to something I'm not seeing. But -- I'm not seeing that we have any comparable legal powerhouse like what is lined up on the MAGA side of the courtroom. The damage was done just by filing the lawsuit The casual reader and low-information voter associates the word "deceptive" to the respondent CBS and forms the MAGA-desired effect: henceforth, the public will think of CBS as deceptive, no matter what the facts are in the case. This isn't 2008. Ya better move really fast. I have no easy answers for you. I am merely calling this to your attention, as if to say, "the train is coming down the track". This isn't 2008. Ya better move really fast. Politics in the year 2025 is a lightning-fast game that is played out in electronic court filings long before the issues or candidates go before the voters. High-priced attorneys paid by deep-pocketed billionaires to do the dirty work of MAGA leaders who really don't care about anybody but themselves. We can't work across the aisle. We can't send "moderates" into our midterm and Special Elections in hopes of picking up a few more votes. And those who are already in Congress can't sit back and wait to see if there is any place to meet them halfway. Democrats need to be smart, strong, and bold. My main message to you, and to progressive attorneys: what we did before doesn't work, and we need to move fast. Take these law-firm powerhouse moves seriously before we get stuck on the train tracks. (* I should give credit where credit is due. The organization, , has a phrase, "Strong, Smart, and Bold". I'm paraphrasing it.) If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democrat who ran in New York's 21st Congressional District. I hope to run in the Special Election in 2025. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. Donations are much appreciated. Checks can be sent to Paula Collins for Congress; 441 Old State Road, DeKalb Junction, NY 13630, or click these words to: . This is a big first step in our campaign, and I’m incredibly excited to hit the road this year, meet Virginians across the Commonwealth, listen to their challenges and aspirations, and work hard to earn their support.

| Peter,

On the first day of 2025, I officially signed the petition to get my name on the ballot to run for Governor of Virginia! This is a big first step in our campaign, and I’m incredibly excited to hit the road this year, meet Virginians across the Commonwealth, listen to their challenges and aspirations, and work hard to earn their support.

As Michigan’s Secretary of State, I’ve put partisan politics aside to deliver results that make a real difference in people’s lives. I’ve protected Michiganders from powerful special interest groups, defended their freedoms, and made myself accountable to the voters who put me in office.
And as Michigan’s next governor, I will continue to fight for the future we want by working with _anyone_ — Democrats, Republicans, and Independents alike — to make Michigan the best place to be a kid, raise a kid, and call home.
I’m ready to fight for higher wages and lower costs. To give every child a strong education, no matter what zip code they’re born in. And to ensure that every Michigander has the opportunity to provide a better life for themselves and their families.

Peter,
Last month, the January 6th Committee released its final report—a sobering reminder of the coordinated efforts led by Donald Trump to undermine the foundation of our democracy. And now that Trump has pardoned those convicted of crimes related to January 6th, it is even more important that we read the facts and remember the details of the attempt to overthrow the will of the people.
The report details the dangerous lengths Trump and his allies went to in their attempt to overturn a free and fair election. It’s a chilling account of how fragile our democratic system can be when tested by those who prioritize power over the will of the people.
As your Secretary of State, Jena has seen firsthand how the insurrection's impacts continue to affect our democracy. Threats against election officials have skyrocketed, disinformation continues to spread, and Trump’s allies are laying the groundwork to sabotage future elections.
But let me be clear: we will not let them succeed.
Together, we’ve worked to strengthen election security, protect access to the ballot box, and ensure every vote is counted accurately. But our work is far from over. Democracy doesn’t defend itself—it depends on all of us to remain vigilant.
Here’s how you can help:
* Stay informed: Share factual information about elections and combat disinformation in your community.
* Support election workers: These public servants are on the frontlines of democracy and need our support now more than ever.
* Engage in the process: Volunteer to be a poll worker, register others to vote, or advocate for policies that strengthen elections.
Thank you for standing with us in this critical work. Together, we will protect the foundation of our nation and ensure a brighter future for generations to come.
– Team Jena

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101321945/525592996/-317235110?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_GabbardTK_250131_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZDdhYWFhNi1mZGRmLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk3ZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=18DhAaKRJQ8eESvT7z_RgyZwKi5lUCv6qqxFWa4XlYw=) You might have missed it, Derek, but yesterday in the Senate Select Committee on Intelligence, Mark Warner questioned Tulsi Gabbard, Donald Trump’s nominee for Director of National Intelligence.

And I have to say, he did a stellar job – but before I dive into the details, [_**I’m asking if you can pitch in anything you can to Mark’s re-election campaign to let him know how much we appreciate his work in Washington getting the truth from Trump’s nominees.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101321947/525592998/-317235110?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_GabbardTK_250131_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZDdhYWFhNi1mZGRmLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk3ZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=18DhAaKRJQ8eESvT7z_RgyZwKi5lUCv6qqxFWa4XlYw=)

In the hearing, Mark talked a lot about trust.

He said there’s no legal requirement for allies to share intel with us – it’s all predicated on trust – trust that our allies will protect each other’s secrets.

He pointed out that Gabbard has repeatedly _excused_ our adversaries for their worst actions and instead _blamed them on the U.S._ _and those very allies._ Mark begs an important question: Can Gabbard develop the trust necessary to give our allies confidence that they can share their intelligence? Because if they stop, our country will be less safe.

Now, I’m not on the Senate Select Committee on Intelligence so I didn’t question Gabbard.

But you know that I would _never_ vote to confirm someone that the American people can’t trust. **And what I know is that you can trust Senator Warner to always have the best interests of all Virginians and Americans at heart.**

[_**Mark is on the ballot in 2026, and I know it would mean a lot to him if you showed support for his re-election campaign. subject: Day 11 and we’re already paying the price for Trump’s mess
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
We warned you this would happen.
We told you a second Trump administration would be nothing but chaos, and here we are – Day 11, and the ULTRA-MAGA clown show is already wreaking havoc.
Trump’s latest stunt?
This week he froze nearly all federal grants and loans, leaving everyday Americans scrambling to make ends meet.
But guess what?
It was such an unmitigated disaster that he had to revoke it just two days later.
Schools, hospitals, housing programs, and veterans’ services were thrown into panic mode—all for nothing.
We didn’t get “government efficiency” or “fiscal responsibility.” We got waste, confusion, and hardship.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250131_funding_freeze_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250131_funding_freeze_image]
This was a disaster for everyone.
Nationwide, parents found out that school meal programs for students are in jeopardy.
Families relying on Medicaid to pay for life-saving prescriptions were suddenly unsure if they’ll have coverage.
Pregnant women and new mothers couldn’t access benefits to feed their babies.
Veterans woke up to find some of their benefit programs locked.
Even small business owners trying to grow their companies were left wondering if they’ll ever see the loans they were promised.
What happened to "winning"? How does any of this help the families Trump and his #1 enabler Jim Jordan claimed they’d fight for?
The answer is...it doesn’t. Anyone surprised?
We’re not just sitting on the sidelines while they burn everything down. We’re fighting back. Our movement to take down Jim Jordan is stronger than ever. We will hold these reckless leaders accountable and make sure they don’t get away with taking rights and benefits away from us. But we can’t do it without your support. Will you chip in $25 today to fuel this fight? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250131_funding_freeze_link1]
This is what Trump and Jim Jordan stand for: chaos, cruelty, and corruption.
They don’t care who gets hurt as long as their political agenda is served.
This isn’t just chaos – it’s calculated.
Trump and his cronies are calling this a “reorientation of government,” but let’s be honest – it’s an attack on working families, veterans, and seniors.
They campaigned on lowering prices and putting more money in your pocket, but the only ones benefiting from their policies are billionaires and their corporate cronies.
Everything is happening just like we warned it would. The good news is it’s not too late. We have a plan, but we need you. We need a grassroots army.
Our fight is about more than resisting this dangerous administration – it’s about standing up for the values that make America the America we all know and love.
We’re fighting for America to live up to the dream Martin Luther King spoke of. We are fighting for a more perfect union. We are fighting to remain the land of the free and the home of the brave, for everyone. We’re fighting for an America where there’s fairness, accountability, and a place where we all care for one another.

body:
Our nightmare started the day my husband responded to a shoplifting call.| | | my husband had no choice -- it was the suspect’s life or his partner’s.
---
| |
---
Dear Peter,My husband saved the life of his fellow officer and now, on February 3rd, a Soros-funded prosecutor is going to try and lock him up for _11 years_.
Here is one of my favorite pictures of our two boys.
---
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=b2415438406b42719a821418223dcdb3&_e=1I5yqcMLHIY-gNCaxzgZZPFKa2zJfPDmPwP0vNPJ7tTGMoj9YgsEuKnbTIKQEKK77Fn_Wk21lUNqio6kuxabNi9J__Pe6PL_6EUVWRSkWGFKP9o6h51c-PVzwuCsaXqFCeQYqo7cafDs4ksoFtv2OFqFFLNd0WPCLvRa7OPyBH0rw7jm68zr3XoTvAcsct4yz2CzpeJdKL5rqyIRIksCiDuvLVrrhAnRdgoTRGpruQ8brnSIFSrY96omqiu7vZJwaoDW3kOmdGlXjEbxJaJOtxeKxxkSm87pmxmVmCZCAJ065YR6sb057kjNYergsyvZjhhuzGVLzu3EynR1GZYefFOmLMgPh5XzgaM7xqNvkCxWo99xU_AYd5eyckBSs1Vv7EkSEwkchI5hghKkGSXBfQ%3D%3D)

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=b2415438406b42719a821418223dcdb3&_e=1I5yqcMLHIY-gNCaxzgZZPFKa2zJfPDmPwP0vNPJ7tTGMoj9YgsEuKnbTIKQEKK77Fn_Wk21lUNqio6kuxabNi9J__Pe6PL_6EUVWRSkWGFKP9o6h51c-PVzwuCsaXqFCeQYqo7cafDs4ksoFtv2OFqFFLNd0WPCLvRa7OPyBH0rw7jm68zr3XoTvAcsct4yz2CzpeJdKL5rqyIRIksCiDuvLVrrhAnRdgoTRGpruQ9QSYfZefjDQMIJzc2DCe1KZUopUo1zoAb5CgV6CTt9dA1CYb3D0ovcVs8F2QMp8JnoytuiHWMVZYSNqgFVE7ccPRrJKeyL2qYprIYbHTpf4I6mBrHTxiBKEd5DMBfo4LC7BpCue-qv7cUjkYNaok8XMleJtaSF_yzaG64wzgSOTw%3D%3D)

Now it makes me cry. As you can probably tell from my sons' costumes, my husband Brad is a proud U.S. Army veteran. He served two tours of duty in Iraq as a Cavalry Scout. And today he is also a decorated, 9-year veteran of the Las Cruces, New Mexico, police department. I'm used to my husband being in danger. But never in my wildest dreams did I think the biggest threat to Brad wouldn't come from a radical terrorist or a violent gangster... ...but from a _Soros-funded_ , _anti-police_ _prosecutor_. **[**That's why I'm writing you today as a last resort to ask if you'll help me fight for my husband.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=b2415438406b42719a821418223dcdb3&_e=1I5yqcMLHIY-gNCaxzgZZPFKa2zJfPDmPwP0vNPJ7tTGMoj9YgsEuKnbTIKQEKK77Fn_Wk21lUNqio6kuxabNi9J__Pe6PL_6EUVWRSkWGFKP9o6h51c-PVzwuCsaXqFCeQYqo7cafDs4ksoFtv2OFqFFLNd0WPCLvRa7OPyBH0rw7jm68zr3XoTvAcsct4yz2CzpeJdKL5rqyIRIksCiDuvLVrrhAnRdgoTRGpruQ9B6AwCyfx4taoZq9WqgImlTGcJl5MC7UWVPh2frzAG7mrMmdtz_U9qou90d310x9bpOu1N7DCrEN9eSJY63HVKGmHngwpcpnot2ldKk4H2Hr3a_JXpIZ5EqToLoNrsYRWOYt8vYElRQHKUBbxiZqIiKLXez23BJgjUhAVn15pdwA%3D%3D)** Our nightmare started the day my husband responded to a shoplifting call. When Brad arrived on the scene, right away he sensed something was off. And when he and his partner, Officer Keegan Arbogast, asked the suspect to identify himself, the suspect refused. So when Officer Arbogast saw a knife sitting on the suspect's lap, hidden under a water bottle, the officers moved to detain him. Instead of complying, the suspect got violent. Everything that happened next happened in an instant. As the officers tried to subdue him, the suspect went for Officer Arbogast's gun, trying to pull it from the holster. Then he lunged for Officer Arbogast's taser, yanked it free, and pointed it directly at him. In that moment, my husband had no choice -- it was the suspect's life or his partner's. He drew his pistol and fired, killing the suspect and saving Officer Arbogast's life. When one of Brad's coworkers called me to tell me there had been a shooting, I burst into tears. I didn't stop crying until Brad came home. I was so thankful he was safe. I knew he did what he had to do to protect his partner so they could both make it home to their families. And when an Internal Investigation _and_ the local District Attorney cleared my husband of any wrongdoing, I thought this awful episode was behind us. I couldn't have been more wrong. Because more than a year after the incident, the Attorney General of New Mexico charged my husband with Voluntary Manslaughter! When I heard about the charges, I was shocked. Then we did some digging -- and it all made sense. The New Mexico Attorney General is a rabid far-Left activist who _hates_ the police. He was funded by George Soros. And because my husband is white, and the suspect was black... ...this radical prosecutor is determined to make a name for himself by destroying my husband and dragging his name through the mud. He even held a press conference and turned the microphone over to the suspect's family so they could spread hateful lies about my husband, smearing him as a "racist" and a "cold-blooded killer." **Make no mistake -- these charges are a slap in the face to every brave man and woman who has ever put on the badge.** Now you can see why I'm so heartbroken and furious. My husband is an honorable man who wanted nothing more than to serve his country and his community. That's why he served for 3 years in the Army as a cavalry scout. And it's why he served for 10 years as a police officer. But more than that, he's a wonderful husband and an incredible father to our 9- and 6-year-old boys. We've tried to explain to our boys as best we can about what's going on. But they're too young to fully understand. And I can't bear to think of what it will do to them if one day, Daddy is taken away and they're forced to grow up with their father behind bars. But unless people like you speak up to defend my husband against these disgusting Soros-funded political attacks... ...Brad will miss 11 years of birthdays, wedding anniversaries, and Little League games. As I mentioned earlier, Brad's trial starts in just days and the legal bills have become overwhelming for our family. Thank God, we got a call from Jason Johnson. Jason is a retired police officer -- and he's the President of the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Brad. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent officers -- and their families -- when it seemed like there was no hope left. And with the thought of losing my husband and trying to suddenly raise my two boys on my own -- I was certainly hopeless. subject: Power is built in the struggle. Our courts have shown how important they are for our rights

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA016/1/99735/images/NPP_Ed_logo_RGB_green1-01.jpg]
Hi Friend,
Welcome to the latest New PA Project Education Fund (NPPEF) newsletter!
We are happy to report that Pennsylvania has seen a sharp decline in mail ballot rejections. [https://www.abc27.com/pennsylvania-politics/pennsylvania-reports-sharp-decline-in-mail-ballot-rejections/]
We are excited to continue our vital work providing civic education to our centered communities.
As a voting rights organization, our mission is to provide current, accurate, and accessible information about the importance of voting in every election.
Thank you for doing your part to stay informed and engaged!
Social Media of the Week
https://www.instagram.com/p/DC0QUXzBMPe/ [https://www.instagram.com/p/DC0QUXzBMPe/]
Before the country gets ready for the beginning of Black History Month, we want to highlight this video post from Vintage & Iconic African American Everything.
By watching it, you can learn a little about the hidden messages conveyed through quilts during the Underground Railroad, the secret network that helped enslaved people escape to freedom between 1820 and 1861.
SHARE ON INSTAGRAM [https://www.instagram.com/p/DC0QUXzBMPe/]
The right to vote has been undercut across the country and remains at risk—especially for Black voters and other voters of color.
Instead of strengthening these protections by enacting the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act, leadership in Congress is pushing anti-voter legislation that will add more barriers to the ballot.
As Black voters and other voters of color across the country face the greatest assault on their voting rights since the Jim Crow era, a growing number of states are acting to protect the right to vote and safeguard our democracy.
With the passage of State Voting Rights Acts, states can provide key protections to their constituents that prevent and guard against discriminatory voting practices and policies.
Message or call [https://www.legis.state.pa.us/cfdocs/legis/home/member_information/mbrList.cfm?body=H] your representatives to let them know you want a State Voting Rights Act in Pennsylvania.
Do not forget to make sure your right to vote is still intact.
#YourPowerYourVoiceYourVote
CHECK YOUR REGISTRATION STATUS [https://vote.pa/?org=nppef]
RECENT EVENTS
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/572F74527141787142367832646E2B79766B6F4869435068772F646E5867485352734D656F342F394551326D7A49364762424A38585256527431734E59542B4E/editor_images/WCM201%20yellow%20town%20hall%20SQUARE%20GRAPHIC_mallet_2.png] On Thursday, January 30th from 6:30 to 8:00PM , Why Courts Matter - Pennsylvania and affiliated organization New Pennsylvania Project hosted their second virtual town hall on the importance of our state and federal courts.
The very interactive town hall helped attendees understand more about what the courts are doing to protect their rights, as well as the process to retain a judge.
WATCH THE RECORDING [https://www.facebook.com/NewPennsylvaniaProject/videos/988292736687812]
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/7237344C447445787878394747342B75584E47375A57552F745265427662334B544A4A36505A58657A5871474B7A5A6E53705571424758325657365969365747/editor_images/WCM%20logo.JPG] #CourtsMatter
[https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trumps-bid-expand-presidential-power-hits-first-snag-politics-desk-rcna189050] [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trumps-bid-expand-presidential-power-hits-first-snag-politics-desk-rcna189050] [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trumps-bid-expand-presidential-power-hits-first-snag-politics-desk-rcna189050] [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trumps-bid-expand-presidential-power-hits-first-snag-politics-desk-rcna189050] [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trumps-bid-expand-presidential-power-hits-first-snag-politics-desk-rcna189050] [https://www.democracydocket.com/analysis/4-voting-rights-cases-scotus-may-hear-that-could-reshape-elections/] Trump's bid to expand presidential power hits its first snag: From the Politics Desk [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trumps-bid-expand-presidential-power-hits-first-snag-politics-desk-rcna189050]
" It took all of three days for a judge to say one of President Donald Trump’s executive orders is “blatantly unconstitutional.” The order in question seeks to deny citizenship to children born in the United States whose parents are not citizens or lawful residents."
Trump administration rescinds funding freeze ahead of court hearing [https://www.reuters.com/legal/white-house-set-fight-court-after-judge-pauses-trumps-funding-freeze-2025-01-29/]
"The Trump administration on Wednesday rescinded a sweeping directive to pause federal loans, grants and other financial assistance, a White House official said, just shortly before it was set to appear in court for a second straight day to defend the policy."
Appellate Court Revives New York Voting Rights Act [https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/new-york-judge-strikes-down-states-voting-rights-act/]
"An appellate court in New York reversed [https://www.democracydocket.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/2025-01-30-Opinion.pdf] a lower court overturning the state’s John R. Lewis Voting Rights Act (NYVRA) — a law that grants voters additional protections not covered by federal law.The four-judge panel ruled unanimously that Newburgh, New York, failed to show how remedying vote dilution in accordance with the NYVRA would violate the 14th Amendment’s Equal Protection Clause."
News You Can Use
PA House approves bills that would codify Affordable Care Act protections in state law [https://www.cityandstatepa.com/policy/2024/10/pa-house-approves-bills-would-codify-affordable-care-act-protections-state-law/400172/]
" Lawmakers in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives on Wednesday approved a series of bills that would enshrine protections outlined in the federal Affordable Care Act into state law in the event that former President Barack Obama’s signature health care law is repealed or invalidated at the federal level. "
Pennsylvanians Deserve Fair Maps [https://www.commoncause.org/pennsylvania/press/pennsylvanians-deserve-fair-maps/]
"Common Cause is advocating for an end to political gerrymandering with fair redistricting laws in Pennsylvania. This legislation would update the state’s constitution and implement an independent citizens redistricting commission to draw state legislative and congressional districts."
Trump’s Executive Order Freezing Federal Payments is Harmful, Illegal and Unconstitutional [https://pennpolicy.org/penn-policy-center-statement-on-pres-trumps-executive-order-freezing-federal-payments-to-state-and-local-governments-and-social-service-providers/?nvep=&hmac=&emci=55284ace-65de-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=]
[https://www.votebeat.org/2025/01/13/2025-voting-elections-noncitizen-state-legislatures/] "Late on Monday, the Trump administration issued an executive order halting payment of grants and loans to state and local governments, social service providers, and others. This action is illegal and unconstitutional. And it is likely to cause immediate and widespread harm to people and families across our state and the country. It must be rescinded by the President as soon as possible."
NPPEF on the ground
Pennsylvanians have a lot of questions regarding the many confusing executive orders they're seeing on the news. We expect this to be the case for the next few months.
Our teams are ready to help break the cycle of misinformation spread, and make sure registered voters have the facts.
When you see our teams on the ground, even if you are registered to vote, approach us to get some civic education.

[1]Justice Democrats

Hey Peter,

I wanted to personally provide a progress update on our 2026 Candidate
Recruitment campaign we launched earlier this month.

Thanks to this incredible grassroots movement, we hit our $100,000 goal
early! Now, we’re hoping to raise $120,000 before midnight. [ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250131-1?refcode=em20250131-36383&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36383_1203867_jrgCJv&akid=36383%2E1203867%2EjrgCJv ]Will you
send $5 to help us reach our new goal?

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250131-1?refcode=em20250131-36383&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36383_1203867_jrgCJv&akid=36383%2E1203867%2EjrgCJv ]Image of a progress bar labeled '2026 Candidate Recruitment Fund'. The
total amount raised is $118,750, and the goal has been raised from
$100,000 to $120,000.

As the Executive Director of Justice Democrats, one of my responsibilities
is to help set budgets and goals to maximize our impact. Raising this
amount is enabling us to hire an additional staff member to focus on
helping us recruit and launch new campaigns for working-class candidates
in communities across the country.

One of our biggest takeaways from this past cycle and over the years is
that starting early is key. When we are up against unprecedented levels of
money and an incredibly hostile political environment, we can’t afford not
to.

The more we raise today, the more Justice Democrats we can run and elect
to Congress in 2026. The growth of our work building a working-class,
progressive bloc this year depends on the support we get right now.

With four years of right-wing fascism in the White House ahead of us,
along with corporate special interests and right-wing, billionaire-funded
super PACs trying to buy more power in Congress, it’s up to us to find and
support candidates from working-class backgrounds who will proudly fight
for everyday people and a vision as big as the problems we face.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250131-1?refcode=em20250131-36383&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=36383_1203867_jrgCJv&akid=36383%2E1203867%2EjrgCJv ]That’s why I’m asking you to chip in and make a difference on this
final day before our deadline. Justice Democrats is a truly people-powered
organization, so donations as small as $5 or $10 make a real impact on our
ability to transform the Democratic Party, fight back against corporate
and right-wing forces, and put power back in the hands of the people.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250131-1?refcode=em20250131-36383&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36383_1203867_jrgCJv&akid=36383%2E1203867%2EjrgCJv ]Contribute $5

Thank you for anything you can pitch in to fuel our critical work between
now and the midterm elections.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

* **TOP NEWS**

"**Abbott expected to promote vouchers and other highlights of his 2025 agenda in Sunday speech,** " Texas Tribune's **James Barrag an **-- "Gov. **Greg Abbott** will lay out his legislative priorities Sunday night during his biennial State of the State address giving lawmakers marching orders on what topics he wants them to fast-track this session.

Two years ago, Abbott was able to push through bills to reduce the property taxes of millions of Texans after promising the "largest property tax cuts in state history" during his 2022 reelection campaign. But he was foiled in perhaps his biggest priority: passing a school voucher-like program that would allow the use of public dollars to go toward private education.

Passing that legislation, which the governor's office refers to as "school choice" or education savings accounts, will likely be among Abbott's top priorities this session, following his heavy involvement in last year's Republican primaries in which he campaigned against House GOP lawmakers who opposed his proposal. Eleven of those Republicans were replaced by new lawmakers who said they support Abbott's plans for passing a [school voucher](https://substack.com/redirect/822a6eca-afa8-4ec6-a1f7-4b42525027c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) program. The governor said in November that the elections had left him with a net of [79 "hardcore" voucher supporters](https://substack.com/redirect/eee81795-4954-479c-a643-56695ddf51c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the House -- more than the simple majority of 76 needed to pass a bill.

While Abbott has telegraphed his desire to pass school voucher legislation, his address will give insight into his other top issues. The three-term governor who is in his sixth legislative session as the state's chief executive could lay out his most ambitious agenda yet - ahead of a reelection campaign in 2026 and a potential presidential bid in 2028.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/2c1aa9bf-1be6-409d-9885-bf50156332a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
With President**Donald Trump** , a Republican ally back in the White House, Texas' relationship with the federal government will be a key thing to watch. During Abbott's 10-year tenure as governor, Texas has spent billions of state dollars on immigration enforcement - spending that could be freed up if a Trump administration crack down on immigration reduces the amount state leaders think that Texas needs to spend.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/2c1aa9bf-1be6-409d-9885-bf50156332a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Abbott has gained a national reputation for his efforts to stop people from crossing the Texas border without documents, including a state-funded border wall, a deployment of Texas National Guard to the border and the shuttling of migrants from Texas to Democrat-led cities in other states. Trump recently praised Abbott's efforts, calling him the "[leader of the pack](https://substack.com/redirect/95cdf76e-0d9c-495c-9e29-b97d61a0ea4a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" in a public speech.

The State of the State is delivered early every legislative session and is traditionally when the governor announces his legislative priorities. By declaring those priorities as "emergency items," the governor allows lawmakers to circumvent the constitutional ban on passing legislation in the first 60 days of a session. Otherwise, the House and Senate would need at least 80% of the chamber to take up an item before that time.

Two years ago, the governor laid out seven emergency items. The session before that, he set out five.

Abbott's choices for emergency items could have a major impact on this year's session.

Speaking at an event for The Texan news outlet this week, Lt. Gov. **Dan Patrick** said the Senate would pass school vouchers next Wednesday if Abbott designates it an emergency item, which is widely expected. The upper chamber repeatedly passed school voucher legislation last session and a senate committee approved this year's version of the school voucher bill this week.

That would put pressure on the House, which has been resistant to school voucher legislation in recent sessions, to move its own bill forward quickly. But the lower chamber, which has a new leader who is more open to school vouchers in Lubbock Republican **Dustin Burrows** , is still in the process of setting up its committees after a prolonged speaker's race that was finally settled on the first day of the session earlier this month.

The fight over school vouchers also hints at intraparty feuding among Texas Republicans with some in the GOP pushing for infusing more religion and prayer into schools, restricting the rights of LGBTQ Texans and clamping down on programs in schools and businesses focused on diversity, equity and inclusion. In his speech, Abbott could signal whether he wants to throw his weight behind these types of bills.

Patrick, a hardline conservative who leads the Senate, included among his priorities bills to place the Ten Commandments in schools, allow prayer in schools and ban libraries from organizing story time events hosted by people in drag.

In a nod to these culture war proposals, Abbott on Thursday sent a letter urging state agencies to "reject woke gender ideologies." Aligning with a federal executive order issued by Trump, Abbott said "the state of Texas recognizes only two sexes - male and female."

Abbott's speech could also give insight into how the governor wants the Legislature to spend its $24 billion surplus for this year's budget. Last session, lawmakers used $13.3 billion of a historic $32.7 billion surplus to [cut property taxes for Texas homeowners](https://substack.com/redirect/d0910587-eb5c-4855-954a-de331b5ab33f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

Still, the cost of property taxes remains a concern for many Texans. In the Senate, Patrick has set an ambitious goal of increasing the property tax exemption for Texans' primary residences from $100,000 to $140,000. The House has also proposed spending $6.5 billion on property tax relief, but the two chambers must agree on how exactly to achieve that." TOP NEWS "Abbott expected to promote vouchers and other highlights of his 2025 agenda in Sunday speech, " Texas Tribune's James Barrag an -- "Gov. Greg Abbott will lay out his legislative priorities Sunday night during his biennial State of the State address giving lawmakers marching orders on what topics he wants them to fast-track this session. Two years ago, Abbott was able to push through bills to reduce the property taxes of millions of Texans after promising the "largest property tax cuts in state history" during his 2022 reelection campaign. But he was foiled in perhaps his biggest priority: passing a school voucher-like program that would allow the use of public dollars to go toward private education. Passing that legislation, which the governor's office refers to as "school choice" or education savings accounts, will likely be among Abbott's top priorities this session, following his heavy involvement in last year's Republican primaries in which he campaigned against House GOP lawmakers who opposed his proposal. Eleven of those Republicans were replaced by new lawmakers who said they support Abbott's plans for passing a program. The governor said in November that the elections had left him with a net of in the House -- more than the simple majority of 76 needed to pass a bill. While Abbott has telegraphed his desire to pass school voucher legislation, his address will give insight into his other top issues. The three-term governor who is in his sixth legislative session as the state's chief executive could lay out his most ambitious agenda yet - ahead of a reelection campaign in 2026 and a potential presidential bid in 2028. With PresidentDonald Trump , a Republican ally back in the White House, Texas' relationship with the federal government will be a key thing to watch. During Abbott's 10-year tenure as governor, Texas has spent billions of state dollars on immigration enforcement - spending that could be freed up if a Trump administration crack down on immigration reduces the amount state leaders think that Texas needs to spend. Abbott has gained a national reputation for his efforts to stop people from crossing the Texas border without documents, including a state-funded border wall, a deployment of Texas National Guard to the border and the shuttling of migrants from Texas to Democrat-led cities in other states. Trump recently praised Abbott's efforts, calling him the "" in a public speech. The State of the State is delivered early every legislative session and is traditionally when the governor announces his legislative priorities. By declaring those priorities as "emergency items," the governor allows lawmakers to circumvent the constitutional ban on passing legislation in the first 60 days of a session. Otherwise, the House and Senate would need at least 80% of the chamber to take up an item before that time. Two years ago, the governor laid out seven emergency items. The session before that, he set out five. Abbott's choices for emergency items could have a major impact on this year's session. Speaking at an event for The Texan news outlet this week, Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick said the Senate would pass school vouchers next Wednesday if Abbott designates it an emergency item, which is widely expected. The upper chamber repeatedly passed school voucher legislation last session and a senate committee approved this year's version of the school voucher bill this week. That would put pressure on the House, which has been resistant to school voucher legislation in recent sessions, to move its own bill forward quickly. But the lower chamber, which has a new leader who is more open to school vouchers in Lubbock Republican Dustin Burrows , is still in the process of setting up its committees after a prolonged speaker's race that was finally settled on the first day of the session earlier this month. The fight over school vouchers also hints at intraparty feuding among Texas Republicans with some in the GOP pushing for infusing more religion and prayer into schools, restricting the rights of LGBTQ Texans and clamping down on programs in schools and businesses focused on diversity, equity and inclusion. In his speech, Abbott could signal whether he wants to throw his weight behind these types of bills. Patrick, a hardline conservative who leads the Senate, included among his priorities bills to place the Ten Commandments in schools, allow prayer in schools and ban libraries from organizing story time events hosted by people in drag. In a nod to these culture war proposals, Abbott on Thursday sent a letter urging state agencies to "reject woke gender ideologies." Aligning with a federal executive order issued by Trump, Abbott said "the state of Texas recognizes only two sexes - male and female." Abbott's speech could also give insight into how the governor wants the Legislature to spend its $24 billion surplus for this year's budget. Last session, lawmakers used $13.3 billion of a historic $32.7 billion surplus to . Still, the cost of property taxes remains a concern for many Texans. In the Senate, Patrick has set an ambitious goal of increasing the property tax exemption for Texans' primary residences from $100,000 to $140,000. The House has also proposed spending $6.5 billion on property tax relief, but the two chambers must agree on how exactly to achieve that." Hi team,

During my exchange with her, it became crystal clear she holds beliefs that are antithetical to what we should expect from someone charged with our country’s national security interests.

| | _**State of the State: Big Ideas, Collaboration, and Action**_
---
Friends, This week, the Indiana GOP tuned in, alongside thousands of Hoosiers, to hear Governor Braun's first State of the State Address. Governor Braun's address centered around his administration's common-sense priorities, discussing tax relief, government efficiency, public safety, economic development, healthcare reform, and education. Our Republican leadership knows that these are the issues that impact every Hoosier and is proud to stand by a leader who continues to demonstrate his commitment to delivering for Indiana. Governor Braun continued to demonstrate his commitment to these priorities this week, issuing an executive order to protect our communities from criminal illegal aliens and establishing School Choice Week to reaffirm the importance of putting parents in the driver's seat and providing our children with the best educational opportunities we can. At Indiana GOP HQ, we are excited to see our state not only continue to grow and prosper but become a model for what can be accomplished when Freedom and Opportunity take center stage in governance. Together, our party will continue fighting to ensure Indiana remains a place where families thrive, businesses flourish, and our communities are safe and strong. We look forward to continuing this journey and achieving new heights of success for all Hoosiers. Thank you for all you do!

**_Indiana In-Focus: Educational Accomplishments_**
---
Thanks to the dedicated efforts of our Republican leaders in the Statehouse, Indiana has witnessed monumental improvements in educational outcomes for students across our state. Following massive financial and political investments in student literacy and education, Indiana now ranks 6th in the nation for 4th and 8th-grade reading levels, up from 19th and 17th. By prioritizing K-12 Education, Senate Republicans have delivered unprecedented results for Hoosier students!

subject: Turn America back to Godly values
body:
Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. | | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith, Please -- for the sake of all our families -- take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life...You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace. But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue's Clues_...
---
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=25baae00e83b4e3b90017d13b3a14760&_e=bSDAHtiO_SjXLsebL-JAaATbNTEweJhGjrZYEWTSIfNGjhZfgm30DtfE3iH06YYe8sdP8omPdze_MDUVxKW8_M81grSuXRT6Z9QJswtQ6CfUaKEIrE9MywxTVKib3twj98nRsdXlj_CZ7wAu5igFh0MMwz3vR-uRQwvGBq1Qg2SDEYWrrSsH16q0Nwh8gpRHuvadF3kseT3lyeY2051ipkaptgtaOgeL-Iu8KRUw5CptXbbEqd06E--c0YiyZvXxusUtb9r0aGl_4967RJeCB8L3au8gC8jWUnYMXMhp2RRxbDECDAPvHhl6VaTSDvyay8EURVThoRaNplePudyC9QDzu7frKhBxFdzg9jGmtXdPggf47gjBUp3aY5NakEXX)
