| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to "educate" YOU about your "old-fashioned" and "mean" ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. [**Today, I'm inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great**.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=25baae00e83b4e3b90017d13b3a14760&_e=bSDAHtiO_SjXLsebL-JAaATbNTEweJhGjrZYEWTSIfNGjhZfgm30DtfE3iH06YYe8sdP8omPdze_MDUVxKW8_M81grSuXRT6Z9QJswtQ6CfUaKEIrE9MywxTVKib3twj98nRsdXlj_CZ7wAu5igFh0MMwz3vR-uRQwvGBq1Qg2SDEYWrrSsH16q0Nwh8gpRHuvadF3kseT3lyeY2051ipkaptgtaOgeL-Iu8KRUw5CooAfwjzWLcRL2pdMPFYweTfHe7D73gNUq5OOkUxJuvl_e6QEoPM4vgbPtlpvGM8B4oBi_hPNcjgTQKeR_Z9zyMhxgupULe4kWNyDm9ds9GgzRmmdu05uXs09OyY2J2oFSSxQ_4hKQkoVLcZL3SW--m)Introducing: _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I'm making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you've seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we've already countered those awful "Drag Queen Story Hours" the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic "Story Hours" of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It's encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we're working to have that same impact in television.
---
>>Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we've already completed the first ten character-building episodes of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_!We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone -- including folks just like you -- who worked so hard to get us that far.But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we're making the first 5 episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE to everyone on YouTube. That's the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can't get the word out. And the left will try to bury _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 -- and we need to raise the funds in this first quarter of 2025.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $125,000 per episode.**_
---
I know that's a lot of money but it's actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won't work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens _must take over_ to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That's why I'm asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $125,000 per episode for Season 2.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=25baae00e83b4e3b90017d13b3a14760&_e=bSDAHtiO_SjXLsebL-JAaATbNTEweJhGjrZYEWTSIfNGjhZfgm30DtfE3iH06YYe8sdP8omPdze_MDUVxKW8_M81grSuXRT6Z9QJswtQ6CfUaKEIrE9MywxTVKib3twj98nRsdXlj_CZ7wAu5igFh0MMwz3vR-uRQwvGBq1Qg2SDEYWrrSsH16q0Nwh8gpRHuvadF3kseT3lyeY2051ipkaptgtaOgeL-Iu8KRUw5Cqa2rwXAm4SWsafvYbjpaJLhu0Qo57J8dTUX45iuxTBO4_FS-LSDqvNRXqamSdqoJO0vgMmGDXqqzAoraxAIxfBJmt3tVdF3BRpp2hRP8_pYeOUNK-OUR27zi4sjqd9o9ejn5hMvaQM9Mbo1-ik_OZX) ** As our special "Thank You" for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we'll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ _FREE on DVD_.This exclusive _Adventure with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won't be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=25baae00e83b4e3b90017d13b3a14760&_e=bSDAHtiO_SjXLsebL-JAaATbNTEweJhGjrZYEWTSIfNGjhZfgm30DtfE3iH06YYe8sdP8omPdze_MDUVxKW8_M81grSuXRT6Z9QJswtQ6CfUaKEIrE9MywxTVKib3twj98nRsdXlj_CZ7wAu5igFh0MMwz3vR-uRQwvGBq1Qg2SDEYWrrSsH16q0Nwh8gpRHuvadF3kseT3lyeY2051ipkaptgtaOgeL-Iu8KRUw5Co47y-qfVb-28vpmqWJPI9yDSaMS7Y4OY77UMFBwQ8PTG5cBMsAYszqXARhc13LjRD5iRWEYhRElaZzlT5R4mc_qkSYC-De7nMRljnCCpEAx22rRVWdwviM5MSTnv1YbN-n5bWu9qqNFokhdTSPSRRw)** , you'll be part of a select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. name: Sara Jacobs
subject: President Trump violated the Constitution (again)
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
If you’re following the news, you may have heard that President Trump’s Office of Management and Budget (OMB) issued a memo earlier this week that announced his administration would fully freeze all federal grants and loans, along with other financial assistance.
It might be hard to wrap your head around the scale of an order like that, so let me give you some examples of what that means: Funding for Head Start programs for your kids...support services for veterans...community health centers...domestic violence shelters...the salaries of local firefighters...Section 8 housing vouchers for low-income folks...all of those crucial services and so much more, suddenly at risk.
Over the course of the week, that OMB memo caused widespread confusion and panic – for the millions of Americans who rely on important programs and funding everyday and for the amazing folks on the ground in our communities who provide those services. Agencies and organizations were scrambling to figure out how they would be impacted (services cut, staff layoffs, and more) – and states found that they were suddenly locked out of the Medicaid portal and potentially unable to provide health care to low-income Americans.
Fortunately, that panic also turned to action. After significant public outcry and state attorneys general coming together in a lawsuit, a federal judge indicated that he would issue a restraining order (essentially, freezing the freeze). Around the same time – to add more confusion to everything else – President Trump’s press secretary said OMB was rescinding the memo (but still trying to keep some of the freezes in place).
There are still a lot of outstanding questions, but a few things are pretty clear. First, the chaos and confusion are the point. They are trying to overwhelm us so we feel powerless and unable to push back as they dismantle our systems.
We also know that this move – temporary or not – directly violates the Constitution. We are long overdue for a serious conversation about where and how the federal government spends taxpayer dollars. But the Founders of this country gave Congress control of public spending – “the power of the purse” – to protect from instances of presidential overreach just like this.
Whether or not Donald Trump wants to cut back on government spending, this freeze isn’t about that. It’s about defying the Constitution, concentrating power, and pushing an extreme agenda without the checks and balances built into the structure of our government.
My colleagues in the House and I will do everything we can to stop this. More soon as the fight unfolds.
Thanks for reading,
Sara

The State of the State is delivered early every legislative session and is traditionally when the governor announces his legislative priorities. By declaring those priorities as “emergency items,” the governor allows lawmakers to circumvent the constitutional ban on passing legislation in the first 60 days of a session. Otherwise, the House and Senate would need at least 80% of the chamber to take up an item before that time.

Two years ago, the governor laid out seven emergency items. The session before that, he set out five.

Abbott’s choices for emergency items could have a major impact on this year’s session.

Speaking at an event for The Texan news outlet this week, Lt. Gov. **Dan Patrick** said the Senate would pass school vouchers next Wednesday if Abbott designates it an emergency item, which is widely expected. The upper chamber repeatedly passed school voucher legislation last session and a senate committee approved this year’s version of the school voucher bill this week.

That would put pressure on the House, which has been resistant to school voucher legislation in recent sessions, to move its own bill forward quickly. But the lower chamber, which has a new leader who is more open to school vouchers in Lubbock Republican **Dustin Burrows** , is still in the process of setting up its committees after a prolonged speaker’s race that was finally settled on the first day of the session earlier this month.

The fight over school vouchers also hints at intraparty feuding among Texas Republicans with some in the GOP pushing for infusing more religion and prayer into schools, restricting the rights of LGBTQ Texans and clamping down on programs in schools and businesses focused on diversity, equity and inclusion. In his speech, Abbott could signal whether he wants to throw his weight behind these types of bills.

Patrick, a hardline conservative who leads the Senate, included among his priorities bills to place the Ten Commandments in schools, allow prayer in schools and ban libraries from organizing story time events hosted by people in drag.

In a nod to these culture war proposals, Abbott on Thursday sent a letter urging state agencies to “reject woke gender ideologies.” Aligning with a federal executive order issued by Trump, Abbott said “the state of Texas recognizes only two sexes - male and female.”

Abbott’s speech could also give insight into how the governor wants the Legislature to spend its $24 billion surplus for this year’s budget. Greg Abbott will lay out his legislative priorities Sunday night during his biennial State of the State address giving lawmakers marching orders on what topics he wants them to fast-track this session. Two years ago, Abbott was able to push through bills to reduce the property taxes of millions of Texans after promising the “largest property tax cuts in state history” during his 2022 reelection campaign. But he was foiled in perhaps his biggest priority: passing a school voucher-like program that would allow the use of public dollars to go toward private education. Passing that legislation, which the governor’s office refers to as “school choice” or education savings accounts, will likely be among Abbott’s top priorities this session, following his heavy involvement in last year’s Republican primaries in which he campaigned against House GOP lawmakers who opposed his proposal. Eleven of those Republicans were replaced by new lawmakers who said they support Abbott’s plans for passing a program. The governor said in November that the elections had left him with a net of in the House — more than the simple majority of 76 needed to pass a bill. While Abbott has telegraphed his desire to pass school voucher legislation, his address will give insight into his other top issues. The three-term governor who is in his sixth legislative session as the state’s chief executive could lay out his most ambitious agenda yet – ahead of a reelection campaign in 2026 and a potential presidential bid in 2028. » With PresidentDonald Trump , a Republican ally back in the White House, Texas’ relationship with the federal government will be a key thing to watch. During Abbott’s 10-year tenure as governor, Texas has spent billions of state dollars on immigration enforcement – spending that could be freed up if a Trump administration crack down on immigration reduces the amount state leaders think that Texas needs to spend. » Abbott has gained a national reputation for his efforts to stop people from crossing the Texas border without documents, including a state-funded border wall, a deployment of Texas National Guard to the border and the shuttling of migrants from Texas to Democrat-led cities in other states. Trump recently praised Abbott’s efforts, calling him the “” in a public speech. The State of the State is delivered early every legislative session and is traditionally when the governor announces his legislative priorities. By declaring those priorities as “emergency items,” the governor allows lawmakers to circumvent the constitutional ban on passing legislation in the first 60 days of a session. Otherwise, the House and Senate would need at least 80% of the chamber to take up an item before that time. Two years ago, the governor laid out seven emergency items. The session before that, he set out five. Abbott’s choices for emergency items could have a major impact on this year’s session. Speaking at an event for The Texan news outlet this week, Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick said the Senate would pass school vouchers next Wednesday if Abbott designates it an emergency item, which is widely expected. The upper chamber repeatedly passed school voucher legislation last session and a senate committee approved this year’s version of the school voucher bill this week. That would put pressure on the House, which has been resistant to school voucher legislation in recent sessions, to move its own bill forward quickly. But the lower chamber, which has a new leader who is more open to school vouchers in Lubbock Republican Dustin Burrows , is still in the process of setting up its committees after a prolonged speaker’s race that was finally settled on the first day of the session earlier this month. The fight over school vouchers also hints at intraparty feuding among Texas Republicans with some in the GOP pushing for infusing more religion and prayer into schools, restricting the rights of LGBTQ Texans and clamping down on programs in schools and businesses focused on diversity, equity and inclusion. In his speech, Abbott could signal whether he wants to throw his weight behind these types of bills. Patrick, a hardline conservative who leads the Senate, included among his priorities bills to place the Ten Commandments in schools, allow prayer in schools and ban libraries from organizing story time events hosted by people in drag. In a nod to these culture war proposals, Abbott on Thursday sent a letter urging state agencies to “reject woke gender ideologies.” Aligning with a federal executive order issued by Trump, Abbott said “the state of Texas recognizes only two sexes - male and female.” Abbott’s speech could also give insight into how the governor wants the Legislature to spend its $24 billion surplus for this year’s budget. Last session, lawmakers used $13.3 billion of a historic $32.7 billion surplus to . Still, the cost of property taxes remains a concern for many Texans. In the Senate, Patrick has set an ambitious goal of increasing the property tax exemption for Texans’ primary residences from $100,000 to $140,000. The House has also proposed spending $6.5 billion on property tax relief, but the two chambers must agree on how exactly to achieve that." | FREE SUBSCRIPTIONS HAVE ENDED : As of July 11, 2022, we have moved to a paywall for free subscribers. As a Navy veteran and nurse practitioner, I got so frustrated and decided to run for Congress because I wanted to actually SERVE my country and my community.| | | [](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=69b62e2f6a664b61a4df116adaf16084&_e=s3E5n1DotITEmyZZ4JIkrdEcunQ8pT7iD9-0HUqPARp0e8uqnIpt5kNltyFqsWL4XUxCzanXZxarMZmVAQEA6TYcgp1MXbE6tsiyxd6dAsQi_SMn55X3cPtfTKzgjQ7nTgElAyfhkYoCIyntE3-TFkO0wvQ__Kh-X1SCIhSR5McW6kty1XZycF9FNV0AQIIxIIA3V9Q8Ffm6Pj4TSIcFjYRBrlC01GCL2mJzNt1BlWfcoH6_k18KoQ16Ao6Jz2YCfnhOowyvQnnp7NTa-CaQfxaCXtJQx4Jb3vxJO7s303Cckft9VhLMKF0xNAPMIlXv8iN9Z3_c-HYzoUe6AtzlVOUlN5yTAifHGz8SkMZCHSga6otUfAzmZBj29Z0dKA3ZIDyIWcnHkso1IkO_sTHZ0pC3BINNWZ_Td_6qtIRiiB8%3D)

| | That's a picture of me from when I flew H-46 and H-3 helicopters in the U.S. Navy. If you look to my left, you can see my call sign...**Blossom**.

_**[People often ask...how did I get that name?](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=69b62e2f6a664b61a4df116adaf16084&_e=s3E5n1DotITEmyZZ4JIkrdEcunQ8pT7iD9-0HUqPARp0e8uqnIpt5kNltyFqsWL4XUxCzanXZxarMZmVAQEA6TYcgp1MXbE6tsiyxd6dAsQi_SMn55X3cPtfTKzgjQ7nTgElAyfhkYoCIyntE3-TFkO0wvQ__Kh-X1SCIhSR5McW6kty1XZycF9FNV0AQIIxIIA3V9Q8Ffm6Pj4TSIcFjYRBrlC01GCL2mJzNt1BlWfcoH6_k18KoQ16Ao6Jz2YCfnhOowyvQnnp7NTa-CaQf8mQJhd4SsdpfnFDoWQZ3wCv75Ev93O3yzKvAb94UoNcQPV2ogJs5YWrgU2swAUF7FV4h803Ghves8ZLFnY1PKPsxwfn-KKBHUGZutp_fPfpqx736s79YnFZzaHEBgqZ2_tbqTzpRlMgeoMefgRxWGc%3D)**_

Well, my roommate in flight school and I went on a bit of a "girl power" kick one day and bought old bathtub non-skid flower stickers from the store, cut out that flower shape in reflective tape from our squadron, and stuck those reflective flowers on our helmets.

There is very little room for making a Navy flight suit more "feminine," but on cruise we were able to be a little more creative and came to love those girly flowers on our helmets.

Although the helicopter community doesn't use call signs as much as some of the fixed wing squadrons, the "Blossom" stuck and was painted on the side of a CH-46 for part of my first cruise. Made for a great photo and story!

_It was my experience in the Navy that helped instill in me**the importance of service. **_

Far too often, our elected officials today forget that their job is to **SERVE**. They think it is their job to tell everyone what to do and why everyone else is wrong....but that's not service.

As a Navy veteran and nurse practitioner, I got so frustrated and decided to run for Congress because I wanted to actually SERVE my country and my community.

**While for some it is all about power, for me it is all about _service_.**

_Sadly, this has made me some enemies in Washington. _

No one is going to buy me off or tell me what to do...I'm going to keep serving the people I represent, not serve some "master" in Washington, D.C.

If you are also tired of leaders who care more about power than service, [**I 'm asking you to send me some help today.**](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=69b62e2f6a664b61a4df116adaf16084&_e=s3E5n1DotITEmyZZ4JIkrdEcunQ8pT7iD9-0HUqPARp0e8uqnIpt5kNltyFqsWL4XUxCzanXZxarMZmVAQEA6TYcgp1MXbE6tsiyxd6dAsQi_SMn55X3cPtfTKzgjQ7nTgElAyfhkYoCIyntE3-TFkO0wvQ__Kh-X1SCIhSR5McW6kty1XZycF9FNV0AQIIxIIA3V9Q8Ffm6Pj4TSIcFjYRBrlC01GCL2mJzNt1BlWfcoH6_k18KoQ16Ao6Jz2YCfnhOowyvQnnp7NTa-CaQf9qZMta-HOgsk8_lXdP5zEZiT_vzWHBAP4ea3hHOX0ZSJjmWpt4MvB7tYJFC7I2VlP3R13HpGX8A1177k2Ej7A_NTOoeW5MUQAl9zZlc4xVs9pMVyxTds9OZsH8D7aSh1_TQbfE4Is5igMP8oPUo3u4%3D)

Because I'm a veteran and not a career politician, I need all the help I can get to support my fight against the Democrats.
---

body:
Looking for Leaders

|
### A Fork in the Road
The need for a functioning congress is higher than ever and the excuses for partisan gridlock aren't good enough. If members of congress don't want to govern, they should make room for someone who will. In 1993, [Bill Clinton signed a law](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=ZECkydug-5JCfUQCPK7zbDWAK7JdAQuMBH56koMJxtb9zQbAtPYd-ioIrCw-BqpNCJXiwcumn46a3XZWMmg4yaosJ51O2EDPPBPFCVXO8F6V1fX90NYFqHCRxCzP9y57eKT6GdobzikSCsuwDsdTv3dI3IrEJMJ2XmnD1A5sGoM&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2025_february_newsletter&n=1) reducing the number of federal employees by 273,000. This was part of a larger effort to streamline the federal government and reign in spending. This law was debated and passed in congress. The current attempt to achieve similar goals is being orchestrated by unelected members of a made up department reporting to the richest man in the world by the authority of President Trump's executive order. Proponents of this (and Trumps many other first week executive orders) will say that the President has to govern this way. That the wheels of government move too slow to wait for congress to act, and in many ways, they're right. Much of the government has abdicated their responsibilities and left everything up to the executive branch to act unilaterally. What should be a legislative body that finds compromised solutions to the biggest issues in our county, has turned into a platform for signaling partisan purity and rigid principles. They can't even pass a budget. We need good representation at all levels of our government. We at Forward are trying to live this principle by helping people **Just Like You** get involved at the local level. We believe that this will build the foundations of our new party and is critical for better governance. We are a country full of great potential leaders that have gone untapped for too long. This is a fork in the road where we must do things differently to tackle the important issues our current Congress appears unwilling or unable to do. Forward is working hard to make this happen and we need people like you. [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=_KeSraPW0gSlxEBMOvJrEouH4SjeZmYtvTWulgNFAfZWbwNLjI2OgEPmOvU5vPRV&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2025_february_newsletter&n=2)
* * *
### Support our 2025 Efforts
Thank you to those of you that contribute $5, $10, $20 a month. That money funds the essential functions of our party. clean_body: Looking for Leaders | A Fork in the Road The need for a functioning congress is higher than ever and the excuses for partisan gridlock aren't good enough. If members of congress don't want to govern, they should make room for someone who will. In 1993, reducing the number of federal employees by 273,000. This was part of a larger effort to streamline the federal government and reign in spending. This law was debated and passed in congress. The current attempt to achieve similar goals is being orchestrated by unelected members of a made up department reporting to the richest man in the world by the authority of President Trump's executive order. Proponents of this (and Trumps many other first week executive orders) will say that the President has to govern this way. That the wheels of government move too slow to wait for congress to act, and in many ways, they're right. Much of the government has abdicated their responsibilities and left everything up to the executive branch to act unilaterally. What should be a legislative body that finds compromised solutions to the biggest issues in our county, has turned into a platform for signaling partisan purity and rigid principles. They can't even pass a budget. We need good representation at all levels of our government. We at Forward are trying to live this principle by helping people Just Like You get involved at the local level. We believe that this will build the foundations of our new party and is critical for better governance. We are a country full of great potential leaders that have gone untapped for too long. This is a fork in the road where we must do things differently to tackle the important issues our current Congress appears unwilling or unable to do. Forward is working hard to make this happen and we need people like you. Support our 2025 Efforts Thank you to those of you that contribute $5, $10, $20 a month. That money funds the essential functions of our party. The more supporters that join them, the more we can doin 2025 and beyond. | "Join our monthly donors" Join us February 17th at 8pm for our Monthly Statewide call. [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=8280%2E5257348%2EyzFZ1E ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Kash Patel is not fit to become FBI Director,
Derek.

Yesterday, I questioned him when he appeared in front of the Senate
Judiciary Committee.

He denied promoting a song from the January 6 Prison Choir – yes,
unfortunately that is a real thing. He said he didn’t have anything to do
with the recording, even though he was on Steve Bannon’s podcast saying,
“we mastered it, we went to a studio and recorded it, digitized it...” We.
We. We. If he had nothing to do with it, why was he gloating to Steve
Bannon’s listeners about his alleged artistic prowess?

His answer? ‘We’ apparently doesn’t include ‘me’ in every instance.

Well... that’s a new definition of we to me. And Kash Patel doesn’t just
lack an understanding of basic grammar. He lacks the character and
integrity to be FBI director.

I asked him directly: Did you claim that Trump declassified all of the
documents at Mar-a-Lago?

His response? He dodged. Yet he just said he supports transparency.

So I pressed him again. If he truly supports transparency, would he
support the release of his grand jury testimony to Congress?

Because right now, here’s what we know: Mr. Patel testified under oath
before the grand jury about Trump’s handling of classified documents, but
his statements—and the Special Counsel’s findings—remain hidden from both
Congress and the public. (He may also be the first ever nominee for FBI
Director who insisted on immunity because he was concerned he might
incriminate himself.

That’s why I, along with my colleagues on the Judiciary Committee, am
demanding full access to his testimony. We can’t properly vet Trump’s FBI
Director nominee without knowing whether he lied under oath, covered up
for the President, abused his power, or put classified information at
risk.

If you’re unfamiliar with Kash Patel’s extremism, here’s what you need to
know:

He’s spread dangerous, false conspiracy theories about a “deep state” that
is “unfairly persecuting MAGA world”. He’s calling for a “comprehensive
housecleaning” of professionals at the Justice Department, and said he’ll
close down the FBI headquarters and turn it into a “museum of the deep
state” on his first day.

While I served on the House Intelligence Committee, Kash Patel was a major
part of the efforts to sabotage a thorough investigation of Russia’s
involvement in the 2016 election — and for his work, he was rewarded with
a post in the Trump Administration.

Strangest of all — but not surprising, given his close allegiances with
Donald Trump: Kash Patel wrote a children’s book titled The Plot Against
the King — featuring characters such as “King Donald,” “Hillary Queenton,”
and one particular “shifty knight.”

In case you haven’t guessed it yet, that is supposed to be a caricature of
me — Adam Schiff.

Literally repackaging the Big Lie about the 2020 election into a
children’s book. Deranged.

There’s more — Kash Patel hosted a children’s event to promote his new
book, which featured a castle, a trebuchet (a fancy catapult), and
watermelons adorned with, you guessed it, my face.

If it sounds ridiculous. It is. But it also demonstrates how completely
disastrous Kash Patel would be as director of the FBI. He should stick to
his strengths and remain an internet troll.

Again, this is someone who has called for the arrest of journalists,
politicians, and anyone who stands up to Donald Trump. There’s no end to
the damage he could cause.

And this isn’t just about Kash Patel. It’s about Trump’s inner circle—how
far they’ll go to cover for him, and what they’re willing to do with the
power he’s handing them.

We need transparency. We need accountability. And we need to make sure
that the people entrusted with our justice system believe in upholding the
law—not bending it to serve Donald Trump.

Friend, During the first Trump administration, when Customs and Border Patrol were separating children from families, the Michigan Immigrant Rights Center helped make sure every child brought to Michigan was successfully reunited with family members. **Today, in the midst of escalating attacks on immigrants, the Michigan Immigrant Rights Center provides thousands of immigrants with free legal services and represents all unaccompanied children in federal immigration custody in Michigan.** The group is the only free call for legal services that immigrants can make from immigration detention in Michigan. However, 80% of the Michigan Immigrant Rights Center’s legal services are supported by federal grants, which are currently under threat as it’s still unclear which federal funding will be frozen by the Trump administration. The organization’s largest federal grant is the one that allows them to provide services to unaccompanied children. Trump’s ICE raids have nothing to do with public safety. They are a violent and racist attack on our neighbors, along with other inhumane actions from the administration like banning refugees who already had flights booked after getting approval to come to the United States, attempting to undermine the constitutional right to birthright citizenship, and laying the groundwork for another Muslim ban.
Together we will keep defending our communities. Thank you for joining me today in supporting the Michigan Immigrant Rights Center so the group can keep providing free legal services to thousands of immigrants throughout our state, including those in ICE detention.
With you in this fight,
Rashida

Friend,
Immigrants in our community are under attack, especially our undocumented neighbors. I’m speaking out against the Trump administration’s violent proposals such as punishing sanctuary cities, dismantling asylum and humanitarian parole, sending ICE to places like schools and churches, and banning refugees—even those who were already cleared after waiting patiently for years.
Yesterday, I joined local elected leaders and advocates, including the Michigan Immigrant Rights Center, to defend our immigrant neighbors and inform them of their rights.
The Michigan Immigrant Rights Center is providing extensive Know Your Rights information sessions and materials, some of which I shared with you last week. The Michigan Immigrant Rights Center also provides critical legal aid to undocumented immigrants.
**As the only organization****representing all unaccompanied children in federal immigration custody in Michigan, and the only** **free call for legal services that immigrants can make from immigration detention in Michigan, the Michigan Immigrant Rights Center is vitally important.**
**But over 80% of the group’s****legal services are supported by federal funds** , and in the ongoing confusion around which federal grants will be frozen by the Trump administration, these legal services could be in jeopardy. Already, the group received a stop work order for their Helpdesk, which helped 4,000 immigrants in Detroit last year.
[**At this urgent moment with the Trump administration potentially freezing funding, we need to support the crucial organizations that serve as lifelines for our marginalized neighbors, including immigrant families. clean_body: Last year, MIRC provided direct legal services to more than 5,000 immigrants in Michigan. | | | Friend, During the first Trump administration, when Customs and Border Patrol were separating children from families, the Michigan Immigrant Rights Center helped make sure every child brought to Michigan was successfully reunited with family members. Today, in the midst of escalating attacks on immigrants, the Michigan Immigrant Rights Center provides thousands of immigrants with free legal services and represents all unaccompanied children in federal immigration custody in Michigan. The group is the only free call for legal services that immigrants can make from immigration detention in Michigan. However, 80% of the Michigan Immigrant Rights Center’s legal services are supported by federal grants, which are currently under threat as it’s still unclear which federal funding will be frozen by the Trump administration. The organization’s largest federal grant is the one that allows them to provide services to unaccompanied children. | Trump’s ICE raids have nothing to do with public safety. They are a violent and racist attack on our neighbors, along with other inhumane actions from the administration like banning refugees who already had flights booked after getting approval to come to the United States, attempting to undermine the constitutional right to birthright citizenship, and laying the groundwork for another Muslim ban. Together we will keep defending our communities. Thank you for joining me today in supporting the Michigan Immigrant Rights Center so the group can keep providing free legal services to thousands of immigrants throughout our state, including those in ICE detention. With you in this fight, Rashida \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Rashida Tlaib** Date: Thu, Jan 30, 2025 Subject: We all belong here and we all deserve dignity and safety. To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Friend, Immigrants in our community are under attack, especially our undocumented neighbors. I’m speaking out against the Trump administration’s violent proposals such as punishing sanctuary cities, dismantling asylum and humanitarian parole, sending ICE to places like schools and churches, and banning refugees—even those who were already cleared after waiting patiently for years. Yesterday, I joined local elected leaders and advocates, including the Michigan Immigrant Rights Center, to defend our immigrant neighbors and inform them of their rights. The Michigan Immigrant Rights Center is providing extensive Know Your Rights information sessions and materials, some of which I shared with you last week. The Michigan Immigrant Rights Center also provides critical legal aid to undocumented immigrants. As the only organization**representing all unaccompanied children in federal immigration custody in Michigan, and the only free call for legal services that immigrants can make from immigration detention in Michigan, the Michigan Immigrant Rights Center is vitally important. But over 80% of the group’slegal services are supported by federal funds , and in the ongoing confusion around which federal grants will be frozen by the Trump administration, these legal services could be in jeopardy. Already, the group received a stop work order for their Helpdesk, which helped 4,000 immigrants in Detroit last year. Last year, MIRC’s five offices throughout Michigan provided direct legal services to more than 5,000 immigrants who otherwise could not have afforded representation. In 2018, they helped make sure every child brought to Michigan during the family separation crisis was successfully reunited with family members. As ICE agents harass and round up immigrants in racist raids, the Michigan Immigrant Rights Center needs our support more than ever. We all belong here, and we all deserve dignity and safety. The time to protect each other is now. Thank you for always being by my side as we work together to lift up our shared humanity. I am a child of immigrants, and I promise to keep fighting back against these racist policies, including plans for mass deportation. * **TOP NEWS**

"**Abbott expected to promote vouchers and other highlights of his 2025 agenda in Sunday speech,** " Texas Tribune's **James Barrag an **-- "Gov. **Greg Abbott** will lay out his legislative priorities Sunday night during his biennial State of the State address giving lawmakers marching orders on what topics he wants them to fast-track this session.

Two years ago, Abbott was able to push through bills to reduce the property taxes of millions of Texans after promising the "largest property tax cuts in state history" during his 2022 reelection campaign. But he was foiled in perhaps his biggest priority: passing a school voucher-like program that would allow the use of public dollars to go toward private education.

Passing that legislation, which the governor's office refers to as "school choice" or education savings accounts, will likely be among Abbott's top priorities this session, following his heavy involvement in last year's Republican primaries in which he campaigned against House GOP lawmakers who opposed his proposal. Eleven of those Republicans were replaced by new lawmakers who said they support Abbott's plans for passing a [school voucher](https://substack.com/redirect/a6554e0e-e1f4-4a4e-a91a-885c5550ba72?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) program. The governor said in November that the elections had left him with a net of [79 "hardcore" voucher supporters](https://substack.com/redirect/c39b4634-4576-45fe-b0c1-e928fbbe1d6c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the House -- more than the simple majority of 76 needed to pass a bill.

While Abbott has telegraphed his desire to pass school voucher legislation, his address will give insight into his other top issues. The three-term governor who is in his sixth legislative session as the state's chief executive could lay out his most ambitious agenda yet - ahead of a reelection campaign in 2026 and a potential presidential bid in 2028.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/92cb6437-db9f-4368-ad9f-f15fb5e10e0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
With President**Donald Trump** , a Republican ally back in the White House, Texas' relationship with the federal government will be a key thing to watch. During Abbott's 10-year tenure as governor, Texas has spent billions of state dollars on immigration enforcement - spending that could be freed up if a Trump administration crack down on immigration reduces the amount state leaders think that Texas needs to spend.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/92cb6437-db9f-4368-ad9f-f15fb5e10e0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Abbott has gained a national reputation for his efforts to stop people from crossing the Texas border without documents, including a state-funded border wall, a deployment of Texas National Guard to the border and the shuttling of migrants from Texas to Democrat-led cities in other states. Trump recently praised Abbott's efforts, calling him the "[leader of the pack](https://substack.com/redirect/9bf49811-84f0-4b7b-9611-7ebd60a315ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" in a public speech.

The State of the State is delivered early every legislative session and is traditionally when the governor announces his legislative priorities. By declaring those priorities as "emergency items," the governor allows lawmakers to circumvent the constitutional ban on passing legislation in the first 60 days of a session. Otherwise, the House and Senate would need at least 80% of the chamber to take up an item before that time.

Two years ago, the governor laid out seven emergency items. The session before that, he set out five.

Abbott's choices for emergency items could have a major impact on this year's session.

Speaking at an event for The Texan news outlet this week, Lt. Gov. **Dan Patrick** said the Senate would pass school vouchers next Wednesday if Abbott designates it an emergency item, which is widely expected. The upper chamber repeatedly passed school voucher legislation last session and a senate committee approved this year's version of the school voucher bill this week.

That would put pressure on the House, which has been resistant to school voucher legislation in recent sessions, to move its own bill forward quickly. But the lower chamber, which has a new leader who is more open to school vouchers in Lubbock Republican **Dustin Burrows** , is still in the process of setting up its committees after a prolonged speaker's race that was finally settled on the first day of the session earlier this month.

The fight over school vouchers also hints at intraparty feuding among Texas Republicans with some in the GOP pushing for infusing more religion and prayer into schools, restricting the rights of LGBTQ Texans and clamping down on programs in schools and businesses focused on diversity, equity and inclusion. In his speech, Abbott could signal whether he wants to throw his weight behind these types of bills.

Patrick, a hardline conservative who leads the Senate, included among his priorities bills to place the Ten Commandments in schools, allow prayer in schools and ban libraries from organizing story time events hosted by people in drag.

In a nod to these culture war proposals, Abbott on Thursday sent a letter urging state agencies to "reject woke gender ideologies." Aligning with a federal executive order issued by Trump, Abbott said "the state of Texas recognizes only two sexes - male and female."

Abbott's speech could also give insight into how the governor wants the Legislature to spend its $24 billion surplus for this year's budget. Last session, lawmakers used $13.3 billion of a historic $32.7 billion surplus to [cut property taxes for Texas homeowners](https://substack.com/redirect/17bb30ac-82e4-4776-bd44-92d68e13f343?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

Still, the cost of property taxes remains a concern for many Texans. In the Senate, Patrick has set an ambitious goal of increasing the property tax exemption for Texans' primary residences from $100,000 to $140,000. The House has also proposed spending $6.5 billion on property tax relief, but the two chambers must agree on how exactly to achieve that." TOP NEWS "Abbott expected to promote vouchers and other highlights of his 2025 agenda in Sunday speech, " Texas Tribune's James Barrag an -- "Gov. Greg Abbott will lay out his legislative priorities Sunday night during his biennial State of the State address giving lawmakers marching orders on what topics he wants them to fast-track this session. Two years ago, Abbott was able to push through bills to reduce the property taxes of millions of Texans after promising the "largest property tax cuts in state history" during his 2022 reelection campaign. But he was foiled in perhaps his biggest priority: passing a school voucher-like program that would allow the use of public dollars to go toward private education. Passing that legislation, which the governor's office refers to as "school choice" or education savings accounts, will likely be among Abbott's top priorities this session, following his heavy involvement in last year's Republican primaries in which he campaigned against House GOP lawmakers who opposed his proposal. Eleven of those Republicans were replaced by new lawmakers who said they support Abbott's plans for passing a program. The governor said in November that the elections had left him with a net of in the House -- more than the simple majority of 76 needed to pass a bill. While Abbott has telegraphed his desire to pass school voucher legislation, his address will give insight into his other top issues. The three-term governor who is in his sixth legislative session as the state's chief executive could lay out his most ambitious agenda yet - ahead of a reelection campaign in 2026 and a potential presidential bid in 2028. With PresidentDonald Trump , a Republican ally back in the White House, Texas' relationship with the federal government will be a key thing to watch. During Abbott's 10-year tenure as governor, Texas has spent billions of state dollars on immigration enforcement - spending that could be freed up if a Trump administration crack down on immigration reduces the amount state leaders think that Texas needs to spend. Abbott has gained a national reputation for his efforts to stop people from crossing the Texas border without documents, including a state-funded border wall, a deployment of Texas National Guard to the border and the shuttling of migrants from Texas to Democrat-led cities in other states. Trump recently praised Abbott's efforts, calling him the "" in a public speech. The State of the State is delivered early every legislative session and is traditionally when the governor announces his legislative priorities. By declaring those priorities as "emergency items," the governor allows lawmakers to circumvent the constitutional ban on passing legislation in the first 60 days of a session. Otherwise, the House and Senate would need at least 80% of the chamber to take up an item before that time. Two years ago, the governor laid out seven emergency items. The session before that, he set out five. Abbott's choices for emergency items could have a major impact on this year's session. Speaking at an event for The Texan news outlet this week, Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick said the Senate would pass school vouchers next Wednesday if Abbott designates it an emergency item, which is widely expected. The upper chamber repeatedly passed school voucher legislation last session and a senate committee approved this year's version of the school voucher bill this week. That would put pressure on the House, which has been resistant to school voucher legislation in recent sessions, to move its own bill forward quickly. But the lower chamber, which has a new leader who is more open to school vouchers in Lubbock Republican Dustin Burrows , is still in the process of setting up its committees after a prolonged speaker's race that was finally settled on the first day of the session earlier this month. The fight over school vouchers also hints at intraparty feuding among Texas Republicans with some in the GOP pushing for infusing more religion and prayer into schools, restricting the rights of LGBTQ Texans and clamping down on programs in schools and businesses focused on diversity, equity and inclusion. In his speech, Abbott could signal whether he wants to throw his weight behind these types of bills. Patrick, a hardline conservative who leads the Senate, included among his priorities bills to place the Ten Commandments in schools, allow prayer in schools and ban libraries from organizing story time events hosted by people in drag. In a nod to these culture war proposals, Abbott on Thursday sent a letter urging state agencies to "reject woke gender ideologies." Aligning with a federal executive order issued by Trump, Abbott said "the state of Texas recognizes only two sexes - male and female." Abbott's speech could also give insight into how the governor wants the Legislature to spend its $24 billion surplus for this year's budget. Last session, lawmakers used $13.3 billion of a historic $32.7 billion surplus to . Still, the cost of property taxes remains a concern for many Texans. In the Senate, Patrick has set an ambitious goal of increasing the property tax exemption for Texans' primary residences from $100,000 to $140,000. The House has also proposed spending $6.5 billion on property tax relief, but the two chambers must agree on how exactly to achieve that." | | | ...the deep-state
---
| |
---
| | Dear Fellow Conservative, **[Today, I’m asking you to complete this NATIONAL SURVEY ON ENDING GOVERNMENT UNIONS.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=3d9c4291015d476c80df20d048b0f585&_e=VeRSE0eQgBmC-lvwRrH8OVZQnssshdrI-K-t17xI6koimkqOtkfWgVCmew77_1nrY1axFJFa2K0Hh61SsKYWCoWHZ64VB2F_nSvbxgTcJQ_Zujjmqm2AAoXKEHsOB3qIVGbS8ArER3x3vdmQ7KOZ1NFcw3HdDcFthvxxXuQ-tKSROVYMho3d201DtHLA3UiOhdzm1-VFuoGy0-BFqDUKqDoNm5KMOy0_LnybQBpaHM60e1PThKSA5bMofViR8pW03X57bchGe6uKaEEjMhYitNXGe2hcU4P0w2xtRbzuz9RRLzb9zBvuZJH1tTuooZTSxGdVQxwh-mtP9TQy7US-RDJXjUEM1K64bx-Wf_LZFI3w1jo3_omJZoKzrLlm73S1sFneqQNVIJ8JzVTZMJD612Xsc70-FseDWVKpEZdCTqs%3D)**
---
| | I’d be willing to bet you’ve never heard of Everett Kelly before.He’s not a member of Congress. He’s not a governor.He doesn’t hold elected office of any kind.And that’s the problem.
---
| [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=3d9c4291015d476c80df20d048b0f585&_e=VeRSE0eQgBmC-lvwRrH8OVZQnssshdrI-K-t17xI6koimkqOtkfWgVCmew77_1nrY1axFJFa2K0Hh61SsKYWCoWHZ64VB2F_nSvbxgTcJQ_Zujjmqm2AAoXKEHsOB3qIVGbS8ArER3x3vdmQ7KOZ1NFcw3HdDcFthvxxXuQ-tKSROVYMho3d201DtHLA3UiOhdzm1-VFuoGy0-BFqDUKqDoNm5KMOy0_LnybQBpaHM60e1PThKSA5bMofViR8pW03X57bchGe6uKaEEjMhYitH5korLiR4ArBwoTO5Ab4gQZt5lO0vJ2jCbz6loxC4TrZJKeQIffH4dkj_BhJAqebGFehATvTz5xy8t-TMFFn_9zgIH71DOr8QeiNovncwDOWVeH_E-xV1Ljl9iFlQA2JdDApBhtaMuQHZtU_2alsNQ%3D)
---
| | Everett Kelly sits atop the American Federation of Government Employees – the largest government union with dues collected from 800,000 workers – who are fighting tooth and nail to defend the “crown jewel” of the radical left......the deep-state. And, before President Trump even takes office, Everett Kelly and the other proponents of “unionized government” are making the rounds in the media attacking President Trump, attacking Elon Musk, attacking Vivek Ramaswamy, and conspiring with the outgoing Biden administration to extend collective bargaining agreements (an attempt to tie President trump’s hands on this issue for the next two years). **[**That is why the results of this NATIONAL SURVEY ON ENDING GOVERNMENT UNIONS will be tabulated and delivered to the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE).**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=3d9c4291015d476c80df20d048b0f585&_e=VeRSE0eQgBmC-lvwRrH8OVZQnssshdrI-K-t17xI6koimkqOtkfWgVCmew77_1nrY1axFJFa2K0Hh61SsKYWCoWHZ64VB2F_nSvbxgTcJQ_Zujjmqm2AAoXKEHsOB3qIVGbS8ArER3x3vdmQ7KOZ1NFcw3HdDcFthvxxXuQ-tKSROVYMho3d201DtHLA3UiOhdzm1-VFuoGy0-BFqDUKqDoNm5KMOy0_LnybQBpaHM60e1PThKSA5bMofViR8pW03X57bchGe6uKaEEjMhYitBtOjT_sD-dW1Pp-llu2u6cSomSlqtIEC76-reMk3l-HsKuwqq0uORWC8R1gz_SdyN2fNHY-jLWwHLEO5rpOgC3YE13qzpP_3pauz8rQnPaC-lX8pMkFvVGgYvS03B0J2WW6p5FJ0AL-7locOPIMDTE%3D)** Your participation is of the utmost importance.
---
* _Do you believe it’s acceptable that only 6% of federal employees show up in person for a full work week. And if you remove security guards, janitors, facilities and maintenance personnel, the number drops to 1%._
* _Did you know that in addition to 15 cabinet departments, there are over 2,000 federal agencies?_
* _Were you aware that leasing and maintenance costs for federal office buildings costs $15.7 billion per year?_
* _Or that the occupancy of these buildings is 12% on average?_
* _What about the fact that it’s nearly impossible to fire a federal employee?_

---
These are the questions on part one of the **[**NATIONAL SURVEY ON ENDING GOVERNMENT UNIONS.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=3d9c4291015d476c80df20d048b0f585&_e=VeRSE0eQgBmC-lvwRrH8OVZQnssshdrI-K-t17xI6koimkqOtkfWgVCmew77_1nrY1axFJFa2K0Hh61SsKYWCoWHZ64VB2F_nSvbxgTcJQ_Zujjmqm2AAoXKEHsOB3qIVGbS8ArER3x3vdmQ7KOZ1NFcw3HdDcFthvxxXuQ-tKSROVYMho3d201DtHLA3UiOhdzm1-VFuoGy0-BFqDUKqDoNm5KMOy0_LnybQBpaHM60e1PThKSA5bMofViR8pW03X57bchGe6uKaEEjMhYitKOuWeaUqhcD-YBk6VXrkRoz1NWdScGtam9nKTuYuPaOY7ahn0W39pIRWkoBn_5wVH126c6f5q7Nle4ng5wmC3vCSzgn8efG1APzt0lyMKA4E2bxpbpLop7-N19Y0SrK6M-rv_Kx92KZoJMFG9qWUrg%3D)** And if you think these questions are infuriating, just wait until you hear what makes up part two of the survey. You see, part two is concerned with the actions of those government employees who actually do show up for work, but who spend every hour of the day plotting to undermine the will of duly elected presidents and ignore duly passed legislation.In other words, the radical deep-state. These are the bureaucrats who’ve burrowed deep into the federal government (often they served as political appointees in a leftwing administration, but refuse to leave after that administration ends, becoming, instead, career “civil servant”).CIA. FBI. National Security Council. State Department. Pentagon. Hostile agents at the highest levels of these departments spent four years leaking, lying, and unleashing lawfare against the first Trump Administration.
---
* _Shouldn’t the people we elect to run the government actually run the government?_
* _Shouldn’t members of the executive branch work in good faith to advance the vision and policies of the head of the executive branch?_
* _Shouldn’t any bureaucrat who can’t respect the U.S. Constitution leave government service?_
* _Shouldn’t it be an enormous “red flag” that Kamala Harris won 93% of the vote in Washington DC and the fact that roughly 95% of campaign contributions by government bureaucrats go to Democrats?_

---
You and I both know that the Constitution of the United States grants no power to unelected federal bureaucrats. Yet these individuals have enormous power and zero accountability.It’s bad enough you and I are being ripped off financially (covered in part one of your survey).But what’s worse is the reality that our votes and our constitutional republic are being ripped off and wholly undermined by these unions (part two of you survey). In short, this is an attack on the very foundations of our country. It’s part of the Marxist playbook that is destroying America... one that I’m intimately familiar with... because I helped to write and execute it when I was a member of the radical Left movement in the 1960’s and 1970’s.I know from first-hand experience how Marxist radicals sought to infiltrate every facet of American life... _Schools. Churches. The military. Unions. Businesses. The media. Hollywood. _And, yes, the federal bureaucracy.Now, I’m working to expose the TRUTH about the radical Left to a new generation that is being fooled. At the Freedom Center we use the Left’s tactics against them – tactics like those outlined in Saul Alinsky’s “Rules for Radicals” ... in other words we fight fire with fire. Today, I’m asking you to join the Freedom Center in exposing the threat posed by government unions to the mandate delivered by American voters in the 2024 election. **[**Your NATIONAL SURVEY ON ENDING GOVERNMENT UNIONS is the key to reaffirming this mandate by demonstrating the consensus that exists to remove the obstructionist deep-state.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=3d9c4291015d476c80df20d048b0f585&_e=VeRSE0eQgBmC-lvwRrH8OVZQnssshdrI-K-t17xI6koimkqOtkfWgVCmew77_1nrY1axFJFa2K0Hh61SsKYWCoWHZ64VB2F_nSvbxgTcJQ_Zujjmqm2AAoXKEHsOB3qIVGbS8ArER3x3vdmQ7KOZ1NFcw3HdDcFthvxxXuQ-tKSROVYMho3d201DtHLA3UiOhdzm1-VFuoGy0-BFqDUKqDoNm5KMOy0_LnybQBpaHM60e1PThKSA5bMofViR8pW03X57bchGe6uKaEEjMhYitGG-mYhuzdGj3XzvCWmpn1iqmYPIDxeonDKCt3OYOOWwnKMRNuDa4Si3EOwfPRMsVuqQ1DwMD3zLU2YvA1L_DqL8AsZ72A180pWXjFghXwYikalk4S3aCtTTxGBBidAeOrQ3IWsFWg0_6GmnhWIH2j4%3D)** Please complete it as soon as possible. There’s no time to lose.The Freedom Center is spearheading this movement. It is vitally important that we circulate 1 million of these surveys, so there can be no doubt where our country stands on this issue.Because if the threat of government unions is not broken, banned, and outlawed over the next two years... then it _never_ will. As I mentioned, the results of this survey will be reported to Elon Musk, Vivek Ramaswamy, and the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) whose charter expires on July 4, 2026 – on our nation’s 250th birthday. You see, we’ve got a very tight deadline to accomplish this mission. **[That’s why I’m asking you to complete your NATIONAL SURVEY ON ENDING GOVERNMENT UNIONS without delay.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=3d9c4291015d476c80df20d048b0f585&_e=VeRSE0eQgBmC-lvwRrH8OVZQnssshdrI-K-t17xI6koimkqOtkfWgVCmew77_1nrY1axFJFa2K0Hh61SsKYWCoWHZ64VB2F_nSvbxgTcJQ_Zujjmqm2AAoXKEHsOB3qIVGbS8ArER3x3vdmQ7KOZ1NFcw3HdDcFthvxxXuQ-tKSROVYMho3d201DtHLA3UiOhdzm1-VFuoGy0-BFqDUKqDoNm5KMOy0_LnybQBpaHM60e1PThKSA5bMofViR8pW03X57bchGe6uKaEEjMhYitHfnKeK0c4TTqiCOkNOIM-BwT9Vr-snlrRewy9TGyqJhadrnsXVVlhWwcqfSQqCXtaoDb6XY09qKVvpSiOnjOzmUe30q0bNklkPfYfmTohzneR0rTm_0Q98FOYMRNWN0s4GP_EbLRc18r8-uj1ZMGjo%3D)** And that’s why **I’m also asking you to make a one-time contribution of $35** when you do. It’s going to take an enormous grassroots effort to circulate, collect, and tabulate the results of these surveys to the Department of Government Efficiency.**That said, if you can send a larger contribution – $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000, or more – it will supercharge this campaign.** I want you to know that the Freedom Center will maximize every dollar you contribute. We’ve had “woke” corporations and financial institutions conspire to “de-bank” and “de-platform” us before:
---
* They got MasterCard to shut off our online fundraising and credit card processing (we got it turned back on).
* We had to find a new bank after the local bank we’ve been at for years suddenly closed our accounts.
* The hotel we’ve held our annual fundraising conference at for the last 20 years abruptly declined to renew our contract.

---
You see, because of our effectiveness in fighting for conservative principles, they hate us. Like President Trump, we’ve faced countless lies, leaks, and lawfare attempts from the Left. But I refuse to back down.Especially against the wasteful, constitution-subverting unions that make up the federal deep-state. So please hurry. With your support today, I’m confident we can win this fight.
---
Sincerely,
---

| | **David Horowitz**

name: Lacy Lunsford
subject: I’m writing to you today as a last resort
body:
My husband is an honorable man who wanted nothing more than to serve his country and his community.| | | my husband had no choice -- it was the suspect’s life or his partner’s.
---
| |
---
Dear Patriot,My husband saved the life of his fellow officer and now, on February 3rd, a Soros-funded prosecutor is going to try and lock him up for _11 years_.
Here is one of my favorite pictures of our two boys.
---
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=34ff90cc26914276ba938a7707f13dd0&_e=QpSQYzLai_10Gdr0sPS1S0bv7wxQmhoe5vqI4HsMl6kO-17iz9PV6kWJlXy8jnF5jrmXz6-oK6qV0sMYgJ1Ii0UVmmzxHO1jfDzfd56bn2onSjFPtV-wHU2BhfMOv3XUhkSGivJVPD1WtQS-tRbBAspaVcSUEytkIWVZM8vSGzTPW0ZC7bdCKbn-1pMiX79--VfRioTbjJvNGOnQwhyNd3UQKyBeNWfU2v-oMOXSky2WuPaNxDHkaEhY-6BcgcOHAj4pLAgH_NGVALX2Lb3tbtJUizyZtrX_Km4cYEn6aeVgiwvqbQNBwtiitUp_N7Kr7fAVuT-Bi-nGPOexh37WRKs0H3HoT9vJGKaQ2WNLylKqpMITAUxrxneYbTwr6DvvUn9RRGjkoGdp3pf0JhjRCw%3D%3D)
---
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=34ff90cc26914276ba938a7707f13dd0&_e=QpSQYzLai_10Gdr0sPS1S0bv7wxQmhoe5vqI4HsMl6kO-17iz9PV6kWJlXy8jnF5jrmXz6-oK6qV0sMYgJ1Ii0UVmmzxHO1jfDzfd56bn2onSjFPtV-wHU2BhfMOv3XUhkSGivJVPD1WtQS-tRbBAspaVcSUEytkIWVZM8vSGzTPW0ZC7bdCKbn-1pMiX79--VfRioTbjJvNGOnQwhyNd3UQKyBeNWfU2v-oMOXSky1GTMw9JK2o0aQ1b9KuRc_0hBzhvBwhQqI5UyGhgLK7NAUrtYbTPSVrpzCJL8MSsUBe-WVZjEAOlQ6tI42BLUfbV-zIHlw4fHAmgGyMXvUNSEzV566TgneHVBUxjjRpXV8avuDgqG9arppQku-1SC1DFOGIuiICYxlmv5HHyQklUw%3D%3D)
---
Now it makes me cry. As you can probably tell from my sons' costumes, my husband Brad is a proud U.S. Army veteran. He served two tours of duty in Iraq as a Cavalry Scout. And today he is also a decorated, 9-year veteran of the Las Cruces, New Mexico, police department. I'm used to my husband being in danger. But never in my wildest dreams did I think the biggest threat to Brad wouldn't come from a radical terrorist or a violent gangster... ...but from a _Soros-funded_ , _anti-police_ _prosecutor_. **[**That's why I'm writing you today as a last resort to ask if you'll help me fight for my husband.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=34ff90cc26914276ba938a7707f13dd0&_e=QpSQYzLai_10Gdr0sPS1S0bv7wxQmhoe5vqI4HsMl6kO-17iz9PV6kWJlXy8jnF5jrmXz6-oK6qV0sMYgJ1Ii0UVmmzxHO1jfDzfd56bn2onSjFPtV-wHU2BhfMOv3XUhkSGivJVPD1WtQS-tRbBAspaVcSUEytkIWVZM8vSGzTPW0ZC7bdCKbn-1pMiX79--VfRioTbjJvNGOnQwhyNd3UQKyBeNWfU2v-oMOXSky1Nfj6c-wN1iVZTFmkTDVuar9ag_KEz3crL2G8sgNdxp1g99RRXvT-yTL4NnvU-kp5V2YsMpvCrpl2IoQSPMLLIjW4i4Udik1eJXHY5A92lKxiNFD7nhpED64A-oRJ5ufN5N0zr_sQK-45aazet2WNZuo0txS1YWQ5ck8CDsM7pTw%3D%3D)** Our nightmare started the day my husband responded to a shoplifting call. When Brad arrived on the scene, right away he sensed something was off. And when he and his partner, Officer Keegan Arbogast, asked the suspect to identify himself, the suspect refused. So when Officer Arbogast saw a knife sitting on the suspect's lap, hidden under a water bottle, the officers moved to detain him. Instead of complying, the suspect got violent. Everything that happened next happened in an instant. As the officers tried to subdue him, the suspect went for Officer Arbogast's gun, trying to pull it from the holster. Then he lunged for Officer Arbogast's taser, yanked it free, and pointed it directly at him. In that moment, my husband had no choice -- it was the suspect's life or his partner's. He drew his pistol and fired, killing the suspect and saving Officer Arbogast's life. When one of Brad's coworkers called me to tell me there had been a shooting, I burst into tears. I didn't stop crying until Brad came home. I was so thankful he was safe. I knew he did what he had to do to protect his partner so they could both make it home to their families. And when an Internal Investigation _and_ the local District Attorney cleared my husband of any wrongdoing, I thought this awful episode was behind us. I couldn't have been more wrong. Because more than a year after the incident, the Attorney General of New Mexico charged my husband with Voluntary Manslaughter! When I heard about the charges, I was shocked. Then we did some digging -- and it all made sense. The New Mexico Attorney General is a rabid far-Left activist who _hates_ the police. He was funded by George Soros. And because my husband is white, and the suspect was black... ...this radical prosecutor is determined to make a name for himself by destroying my husband and dragging his name through the mud. He even held a press conference and turned the microphone over to the suspect's family so they could spread hateful lies about my husband, smearing him as a "racist" and a "cold-blooded killer." **Make no mistake -- these charges are a slap in the face to every brave man and woman who has ever put on the badge.** Now you can see why I'm so heartbroken and furious. My husband is an honorable man who wanted nothing more than to serve his country and his community. That's why he served for 3 years in the Army as a cavalry scout. And it's why he served for 10 years as a police officer. But more than that, he's a wonderful husband and an incredible father to our 9- and 6-year-old boys. We've tried to explain to our boys as best we can about what's going on. But they're too young to fully understand. And I can't bear to think of what it will do to them if one day, Daddy is taken away and they're forced to grow up with their father behind bars. But unless people like you speak up to defend my husband against these disgusting Soros-funded political attacks... ...Brad will miss 11 years of birthdays, wedding anniversaries, and Little League games. As I mentioned earlier, Brad's trial starts in just days and the legal bills have become overwhelming for our family. Thank God, we got a call from Jason Johnson. Jason is a retired police officer -- and he's the President of the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Brad. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent officers -- and their families -- when it seemed like there was no hope left. And with the thought of losing my husband and trying to suddenly raise my two boys on my own -- I was certainly hopeless. Not only did LELDF decide to help my husband get the legal defense he deserves, they're also raising money to pay for the best lawyers and expert witnesses available. But it’s only because of the support of brave patriots like yourself. Jason and LELDF were an answer to prayer for our family. That's because Brad and I aren't wealthy people. I run our family farm and Brad is a veteran turned cop. So I must ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone. **[**Will you donate $35 or any amount to LELDF to help me save my husband?**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=34ff90cc26914276ba938a7707f13dd0&_e=QpSQYzLai_10Gdr0sPS1S0bv7wxQmhoe5vqI4HsMl6kO-17iz9PV6kWJlXy8jnF5jrmXz6-oK6qV0sMYgJ1Ii0UVmmzxHO1jfDzfd56bn2onSjFPtV-wHU2BhfMOv3XUhkSGivJVPD1WtQS-tRbBAspaVcSUEytkIWVZM8vSGzTPW0ZC7bdCKbn-1pMiX79--VfRioTbjJvNGOnQwhyNd3UQKyBeNWfU2v-oMOXSky0QS4TMa3Alfy7zLIJaBb_HpDvCObXG5ip_5d4kKUKSjmuZ5EegmENyOS34su8GZC3lfF_8Cwsc0BIhF6j3pbPODVP3Clz75DNdzzH0Qgl_DVmn0oFvwWRvyS5EDkrRNy6FyoUOou9zUeZko687Z8ghi3DWBAo9ty-sYRc7_eiFww%3D%3D)** If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help. But I'm so scared for Brad and I will do whatever I can for him -- and for our sons. **[So I pray you'll find it in your heart today to make a tax-deductible gift of $35, $50, $100 or more to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=34ff90cc26914276ba938a7707f13dd0&_e=QpSQYzLai_10Gdr0sPS1S0bv7wxQmhoe5vqI4HsMl6kO-17iz9PV6kWJlXy8jnF5jrmXz6-oK6qV0sMYgJ1Ii0UVmmzxHO1jfDzfd56bn2onSjFPtV-wHU2BhfMOv3XUhkSGivJVPD1WtQS-tRbBAspaVcSUEytkIWVZM8vSGzTPW0ZC7bdCKbn-1pMiX79--VfRioTbjJvNGOnQwhyNd3UQKyBeNWfU2v-oMOXSky2NHlL6RpTZbK3vmsMPy48gxwZtSv4s8xhpUmQcZjimoI7GIA1zeebwmLNWqQ_1_DdJ0WgAmuonhQeeKpzk4gvWVY2cQHUHM_2XrRfpaOXUdUUm837tyVZSxqHXQL5gxUbhHIHHmo7qHC4CoNbmRwULy7eIBte5c7vYydibMM2qEg%3D%3D) ** Brad and I -- and our two sons -- are counting on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you to help keep Brad home where he belongs. No matter what you're able to give today, please pray for us. Thank you in advance for your support.
---
Sincerely,
---
Lacy Lunsford
---
| | P.S. I already spent a year apart from my husband when he was in the Army. It's the hardest thing I've ever done. He almost died during that deployment when the Humvee he was driving hit an IED. I can't imagine having to spend 11 long, lonely years, trying to raise the boys by myself -- and worrying every day about my husband, locked up with hundreds of violent criminals. Please don't let my two boys grow up without their father -- [**please follow this link right now to make a tax-deductible donation of $35 or any amount to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund today.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=34ff90cc26914276ba938a7707f13dd0&_e=QpSQYzLai_10Gdr0sPS1S0bv7wxQmhoe5vqI4HsMl6kO-17iz9PV6kWJlXy8jnF5jrmXz6-oK6qV0sMYgJ1Ii0UVmmzxHO1jfDzfd56bn2onSjFPtV-wHU2BhfMOv3XUhkSGivJVPD1WtQS-tRbBAspaVcSUEytkIWVZM8vSGzTPW0ZC7bdCKbn-1pMiX79--VfRioTbjJvNGOnQwhyNd3UQKyBeNWfU2v-oMOXSky3l2oT12dyIZK3qkCo2ie4GA_--gXZz3j7M7U_Nf5BGQ-J_3qWLXyg1k2Rb8UPo0zRZxj-iBRJZ_cV5rAcZrFKIRWL-zifHFxNpjPpWDFnGGbvRWUqK7TYt6W-eZRacrxO5P_hq6Ijr12Q5rJmHhHF7e22M865r3R67WljPfj7ddQ%3D%3D) P.P.S. Brad's trial starts on February 3rd, so we're quickly running out time. Thank you for helping my family fight back against this Soros-funded prosecutor!
---
|

Richard Craig was working a bus crash during a January snowstorm when he spotted a pizza deliverer [trudging through the snow](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8z7FugzAQxvGngc3Id_aBM3jowpauHZEbn-EqEyOwgpKnr9IH6PxJ30__r-t0DZLlPn-GlX2a01RTmVAjKQ3KwBSD5Odk2-gTM7Jp2cNgnCGyhO3irXUEabgksK53kfAbdXR4S46oh3Bpxb_fNBhAjQPZLhgDEK1mxxcDw9BYzVFq2bufIve6cMrP8uC9u5W1zX6pdTsa89Hg2OB4nmf3DEsp77XB8c7n0eC4yesVVNzlwbuauR4KVZVNwQBEPRnXLXXN7e7jdkrOcvRvdl6D5D-m_pf-8PgbAAD__0jiWqQ) in Avon, Indiana, carrying an empty pizza bag.

# Friday, January 31, 2025
---|---

name: Prudent Politics
subject: “Fact-checker” NewsGuard comes after PragerU again
body:
Please read the following message.
* * *

| | | | | [](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueba2Iteknop5IeITm6lin73l&s=NKJJINPPPCMHCEOE)
---
| | **[](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueba2Iteknop5IfITm6lin73l&s=NKJJINPPPCMHCEOE)[](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueba2Iteknop5IgITm6lin73l&s=NKJJINPPPCMHCEOE)[](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueba2Iteknop5IhITm6lin73l&s=NKJJINPPPCMHCEOE)[](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueba2Iteknop5IiITm6lin73l&s=NKJJINPPPCMHCEOE)[Big Tech fact-checkers are after PragerU again!](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueba2Iteknop5IjITm6lin73l&s=NKJJINPPPCMHCEOE)**
---
| | NewsGuard, one of Big Tech’s self-declared and left-wing funded “fact-checkers,” is targeting PragerU—again! After years of smearing our reputation, falsely accusing our videos of advancing _“inaccurate, misleading, and unsubstantiated claims,”_ pressuring tech platforms to cancel us, and costing us hundreds of thousands—if not millions—of dollars, NewsGuard refuses to leave us alone. They recently reached out AGAIN to inform us they are “updating” their rating of PragerU (currently a low score of 57 points out of 100).
---
[](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueba2Iteknop5IkITm6lin73l&s=NKJJINPPPCMHCEOE)
---
[**Expose NewsGuard**](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueba2Iteknop5IlITm6lin73l&s=NKJJINPPPCMHCEOE)
---
This is the same NewsGuard that claims to fight misinformation but avoids transparency themselves. We believe the American public deserves answers. That’s why I responded to NewsGuard by inviting co-CEOs Steven Brill and Gordon Crovitz to sit down with me for a recorded and transparent interview. Despite offering multiple times to respectfully ask and answer each other’s questions, NewsGuard’s CEOs have failed to accept my invitation. **[Like many other things in America, it’s time to expose the Truth. NewsGuard has been intimidating conservative media companies, attempting to control information. We will not allow them to intimidate us with their baseless ratings.](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueba2Iteknop5ImITm6lin73l&s=NKJJINPPPCMHCEOE) ** ** ** Even Mark Zuckerberg (whether you trust him or not) has acknowledged the bias of so-called “fact-checkers,” and Meta plans to phase them out. Meanwhile, Steven Brill told NPR that the idea they should ease up on fact-checking is _“just plain ridiculous”_ and accuses Zuckerberg of _“living in an alternate universe.”_ PragerU sounded the alarm about NewsGuard long ago—and they are finally starting to be exposed! But now is not the time to take our foot off the gas. We must continue to apply pressure and reveal their blatant censorship and intimidation tactics. **[That is why we need your help!](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueba2Iteknop5InITm6lin73l&s=NKJJINPPPCMHCEOE) **
---
[**Support PragerU**](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueba2Iteknop5IoITm6lin73l&s=NKJJINPPPCMHCEOE)
---
Despite NewsGuard’s continued threats, **[**PragerU has been sounding the alarm about their suppression of free speech for years.**](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueba2Iteknop5IpITm6lin73l&s=NKJJINPPPCMHCEOE)** Now EVERYONE is talking about NewsGuard’s nefarious agenda. Here are just a few highlights:
* Mike Benz, a former State Department official, accused NewsGuard of blacklisting media outlets, censoring what students can learn in K-12 schools.
* House Oversight Committee Chair James Comer (R-Ky.) launched an official congressional investigation into NewsGuard.
* Media outlets from The Daily Wire to The Federalist and Newsmax have reported on NewsGuard’s censorship and intimidation tactics.
* The “Twitter Files” (internal Twitter documents leaked by Elon Musk to a few journalists) confirm what PragerU has been saying all along—Big Tech has colluded with Big Government via fact-checkers like NewsGuard.
* Congressional hearings were held by the “House Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government” on this matter.
* Journalists Michael Shellenberger (who starred in several PragerU videos) and Matt Taibbi testified in these hearings and have been relentlessly attacked for exposing this collusion—our own government has interrogated and threatened journalists who are simply telling the truth!
* State of Florida CFO Jimmy Patronis has been warning businesses about NewsGuard's nefarious tactics!
* Word has been spreading like wildfire online...millions now know that our government has not allowed dissent and used taxpayer dollars (Biden’s Department of Defense paid NewsGuard $750K in 2021) to censor the American people!

PragerU has pulled back the curtain. We've opened millions of eyes to these cold hard facts: Our own government was pressuring—and paying—Big Tech to use "fact-checkers" like NewsGuard to slap a “misinformation” label on anything they disagree with and “redirect” people to powerful elite-approved websites to be reeducated with the “correct” information.
---
[**Expose NewsGuard**](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueba2Iteknop5IqITm6lin73l&s=NKJJINPPPCMHCEOE)
---
We will not let NewsGuard and their cronies get away with this. We’re not going to let them suppress free speech, conceal information, and control what you can and cannot see, all while keeping you completely in the dark. There might be severe consequences for us for pushing against NewsGuard. But if we don’t do it, who will? Third-party fact-checkers and their “partners” have a lot of money and power. But we have you! Times are changing for the better in America, but to keep this momentum going, we must strike while the iron is hot. **[**Donate now to help us expose NewsGuard.**](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueba2Iteknop5IrITm6lin73l&s=NKJJINPPPCMHCEOE) ** Let’s protect our freedom of speech. We’re willing to take the risk. We’re putting everything on the line. But we need your help. Please join in the fight and help us. Sincerely, Marissa Streit, PragerU CEO
---
[**Donate Now**](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueba2Iteknop5IsITm6lin73l&s=NKJJINPPPCMHCEOE)
---

body:
We’re staying the course for Virginia.

| Hi Derek, Did you know that most people give up their New Year’s resolutions by the end of January? It’s true – but not us! Our resolution is simple: keep Virginia blue and regain Democratic momentum in 2025 with the first big election after last November. Each of us has a role in turning the promise of our democracy into a lasting reality. Peter –

I'll be the first to admit that it's easy to look at the state of things and feel overwhelmed, and even hopeless. But I'll also be the first to remind you: As Americans, we’ve overcome worse.

Our first fight was getting to Congress – and we did it! Now, the real work begins.

When the odds have been against us, we've come together, stood up for what’s right, and made progress. That’s exactly what we need to do now. Each one of us has a role to play in ensuring that the good of the people and the best of what our nation and democracy stand for isn’t just an idea – but a permanent reality.

But that takes effort, commitment, and a willingness to fight for what’s right. Now, our very first end-of-month deadline of 2025 is coming up and we need all hands on deck to meet this critical goal by midnight tonight. Whether it’s reaching voters in off-years, combating misinformation, or standing up to the extremists trying to roll back our rights – what we do right now matters.

| Friend – Why should we go to Mars? In his inaugural address, much to the delight of a cheering Elon Musk, President Trump announced that we will "plant the American flag on Mars." How many Americans understand why this is so important, but also understand that it must be approached from a completely different perspective -- one which seeks to foster discoveries of new physical principles, like the Russians have just demonstrated with their hypersonic Oreshnik missile? Bill Jones of EIR and I will take this up from the standpoint of Lyndon LaRouche's 40 year Mars colonization program. Don't remain an earthling! Join us at 8pm Friday.

Trump made it clear from the start that he’s not going to fight for regular Americans
#
[](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-jan25.IJ0kth&refcode=em250131-2-210&t=1&akid=5480%2E196590%2EiK7NMB)
See these guys? They were the VIPs at Trump’s inauguration.
Musk, Zuckerberg, Bezos, and Pichai. Twitter, Meta, Amazon, and Google. Their combined net worth is almost one trillion dollars. Yes, one trillion. That’s $1,000,000,000,000.
Trump made it clear from the start that he’s not going to fight for regular Americans. He’s not looking out for the working class. His goal is to make his billionaire buddies richer at the expense of the rest of us.
Just look at the complete mess this week around the federal grant freeze. With just a short memo, Trump froze essential benefits for millions of working class Americans, such as Medicaid, food stamps, housing assistance, veteran’s care, Meals on Wheels, and much more.
And that’s within the same week that he used executive orders to deregulate big money industries like fossil fuels, AI, and cryptocurrency. **We have to fight back. We have to stand against Trump’s looting of the American people.**
One of our biggest goals here at The Long Run is to elect more working class candidates to office. Because we understand that for our government to represent us, they have to look like us. They have to understand the struggles we face, and put the needs of regular folks over the needs of billionaires.
We’ve already seen success in our work to elect Long Run candidates in swing districts across the country, and we’re gearing up to do the same this election cycle. But we need your help if we’re going to come out the gate strong.
