name: Team Freedom VA
subject: 🏃 The 2025 Session is Moving Quickly! 💨
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Freedom Virginia, Inc
body:
https://freedomva.org/ [https://freedomva.org/]
The 2025 Virginia General Assembly Session is in full swing, and as crossover approaches we have been busier than ever advocating for an affordable Virginia. Last week, we held two advocacy days, one as Freedom Virginia and one with the Virginians for Affordable Medicine Coalition, advocating for a Prescription Drug Affordability Board, Paid Family and Medical Leave, Banning Hidden Fees, and a Fair Tax on Millionaires and Billionaires.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMMP/1/85567/images/IMG_5990%20%281%29.jpg]
Virginians for Affordable Medicine meets with legislators to discuss a Prescription Drug Affordability Board in Virginia
“ Advocacy days are important because it gives organizers and community members alike the unique opportunity to share why the issues we support are important to us and gives us face-time with our legislators. Legislators are hearing about so many bills all day and stories and face-to-face conversations help to plant the seed in their brains. ”
-Grace Robinson, Advocacy Organizer
As session speeds by, here’s a look at some of the other important legislation we supported and opposed this past week:
Supported:
Freedom Virginia is committed to lowering the cost of medicine for hardworking people and ensuring that drug companies can’t get away with price gouging. Accordingly, we supported:
HB 2329 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB2329] (Requires health plans to cover generic drug/biosimilar when they cover the brand name)
Freedom Virginia believes big corporations should not be able to get away with deceptive practices that slam Virginians with hidden fees, costing them thousands each year. Accordingly, we supported:
HB 2515 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB2515] (Banning Hidden Fees)
Freedom Virginia believes that to respond to our housing crisis, we must take bold action to greatly increase the supply of housing and lower the cost of rent or buying a home. Accordingly, we supported:
HB 1598 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB1598] (First-Time Homebuyer Tax Credit)
SB 1400 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SB1400] (Prohibits Algorithmic Price Fixing)
HB 1870 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB1870] (Prohibits Algorithmic Price Fixing)
SB 1424 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SB1424] (Prohibits Partnership, Corporation, or Trust from Buying a Single-Family Home)
Freedom Virginia believes we need to support hardworking parents, especially those who want to go back to work or work more, by lowering the cost of child care. Accordingly, we supported:
HB 2180 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB2180] (Child Tax Credit)
SB 1378 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SB1378] (Child Tax Credit)
HB 2049 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB2049] (Eliminates Sales Tax for Child Car Seats)
Freedom Virginia believes hardworking Virginians need to keep more of what they earn, whether it’s their own wages or the unnecessary fees charged by big corporations when they file their taxes. Accordingly, we supported:
HB 2333 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB2333] (Fair Tax on Millionaires and Billionaires)
HB 1717 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB1717] (Earned Income Tax Credit)
SB 810 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SB810] (Earned Income Tax Credit)
HB 1754 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB1754] (Higher Income Tax above $600,000 Earned and Increases Standard Deduction)
HB 2368 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB2368] (Toll Relief)
HB 2021 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB2021] (Requires Voice Assistant Providers to Set Up Services by Customers Opting In)
SB 1167 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SB1167] (Establishes minimum compensation for Uber/Lyft drivers, protects tips)
Opposed:
Freedom Virginia believes that we should take meaningful steps to make life more affordable for working people, including exempting tips from state taxes. However, proposals like HB 1965 had no protections to prevent the ultra-rich from reporting their income as tips to evade taxes, or to prevent employers from paying employees through tips instead of wages. Accordingly, we opposed:
HB 1965 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB1965] (No Taxes on Tips)
Freedom Virginia believes that there are myriad causes of expensive drugs, but that the solution to lowering drug prices is not by making health insurance more expensive for everyone. Accordingly, we opposed:
HB 2773 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB2773] (Drug cost sharing)
Thank you for your continued support as we advocate for an affordable Virginia!

name: Marjorie Taylor Greene
subject: Petition: Rename J6 ‘Patriots Day’
body:
Let’s send a message to the establishment

| | | | |
---
Friend, hundreds of patriotic Americans sat in jail cells in the Washington, DC gulag. They endured inhumane and un-Godly conditions as political prisoners of a corrupt and weaponized DOJ.
**They were political prisoners.**
They were being held because they dared to exercise their constitutional right to question an election: a sacred tradition as old as the Boston Tea Party itself.
They were targeted by institutions so corrupt and politicized, they make the USSR’s Secret Police look like a department store’s security guards.
These Americans deserve our appreciation... _**[and they deserve our recognition](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/9VaX/?__vbtrk=MjcyODEzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjcyODEzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**_**.**
**__[That’s why I’m asking YOU, right now, to sign my petition to declare January 6th as American Patriots’ Day](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/9VaX/?__vbtrk=MjcyODEzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjcyODEzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)__ _._**
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/9VaX/?__vbtrk=MjcyODEzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjcyODEzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Let me be clear: this is not just about them. **This is about all of us.**
This is about whether we still live in a nation where freedom of speech, freedom of assembly, and freedom to stand up against injustice are protected rights or if we have become a country where dissent is punished and patriots are silenced.
We don’t honor these patriots because of what the media says about that day;_****_**we honor them because of what it represents:**_**the courage to take a stand, the love of country that drives ordinary Americans to extraordinary action, and the resilience of a movement that refuses to be silenced.**_
[SIGN THE PETITION – DECLARE JANUARY 6th ‘AMERICAN PATRIOTS DAY’ ](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/9VaX/?__vbtrk=MjcyODEzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjcyODEzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Patriots’ Day will remind us of the values that make America great: love of country, belief in freedom, and the unshakable conviction that when the people rise, they cannot be silenced.
_Yours,_
[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/9VaX/?__vbtrk=MjcyODEzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjcyODEzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
_Marjorie Taylor Greene_
[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/9VaX/?__vbtrk=MjcyODEzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjcyODEzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)

American Eagle Flight No. 5342 crashed into a Sikorsky H-60 Black Hawk helicopter at around 9 p.m. Wednesday night, January 29, 2025.
The flight was preparing for landing at Reagan National Airport, inbound from Wichita, Kansas and carrying 64 people.
The Black Hawk helicopter the flight collided with was a "Priority Air Transport" flight, designated for transporting senior U.S. officials, and was crewed by three US Army members.
All 67 people are believed to be deceased.
This is the deadliest crash in America since November 2001.
And while the families were waiting for notifications and the country was waiting for answers, Trump let the country down by race-baiting the disaster.
Trump blamed [Obama, Biden and DEI initiatives](https://substack.com/redirect/706a97b5-e655-4cf3-9fc5-06c1fef976eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in an [unhinged press conference ](https://substack.com/redirect/4297100c-d02b-497a-8138-e174ac37f362?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)after the event, even though records released by the US Army show that all three members of the US military who were on the helicopter were white men.
Trump went further and blamed [Pete Buttigeg](https://substack.com/redirect/36e6611c-0fce-4c4d-85bd-80285758cdea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), though under his tenure as Secretary of Transportation there were no air disasters or crashes...

Peter, it’s Ritchie. My resume is different than many members of Congress:

I grew up in vermin-infested public housing. I was raised by a single mother in the Bronx, making just over $4 an hour to support her family.

I didn’t have a traditional path to Congress: In the years leading up, I dropped out of college, struggled with my mental health, and eventually ran for City Council at age 25.

But Peter, my resume isn’t all that different from many Americans:

I do know what it’s like to go to bed hungry.
I do know what it’s like to struggle with mental health.
I do know what it’s like to experience hate and discrimination as a member of the LGBTQ+ community.
I do have more in common with the average American than I do with my colleagues — _and I’m proud of it._

**Because what I lack in credentials, Peter, I make up for in lived experience.**

[My journey to Congress was untraditional, and so is the way I fundraise. Since I don’t do a second of call-time, I rely on grassroots support from folks like you. subject: Take some time outside
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Powered by People, [poweredxpeople
body:
#
This week has been an interesting one.
But even though Donald Trump and Greg Abbott are doing everything they can to drag our country backwards, and create as much chaos and confusion along the way, I still can’t shake my belief in a brighter future.
I know it won’t come easy and I know there’s a lot of pain and hard work in front of us. But I believe we will get there.
It helps in moments like these to get outside, spend some time in the Franklin mountains with our dogs (Freyja, Ziggy and Artemis who is pictured here) and try to find the long view.
Whether it’s a park or a hiking trail or some unspoiled wilderness in your neck of the woods, I hope you get a chance to do the same. The fresh air will do us all some good.
More soon,
Beto

name: Senator Jennifer Boysko
subject: Boysko Bulletin: Life-changing Legislation Passed by Senate Democrats
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/102624/images/Bulletin.jpeg]
Boysko Bulletin: Life-changing Legislation Passed by Senate Democrats
Dear Peter,
Next week we will reach Crossover, the time when all Senate bills cross over to the House of Delegates for consideration. This week the Senate passed many of my bills that would make life better for Virginians if signed into law! One of my highest profile bills is the Constitutional Amendment to enshrine the right to Reproductive Freedom in Virginia's Constitution. With majority control of the Senate, we rejected the anti-reproductive freedom amendments on the floor of the Senate.
The right to reproductive freedom has been a top priority for Virginians for years but now it’s more urgent than ever since the U.S. Supreme Court’s Dobbs decision overturning Roe v. Wade took away our rights to make decisions for ourselves about when, where, and with whom we decide to start or grow our families, giving that power to the States. In Virginia, we’ve been protected by the democratic majority in the Senate which has voted down every bill to strip reproductive freedom in Virginia. In other states, women have lost the power to make decisions for themselves. Women have been left without care. Some have lost their fertility and even their lives because doctors were afraid to perform life-saving procedures for fear of being sent to jail. Virginia Democrats are standing united in our efforts to pass the Constitutional Amendment and the voters will have the final say in a referendum after the amendment has passed the House and Senate twice, with an election in between. Next November’s elections will determine whether the resolution passes a second time, giving the voters the power to protect reproductive freedom in the Virginia Constitution. We all must stay engaged.
On the national scene, rest assured that I am monitoring it carefully and will continue to stand up for the people of Virginia and the members of our community. With the new President taking office last week, already there has been significant disarray. In his first days in office, President Trump issued an executive order calling for a “temporary pause of agency and other financial assistance programs” which led to a chaotic 24 hours as policy-makers worked to discern the executive order’s effect on economic development, health care, and disaster relief. Federal Aid portals were temporarily frozen. Federal grants are the largest source of Virginia's non-general funds. The Commonwealth is set to receive $45 billion in federal funds in this biennium. After the outcry from lawmakers, President Trump rescinded this executive order. I will be vigilant as we consider fiscal challenges for the Commonwealth caused by policy changes that will harm our economy and our safety net caused by the new federal government. I will continue to fight for the values and policies that we hold dear.
During the first half of the legislative session, the Senate hears bills carried by Senators and works on the Senate budget. During the second half of the legislative session, the Chambers swap bills, hearing those that passed their Chamber and reconciling their respective changes to the budget. So far, sixteen of my 20 bills are moving forward. Eight bills have passed the Senate and eight bills are on the Senate Floor nearing a final vote. Another bill with a large fiscal impact will be handled in budget negotiations and another will be sent for study. I will continue to work my bills through the House of Delegates and seek the Governor’s signature. Just know that the Senate Democrats have passed my life-changing legislation - it will be imperative that Democrats hold the majority in the House and the Senate and the Governor’s leadership after next November’s election - Virginians could have paid family and medical leave benefits to care for themselves, their loved ones and new babies. We would see a commitment to invest in a strong and effective public school system. We could enact meaningful environmental policy. We could see a narrowing of the wage gap that leaves women and minorities earning thousands of dollars less than white men. We could see firearms locked up safely in homes with children and other people not allowed access to firearms. This will be our reality if we elect Democrats in November in the House of Delegates and in the Governor’s Mansion.
You will find information on each of my bills in the legislative update section of this newsletter. If you have time, check out my legislative slate - I have a good mix of bills from constituents, Fairfax County, the Town of Herndon, businesses and nonprofit advocacy organizations.
I am very disappointed to tell you that SB 982 Casino gaming; eligible host localities [https://tinyurl.com/yxs87872] has reported from General Laws and Technology and the Finance and Appropriations Committee and is being debated on the Senate Floor. Opponents of the bill, including members of No Fairfax Casino [https://nocasinocoalition.org/] , traveled to Richmond to speak in opposition to the bill, working tirelessly to defeat this legislation. Not one member of the Fairfax Board of Supervisors in the community targeted for the casino has stated their support. One hundred six HOAs and community associations have expressed strong opposition in the immediate region. The Silver Line, especially in Tysons, is already the number one economic driver in the entire region, and I would argue in the entire Commonwealth, with Class A real estate that is highly sought after. And while the developer pushing the proposal claims that he has an MOU to assure labor protections, he doesn’t have the authority to guarantee them because he does not control the process and he has backed out of other MOUs where he promised a high-quality project. Also note that to meet revenue projections thrown out about the casino, it would have to be more successful than all casinos in Maryland *combined* and twice as successful as MGM Grand and more successful than the Bellagio in Las Vegas. The General Assembly has been swarmed with paid lobbyists on his payroll. If it was such a great idea there would be no need to have an army of paid advocates pushing the proposal. I have no illusions, the lofty promises appear to be winning the day. As you can see from the votes, no one in the community targeted for the casino voted for it. I share your strong opposition to a casino in our community and will continue to oppose it.
I am heartbroken by the tragic loss of life in the crash of a commercial jet and the military helicopter near National Airport. There are many questions and we will continue to follow the investigation. Many first responders have worked tirelessly to recover the victims. Family Assistance Centers have been set up at Washington National Airport and at the Hyatt Regency Hotel in Bethesda, Maryland. Please contact American Airlines at 1-800-679-8215 for information regarding loved ones on Flight 5342. Our prayers are with the families.
Kindest regards,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/102624/images/2024%20February%20Images/electronic%20signature.png]
Jennifer B. Boysko
Member, Senate of Virginia
Representing the newly created 38th Senate District making up the northernmost portions of Fairfax County (Great Falls, Herndon, McLean, Reston, WolfTrap, parts of unincorporated Vienna and a slice of Falls Church)

Keep in Touch
I am now in Richmond for the 2025 General Assembly Session. My team includes my Chief of Staff Karen Harrison, and aides, Kathy Shupe, Gillie Cuda, and Juliet Morro. Team Boysko also includes Ava Kegler from Hollins University, and Olga Rokhlenko and Jackson Sanders-Bussey from the University of Richmond. For constituent services and to schedule meetings with your community group, please call (703) 437-0086 or email Senator Boysko@senate.virginia.gov. To schedule a meeting in Richmond, you can send an email or call 804-698-7538. Friend me on Facebook [https://bit.ly/2PskgOp] and follow me on X. [https://bit.ly/3uLhVhC]

Peter,

**Well, it’s been quite the month. I know it can be overwhelming to keep up with the flurry of headlines coming out of the other Washington, so I want to offer you a bit of reassurance as we all figure out how to navigate this new political landscape.**

Serving Southwest Washington in Congress is an honor I don’t take lightly, and I strive every day to make good on my promise to find common ground in order to address the issues that matter most to you.

Peter, I remain committed to fighting for our shared values and against clickbait political agendas. But, that commitment has made me a target for far-right extremists whose only aim is to advance their dangerous, hateful agenda.

Derek,
We’ve been busy sorting through the overwhelming number of executive orders. It is overwhelming by design – a tactic outlined by the authors of Project 25 – and we refuse to be overwhelmed or stunned into paralysis. I hope you feel the same.
As a member of the House Armed Services Committee leadership team and one of only seven female veterans in the U.S. House, Chrissy can speak with more authority on the executive orders that undermine national security and civil rights (because we know they are related). Although all of the executive orders are worth commenting on, that’s not a realistic or smart tactic, so national security and civil rights are where we’re focusing right now.
How can you help during this time?

name: Office of the Governor
subject: Maryland's Path Forward and Our Pro-Growth Agenda
body:
Tackling the budget crisis, fostering growth, building a brighter future
---
| | | | | [](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2FPages%2Fhome.aspx/1/01000194be9fe734-ede7acac-cdd1-48dd-b63c-097a61721057-000000/3pUBBat4PNbgW-mCmPKYcaYa1GymvmAiaEzMujkpifM=390)
---
| [](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv=SFQrkaa9lOk%26t=3295s/1/01000194be9fe734-ede7acac-cdd1-48dd-b63c-097a61721057-000000/UdBoMKq4RlF7XIE55Pz6m8t2-IIDFb7o01rAtQc9Ch8=390)My fellow Marylanders, Weeks ago, I introduced our administration’s budget proposal to balance the state budget, with these four priorities: Grow the economy, strengthen our labor force, modernize government, and fix what’s broken in our tax system. This proposal will **grow our economy by investing in attracting, retaining, and growing businesses** in Maryland. We’re also modernizing state government to serve you better while **cutting $2 billion in spending—saving taxpayers money.** We also propose **reforms to the tax code to make it simpler, fairer, and pro-growth**. I’ve heard from families all throughout the state about how difficult it is for them to make ends meet. They deserve relief, so under our plan, **nearly****two-thirds of Marylanders will get a tax cut.** But our work doesn’t stop there. I’ve also signed executive orders to boost economic development and modernize state government. These steps will help us save taxpayers like you a combined **$50 million this year alone**. On top of that, I’ve unveiled our Economic Growth Agenda, which focuses on **making Maryland a leader in industries of the future** like quantum computing, A.I., defense, and biotech. Our “Capital of Quantum” Initiative will further position Maryland as a global leader and help**bring high-paying jobs and cutting-edge innovation to our state**. We’re continuing to prioritize and invest in our schools and communities. Our budget proposal **maintains record funding for K-12 education** and includes an $825 million investment in school construction to relieve crowded classrooms and ensure students have safe, well-kept places to be the innovative leaders we need. We’re also making **critical safety improvements to U.S. 81 and 15** in Western Maryland and we’re maintaining **a record $122 million in funding for local law enforcement and public safety** so we can continue delivering record drops in violent crime. Finally, on **Wednesday, February 5th** , I will deliver my **2025 State of the State Address** , where I will further discuss our budget proposal and lay out our legislative agenda for this session. You'll be able to watch the Address live on [our YouTube channel](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2F@GovWesMoore%2Fstreams/1/01000194be9fe734-ede7acac-cdd1-48dd-b63c-097a61721057-000000/EkwPDqp3ui1Y1zlbfOvG85pm9fQLE0Z5KEuYDlx31Ow=390) or [on Maryland Public Television](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.mpt.org%2Fstateofthestate%2F/1/01000194be9fe734-ede7acac-cdd1-48dd-b63c-097a61721057-000000/dqfppw-trFIBDJedA99aQQIsG4cAxWfsUoeNOEsuz7U=390). Together, we will build a Maryland that grows the middle class and ensures everyone has a pathway to work, wages, and wealth. Your Governor,
Wes Moore [](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Flive%2FSFQrkaa9lOk%3Fsi=VplZWui_J0nAgVWw/1/01000194be9fe734-ede7acac-cdd1-48dd-b63c-097a61721057-000000/O1drtJm_Xup0jfkwOVqdt-MGlAq25GYNOXGVvqiBJE8=390)[](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fdbm.maryland.gov%2Fbudget%2FDocuments%2Foperbudget%2F2026%2Fproposed%2FFY2026BudgetPresentation.pdf/1/01000194be9fe734-ede7acac-cdd1-48dd-b63c-097a61721057-000000/gGeYQfd5msjE1vyR_uP1oxahsjJJq9lqQA6iuEDhEXM=390)
---
| | [](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2FPages%2Fhome.aspx/2/01000194be9fe734-ede7acac-cdd1-48dd-b63c-097a61721057-000000/BsE1fid6YmQ0Kp8ZBCbJcWU1y_EmcTmcFQ9pYCQjIlU=390)
---
|
### [Addressing the Trump-Vance Administration's Freeze on Federal Funding](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2Fgovernor-wes-moore-statement-on-trumpvance-administrations-freeze-on-federal-funding.aspx/1/01000194be9fe734-ede7acac-cdd1-48dd-b63c-097a61721057-000000/Q8vyucCNRewYZY8J73beraoFEX3xp8xC178hg76hW_s=390)
We are still evaluating what, exactly, this ideological freeze would mean for our state and our people in the long-run. But one thing is already clear: These irresponsible actions and conflicting directives from the White House have caused unnecessary confusion, fear amongst Marylanders, and instability in our economy.
### [Highlighting Our Budget Proposal's Investment in School Construction](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2Fgovernor-moore-highlights-the-mooremiller-administration-fy-2026-budget-proposal-investment-in-school-construction.aspx/1/01000194be9fe734-ede7acac-cdd1-48dd-b63c-097a61721057-000000/t3S8Dp-OisJA3cl3GBSBvHUl7__twOCTu5dpsQMGFqA=390)

Frederick County is the fastest-growing county in our state and many of their schools are above capacity. Parents and educators asked for action, and we listened. Over the next five years, our proposed State investment for school construction totals more than $3 billion. We’re committed to investing in our young people and ensuring schools have the capacity needed to deliver on our promise.
---
### [Celebrating the Formation of the ENOUGH Alliance](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2Fgovernor-moore-celebrates-the-formation-of-the-enough-alliance-and-100-million-dollar-philanthropic-investment-to-end-child.aspx/1/01000194be9fe734-ede7acac-cdd1-48dd-b63c-097a61721057-000000/rvhQ-TbjEVCfKXKWcivMQHorzhsgkW5Pt1NJFPJcDpo=390)

The ENOUGH Alliance, a philanthropic community dedicated to investing in children and families to end child poverty, has come together because Maryland is doing something that has never been done before. By investing in communities and leveraging strategy we are saying "Enough" to cycles of generational poverty in our state.
### [Making Critical Investments in Safety and Capacity Improvements Along U.S. 15 in Western Maryland](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2Fgovernor-moore-highlights-critical-investments-in-safety-and-capacity-improvements-along-us-15-in-western-maryland.aspx/1/01000194be9fe734-ede7acac-cdd1-48dd-b63c-097a61721057-000000/9c5cY1l3XHOz8FIqBtQVD5YwIocCdkIhhPYRPcAJww4=390)

U.S. 15 is one of the most important pathways for commerce in our state – and also one of the most dangerous. People asked us to act, and that's exactly what we did. The funding for this project will:
* Prioritize basic highway safety,
* Protect Marylanders,
* Help workers travel, and
* Provide infrastructure to help grow our economy.

---
| [](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2FPages%2Fdefault.aspx/1/01000194be9fe734-ede7acac-cdd1-48dd-b63c-097a61721057-000000/ASmdN14TYMvJyYtbnjaQKp6CEpfnptpl_42n9mHezG0=390) | | |
## [Maryland enshrines access to abortion in state constitution after voters approve amendment](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwtop.com%2Fmaryland%2F2025%2F01%2Fmaryland-enshrines-access-to-abortion-in-state-constitution-after-voters-approve-amendment%2F/1/01000194be9fe734-ede7acac-cdd1-48dd-b63c-097a61721057-000000/M13Q_9TZlh2jz-gD2Ojy38ZDnx40kA4HEzX-mkCyOYc=390)

Maryland Gov. Wes Moore signed a proclamation enshrining access to abortion into the state’s constitution after voters approved ballot question 1 in the 2024 election.
---|---|---
| |
## [Most Marylanders would see a tax cut under Gov. Moore’s budget. How would that work?](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.thebaltimorebanner.com%2Fpolitics-power%2Fgovernor-moore-tax-plan-explained-7Y7T6ZLRHZF4HJOAEJ7CZKZ3XU%2F/1/01000194be9fe734-ede7acac-cdd1-48dd-b63c-097a61721057-000000/ifmqFJVsz1RgyIEjdMfa3sg30w_FI2QB1mcs7uIrkaM=390)

The average benefit for Marylanders receiving a tax cut would be about $173, officials said, though that number may be as much as $300 for people in lower- and middle-income ranges
---|---|---
| |
## [](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fmocoshow.com%2F2024%2F10%2F16%2Fmaryland-secures-13-9-million-in-federal-funding-to-boost-workforce-development-for-individuals-with-disabilities%2F/1/01000194be9fe734-ede7acac-cdd1-48dd-b63c-097a61721057-000000/m-G_lppV1Dmlm5Ec7DaT36ZwgdpisjmiUR9sFTlH7SE=390)**[MD aspires to be ‘quantum capital’ of the world one day](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fthedailyrecord.com%2F2025%2F01%2F15%2Fmd-aspires-to-be-quantum-capital-of-the-world-one-day%2F/1/01000194be9fe734-ede7acac-cdd1-48dd-b63c-097a61721057-000000/Dkeep7IImQJwcg6Cy4tH6zQUFldxnLTTUQkrEf_Uta8=390)**

Speaking at the College Park headquarters of IonQ, a leading quantum computing company, Moore said Tuesday he believes quantum is one of the industries in which Maryland has a competitive advantage, industries that could help grow an economy he said has been stagnant for too long.
---|---|---

# FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Reader In over sixty years in the legal profession, I’ve experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today’s media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun’s deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don’t agree with everything that can be found in the Sun’s pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I’ve been impressed by the Sun’s growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun’s success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don’t wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

subject: checking in with Peter
body:
Hi, Peter. I hope you're doing well. I wanted to reach out personally with an update on my first month in the new Congress with January coming to a close.
Needless to say, we’ve seen a lot of anxious headlines and likely unconstitutional moves from Donald Trump and House Republicans. Eggs aren’t any cheaper like they promised, tariffs are threatening entire sections of our economy, but they have been crystal clear about the _actual_ things they’re hoping to do.
They've tried to erase transgender individuals, repeal 65-year-old Civil Rights efforts, and shut down or defund entire portions of the federal government to clear room for tax cuts for billionaires. And along the way, Republican stooges in Congress have offered constitutional amendments (which will _never_ pass) to allow Donald Trump free reign to abuse his office and the federal government even more than last time.
_Despite the dysfunction, I’m still creating a path toward a positive future for the 17th District._ We are opening new community centers within the district, securing funding for our troops at Rock Island Arsenal, and bringing thousands of union jobs to the district. At the end of the day, I'll work with anyone if it means passing good legislation for our country and community.
**I've been so focused on delivering on these important legislative works that my staff and I have had less time to fundraise for the reelection effort. We know it's early, but this is still a swing seat, and the Republicans are still dead set on unseating me.**
I’m hoping to raise another $5,000 in online donations before midnight hits to set the tone for the rest of this cycle. Will you contribute what you can before midnight and help us reach this goal? I look forward to continuing delivering for our district and, as always, I'm grateful to have you by my side. I hope you'll stick with us and continue to support our efforts. Right now, the best way to do that is by donating to help keep this seat blue.
Here's that personalized link again: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q1-2025**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101340100/525654801/1514584251?refcode=em-1.31.25-2-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDJmYzM1YS0yYWUwLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk3ZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Zn0av6KLWC_P6ZBGHGKSRcnLtVRGQJnUNP5PfWEp-8o=)

Calling it an “incredible first step,” U.S. Senator Katie Britt and colleagues watched on Wednesday afternoon as President Donald Trump signed into law the Laken Riley Act.

The legislation, introduced and sponsored in the Senate by Britt (R-Montgomery), mandates that any illegal immigrants guilty of theft, burglary, larceny, and/or shoplifting must be detained by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement.

It also ensures that states have standing to bring civil actions against federal officials who refuse to enforce immigration law or who violate the law. Amendments to the bill later added the assault of a law enforcement officer or any crime that results in death or serious bodily injury to the list of offenses that will result in being arrested by ICE.

body:
all I can say is... wow.

|
---

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101340636/525656577/-473034427?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_EOM_250130_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYjkxNDU0Ny0yYmUwLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk3ZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=B7kPhyeVjuYjoxgR-MkiwakTVzAMFeu-yYny75zgwgk=) Derek,

This week when I questioned RFK Jr. on protecting Medicaid for the 2 million Virginians that rely on it, he seemed confused as to which programs were impacted by Trump’s illegal federal fundraising freeze. I had to explain to him that Medicaid is what prevents Virginians from health crises on a daily and weekly basis. And when I confronted him about his campaign fundraising off of Trump’s reckless directive, he claimed he didn’t think his campaign still existed.

[_**RFK Jr. won’t protect vulnerable Virginians. I will always fight to safeguard Medicaid for all Virginians and Americans. Will you rush a donation to my re-election campaign before our deadline at midnight so I can continue this crucial fight?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101340638/525656578/-473034427?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_EOM_250130_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYjkxNDU0Ny0yYmUwLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk3ZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=B7kPhyeVjuYjoxgR-MkiwakTVzAMFeu-yYny75zgwgk=)

That was just the tip of the iceberg, Derek. I pressed him on his commitment to protecting Community Health Centers. He seemed confused about what they were and how their funding worked. That’s pretty disqualifying to me.

**I wanted to give RFK Jr. a fair shot, but the fact of the matter is, I don’t believe he approaches this job with the knowledge and experience it deserves.**

Even though Trump rescinded his order to defund the federal government because we raised holy hell about how disruptive it was going to be, we’re still hearing that domestic violence shelters, firefighters, and Community Health Centers aren’t sure if they can keep their doors open.

body:
#
It’s been a chaotic and confusing week.
Trump made his first attempt to loot veterans, public education, and more by freezing all federal aid so as to end “DEI, woke gender ideology, and the Green New Deal.”
The order was temporarily blocked by a federal judge, but **one thing is certain: Trump is set on gutting progressive initiatives** across the country.
**So today, we’re highlighting four organizations whose community-driven, DEI, environmental justice work is the antidote to this authoritarianism.**
[Will you make a $4 contribution today — $1 for each of these incredible organizations — to help their work through the fiasco of this administration?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250131.GLMSMV&refcode=em20250131-8040-P_FND_CHA_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8040%2E2526796%2ED43jOF)
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250131.GLMSMV&refcode=em20250131-8040-P_FND_CHA_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8040%2E2526796%2ED43jOF)
_100% of your contribution will go directly to these non-profits doing essential community work._
**[Contribute $4](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250131.GLMSMV&refcode=em20250131-8040-P_FND_CHA_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=8040%2E2526796%2ED43jOF)**
Here’s some more information on each of the groups you are supporting today:
• **Malikah, Inc** is a mutual aid hub in Queens, providing organizing training for women’s empowerment and food relief to migrants, low-income families, and single parent households. Your support will also power their anti-violence and community building programming.
• **The Point Community Development Corporation** is dedicated to the comprehensive revitalization of the Hunts Point section of The Bronx with youth development, free public arts and culture events, and community partnerships to develop environmental justice awareness in the area.
• **Make the Road NY** offers an array of education, health, and legal services for immigrant and working class communities in NYC, and supports asylum seekers with services like housing assistance referrals, case management, Metrocards for public transit, and cash assistance.
• **Relief Access Program for The Bronx (known as RAP4Bronx)** has become a major mutual aid provider in NYC since the onset of COVID-19, and now provides food, prepared meals, and groceries to dozens of food pantries and public housing developments throughout The Bronx.
[We’ve seen this movement step up to achieve incredible things before. Together we’ve raised over $8 million for mutual aid groups, relief programs, and more.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250131.GLMSMV&refcode=em20250131-8040-P_FND_CHA_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=8040%2E2526796%2ED43jOF)
**[Contribute $4](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250131.GLMSMV&refcode=em20250131-8040-P_FND_CHA_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=8040%2E2526796%2ED43jOF)**
Whether or not you can contribute today, thank you for standing with us.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20250131?refcode=em20250131-8040-P_FND_CHA_HDL&t=24&refcode2=8040_2526796_D43jOF&akid=8040%2E2526796%2ED43jOF)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20250131-8040-P_FND_CHA_HDL&t=25&akid=8040%2E2526796%2ED43jOF)**

Fair, efficient, and simple are words you probably don't associate with our tax system. But what if they could be?

Unfortunately, the federal income tax is a complete mess.

It's not efficient, fair, or simple. It fosters tax avoidance and cheating and costs billions of dollars to administer. First proposed in 1981 by Hoover fellows Alvin Rabushka and Robert Hall, the flat tax was intended to simplify the federal tax system by replacing the progressive federal income tax system with a low and simple flat tax. They believed that the flat tax was the fairest, most efficient, simplest, and most workable tax plan.

The flat tax plan would give an enormous boost to the US economy by dramatically improving incentives to work, save, invest, and take entrepreneurial risks. It would also save taxpayers hundreds of billions in direct and indirect costs.

As we navigate the complexities of our present tax system, it becomes evident that change is necessary. The classic book, _The Flat Tax_ , critiques the flaws in our highly progressive tax structure and introduces a practical, efficient, and workable alternative.

Hall and Rabushka explain that:
* All income should be taxed once, and only once, at a uniform low rate.
* A flat tax would eliminate the distortions of the present tax treatment of business.
* It is not an academic abstraction but a workable solution that has been implemented in many countries.
* If meaningful, systematic tax reform is to succeed, it won't be birthed in Washington. It will come from millions of taxpayers demanding fairness in taxation.

That's why we want to share this Hoover Classic with as many Americans as possible, starting with you. By requesting your free copy of _The Flat Tax_ eBook, you not only gain access to invaluable insights but also become part of a community engaged in reshaping our thinking on taxation.

As you delve into the pages of _The Flat Tax_ , you'll discover not only the critique of the current system but a practical alternative that has been a guiding light for those seeking fairness, efficiency, and practicality.

Join us in unlocking the legacy of _The Flat Tax_. Claim your free copy now and become part of a movement for transformative ideas in tax reform.
